Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

 - Agency alumni who've made (or want to make) the move to the client side

 - Experience standing up a media function or measurement framework from scratch

 - Experience with OOH and large cultural-moment buys (sponsorships, tentpole events)

 - A point of view on how AI is changing media planning and buying — and what most brands get wrong about it

 - Active Replit user; you've built and shipped something with the product

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

We're looking for a Director, Commercial Enablement to build and lead our Commercial Enablement function across 37 EMEA markets. Sitting at the heart of our EMEA Merchant organisation, you'll lead a multi-disciplinary pod spanning Commercial Learning & Development, Analytics and Commercial Incentives, equipping our Merchant Sales, Account Management, and Support teams with the insights, capabilities, tools, and incentives they need to execute consistently and deliver exceptional merchant outcomes.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a pragmatic senior operator who thrives on turning commercial strategy into scalable systems — someone who can build high-performing teams, navigate ambiguity, and drive measurable improvements in frontline productivity, training effectiveness, and incentive performance.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

Learning & Development: You'll oversee the design and delivery of learning programs that build the skills, knowledge, and confidence Sales, Account Management, and Support teams need to execute consistently across markets — from new hire onboarding and role-based learning paths to manager enablement and targeted capability-building tied to commercial priorities. You'll partner closely with commercial leaders and central People, HR, and L&D teams to ensure programs are practical, measurable, and integrated into the broader company learning agenda.

Commercial Incentives: You'll own the design, rollout, and operation of incentive programs that align frontline behaviour with selection, growth, quality, profitability, and merchant outcome goals — ensuring plans are commercially sound, easy to understand, and operationally scalable. You'll also drive continuous improvement in incentive governance, documentation, controls, dispute resolution, and performance measurement, with accurate tracking and on-time payouts throughout.

Analytics & Reporting: You'll be responsible for providing trusted, actionable performance insights to commercial leaders and frontline teams. You will ensure leaders and teams have access to clear dashboards, validated metrics, consistent definitions, and reporting that helps them identify priority merchants, performance gaps, execution opportunities, and areas requiring intervention. You will partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, and business stakeholders to improve data availability, data quality, metric consistency, and reporting adoption.

Why Join Us?

jobs.title: Talent Investor - Venture Studio
jobs.description:
About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator. We build technology companies from scratch, working with leading corporate partners to identify opportunities, develop new products and businesses, and build the founding teams that turn them into independent companies.

Unlike a traditional VC, we don't just invest in companies that already exist. We help create them. That means our approach to talent is different too. We believe the right founder can fundamentally change the trajectory of a company.

About the Role:

As a Talent Investor, you'll sit at the intersection of venture, talent and company building, helping us identify the exceptional people who will build our next generation of companies.

Our ventures often start with a problem or opportunity, rather than a founder. Your job is to find the person who can turn that opportunity into an excellent business.

You'll work closely with our Venture Builders, Studio Leads and founders to:

  • Identify exceptional founders across our global network and beyond.

  • Build talent maps and develop a point of view on where the best founders and operators sit.

  • Assess individuals for founder-market fit, looking beyond CVs and conventional credentials to understand their potential to build a company.

  • Build relationships with exceptional people who aren't necessarily looking for their next role.

  • Convince them to take the leap into entrepreneurship and build with Founders Factory.

  • Help founders identify and recruit their early founding team across product, technology, commercial and growth.

  • Develop our approach to founder sourcing, assessment and talent intelligence as we build more ventures.

This isn't traditional recruitment. You won't be given a list of vacancies to fill. You'll be given venture theses and asked to work out who could build them.

You'll have significant autonomy to experiment with how we identify, assess and attract exceptional people, and your work will directly influence the quality and trajectory of the companies we build.

About You

At your core, you're obsessed with exceptional people and curious about how great companies are built.

You might come from VC, executive search, strategy consulting, investment banking, a high-growth startup, venture building or talent. You don't need to have worked in venture before.

What matters is that you can:

  • Spot exceptional people and develop a strong point of view on their potential.

  • Understand businesses, markets and what makes founders successful.

  • Build genuine relationships and influence people to make high-stakes career decisions.

  • Source talent creatively, particularly people who aren't actively looking.

  • Operate with limited information, ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy.

  • Balance instinct with evidence and be willing to change your mind.

  • Move quickly without compromising your judgement.

  • Communicate clearly and challenge assumptions when needed.

You don't need to be a founder or have a traditional career path. We care more about your judgement, curiosity, ambition and ability to identify exceptional people.

What You'll Be Measured On

  • Founder quality: Exceptional founders joining our ventures.

  • Founder-market fit: The quality of our decisions around who should build which company.

  • Speed: Moving from venture thesis to founder commitment quickly.

  • Founding teams: Helping founders build the teams they need to succeed.

  • Talent intelligence: Building a proprietary network and understanding of exceptional founders and operators.

  • Repeatability: Making our approach to talent investing better and more scalable over time.

A Career in Venture

Talent Investing sits at the intersection of people, company building and venture capital.

You'll develop an investor's perspective on founders and companies at the earliest possible stage, often before there is a company to invest in.

Over time, there is scope to develop into broader venture-building and investment responsibilities across Founders Factory, depending on your performance, interests and the needs of the business.

Our Culture

Working at Founders Factory is very different from working at a traditional company. We are resilient business builders, passionate about what we're creating and comfortable operating in uncertainty.

We:

  • Think big, act small, move fast

  • Value momentum over perfection

  • Embrace uncertainty and remain decisive

  • Suggest solutions, not problems

  • Prioritise diversity to strengthen our collective intelligence

  • Are polite, generous and show empathy to others

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Shares in the Founders Factory global portfolio

  • Hybrid working — typically Tuesdays and Thursdays in the London office

  • Up to 5 weeks working abroad each year

  • 25 days annual leave

  • 1 additional mental health day per quarter

  • Monthly calendar freedom day

  • Travel opportunities across our global Founders Factory offices

  • Access to our network of founders, investors, operators and corporate partners

Founders Factory is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where people can authentically be themselves, challenge assumptions, take risks and think creatively.

jobs.title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
jobs.description:
Senior Vet Surgeon

Salary up to £75,000 DOE

Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 plus a Welcome Bonus of up to £5000

 

Dragon Vets, part of inspiring vet care, are seeking an enthusiastic Veterinary Surgeon to join our Rissington site as a Senior Vet, The role will require you to help shape the future of the branch by developing the staff and supporting senior management to ensure the site thrives.

 

We promote further growth and development within the team, giving you access to a large client base with a wide variety of cases, equipment, CPD and a supportive team. In this role you will be working with a large team of dedicated Vets, Nurses and support team members to deliver excellent client and patient care.

 
The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week.
 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

Practice Highlights

 

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

 

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support.

 

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

 

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team – Vets Now – based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Average of 37 hours per week over 4 days
* 1 in 4 Saturday mornings
* No out-of-hours or on-call requirements
* Flexible options available for both part-time and full-time applicants
 

Here's what the team have to say

 

"I started at Dragon Vets nine years ago working after school as an ACA. After leaving to go to vet school, I was welcomed back into the team as a new graduate vet in 2023. Dragon have given me a supportive and exciting start to my career. We are lucky to have the facilities in house to advance diagnostics and care beyond first opinion. I enjoy working with all the team and am proud to be a part of it." – Sofia, Vet.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As Lead Veterinary Surgeon, you will be the most senior veterinary clinician within the practice, responsible for leading clinical standards, governance and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.

 

You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes and ways of working.

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS, with significant experience in small or mixed animal practice, including advanced surgical and medical capability
* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching and supporting veterinary colleagues
* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills
* Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
* The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations
* Professionalism, integrity and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities

In deze functie werk je mee aan een vlot productieproces bij een van onze klanten. Je focust op kwaliteit, veiligheid en tempo. jobs.title: Rådgjevar/seniorrådgjevar (jurist) – barnevern
jobs.description:
Om stillinga

Statsforvaltaren i Vestland lyser ut éi fast stilling for jurist på barnevernsområdet. Vi søkjer ein engasjert og fagleg sterk medarbeidar som ønskjer å bidra til forsvarlege og trygge tenester for barn og unge.

Tilsyn med barnevernsinstitusjonar er ein sentral del av stillinga.

Helse-, sosial- og barnevernsavdelinga har ansvar for tilsyn, rettleiing, klagesaksbehandling og andre forvaltningsoppgåver innan barnevern, sosialtenester, helse og omsorg. Vi jobbar i skjeringspunktet mellom juss og barnevernsfag på velferdsområdet. Vi løyser oppgåvene med høg kvalitet, fagleg tyngde og er i kontinuerleg utvikling.

Stillinga ligg til kontorstad Leikanger.


Arbeidsoppgåver

Ein vesentleg del av arbeidet er tilsyn med barnevernsinstitusjonar, der du vil

  • planleggje, gjennomføre og følgje opp tilsyn
  • vurdere praksis opp mot barnevernslova og forskrifter
  • utarbeide rapportar og eventuelle pålegg
  • samarbeide tett med kommunar, institusjonar og andre aktørar

Andre sentrale oppgåver er

  • behandling av klager og andre forvaltningssaker
  • råd og rettleiing til tenester og brukarar
  • formidling av faglege vurderingar
  • deltaking i fagutvikling og kompetanseheving

Andre relevante oppgåver kan bli tildelte etter avtale med seksjonsleiar.


Kvalifikasjonar
  • Juridisk embetseksamen / master i rettsvitskap
  • Gjerne erfaring frå barnevernsfeltet
  • God innsikt i offentleg forvaltning
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne på nynorsk og bokmål
  • Evne til strukturert og sjølvstendig arbeid
  • Trygg i møte med komplekse faglege vurderingar
  • Det er ønskjeleg med førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har gode samarbeidsevner og trivst i tverrfaglege miljø
  • er analytisk, grundig og fagleg trygg
  • kommuniserer klart og forståeleg
  • bidreg positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • er fleksibel, løysingsorientert og utviklingsretta

Personlege eigenskapar blir vektlagde.


Som tilsett hos Statsforvaltaren får du
  • interessante arbeidsoppgåver
  • eit kompetent og tverrfagleg arbeidsmiljø
  • ein arbeidsplass i utvikling
  • medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med god pensjonsordning, gunstig bustadlån og forsikringsordning
  • trening i arbeidstida
  • delvis heimekontor 
  • fleksibel arbeidstid
  • løn i samsvar med vår lokale lønspolitikk

Vil du jobbe hos oss? | Statsforvaltaren i Vestland

Kontora våre i Leikanger og Førde ligg i kommunar som er omfatta av den nye ordninga for sletting av studiegjeld. Det vil seie at etter eitt år som yrkesaktiv kan du få sletta 25 000 kroner av studielånet ditt.


Vi ønskjer mangfald

Statsforvaltaren ønskjer mangfald, og vil leggje til rette for eit inkluderande arbeidsliv. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel vere tekniske hjelpemiddel, tilpassing av møblar eller endringar av rutinar, arbeidsoppgåver og arbeidstid. 

Vi meiner at inkludering og mangfald er ein styrke. Vi ønskjer tilsette med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjonar, livserfaring og perspektiv for å bidra til endå betre oppgåveløysing.

Vi oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje utan omsyn til alder, kjønn, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller hol i CV-en. Vi oppmodar om å krysse av i jobbsøkjarportalen dersom du har nedsett funksjonsevne, hol i CV-en eller innvandrarbakgrunn. Dersom det er kvalifiserte søkjarar frå desse gruppene kallar vi inn minst ein søkjar i kvar av gruppene til intervju. 


Vilkår

Alle som søkjer stillinga må søkje digitalt gjennom rekrutteringsportalen Jobbnorge. Du må laste opp relevante vitnemål og attestar. Vitnemål og/eller karakterutskrifter hentar du frå vitnemålsportalen i Jobbnorge. Har du utdanning frå utlandet legg du ved godkjenning frå HK-dir. 

Når søknadsfristen er ute, vurderer vi søknaden din på bakgrunn av informasjonen du har sendt oss. Det er derfor viktig at du både i søknadsbrevet og CV-en, viser korleis kompetansen din fyller krava som er sett i utlysinga. 

Stillinga er lønna i stillingskode 1434 rådgjevar/1364 seniorrådgjevar, frå kr 610 000–770 000 brutto per år ut frå kvalifikasjonar og lokal lønnspolitikk. Stilling som seniorrådgjevar har strenge krav til kompetanse. For særskilt kvalifiserte søkjarar kan vi vurdere høgare løn. 

Dei første seks månadane er prøvetid. Du kan lese meir om det i statens personalhandbok.

Tenestemålet til embetet er nynorsk.

Offentleg søkjarliste blir utarbeidd etter søknadsfrist. Dersom du ønskjer å reservere deg frå oppføring må du grunngje dette. Du får varsel om reservasjon i rekrutteringsportalen dersom reservasjon ikkje blir teken til følgje.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Statsforvaltaren har eit heilskapsansvar for all statleg verksemd i fylket, og skal følgje opp vedtak, mål og retningslinjer frå stortinget og regjeringa. Vi skal dessutan fremje fylket sine interesser, og kan dermed ta initiativ både lokalt og overfor sentrale styringsmakter.

Statsforvaltaren kjenner kommunane, og er i kontakt med mange enkeltmenneske i ulike situasjonar og livsfasar.

Vi jobbar heile tida for at omverda skal oppleve Statsforvaltaren som tilgjengeleg, nær og løysingsorientert.

Statsforvaltaren i Vestland er ein spennande arbeidsplass med seks avdelingar og kring 280 tilsette. Vi har delt lokalisering mellom Leikanger, Bergen og Førde – med hovudsete i Leikanger.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. CesiumAstro’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems.
 
As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.
 
The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Designing and implementing software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment.
  • Designing, developing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting system software.
  • Reviewing code and system designs.
  • Analyzing code for efficiency, stability, and scalability.
  • Integrating and validating new product designs.
  • Supporting software quality assurance and optimizing I/O performance.
  • Providing post-production/in-orbit customer support.
  • Interfacing with hardware design and development engineers.
  • Assessing third-party and open-source software.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • 4+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs.
  • Experience with products for aerospace applications.
  • Programming experience in C or C++.
  • Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable).
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review.
  • Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets.
  • Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers.
  • Experience in the design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK).
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation.

    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Akershus fylkeskommune ønsker medarbeidere som tar en aktiv, engasjert, reflektert og ansvarlig rolle i organisasjonen vår. Hos oss møtes mennesker med ulik kompetanse- og utdanningsbakgrunn for å skape gode tjenester til våre innbyggere. Akershus fylkeskommune er en stor arbeidsgiver, og har ansvar for viktige samfunnsoppgaver som videregående opplæring, kollektivtransport og fylkesveier, tannhelsetjenester, regional planlegging, kultur og kulturminner.

Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Akershus fylkeskommune jobber for et inkluderende arbeidsliv, der våre ansatte i størst mulig grad gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi tilrettelegger slik at alle ansatte kan utføre sitt arbeid på best mulig måte.
Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Dette gjelder også dersom du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet (hull i CV-en).

For ansettelse i skole og tannhelse kreves det politiattest av kandidater som får tilbud om stilling. Dersom det fremkommer av din søknad at du ønsker konfidensiell behandling, gjør vi oppmerksom på følgende: Opplysninger om søker kan gjøres offentlig selv om søker har bedt om konfidensiell behandling. Søker vil da få tilsendt informasjon om dette jf. offentleglova § 25.

jobs.title: Support Technician  Customer & Operations
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy helping customers, solving problems and understanding how things work?

We are looking for a service-minded and technically confident Support Technician who enjoys working with people just as much as solving practical problems.

You will be an important point of contact for our customers and partners and help them get the most out of our solutions. The role combines customer support, troubleshooting, coordination and hands-on operational tasks.

You do not need to be a developer or a deep technical specialist. What matters is that you are comfortable with technology, curious enough to investigate problems and confident communicating with customers when things do not work as expected.

About us

We are a Swedish technology company founded in 2008 focused on asset tracking and connected asset management.

Our platform combines software, location data and connected hardware to help customers track, manage and gain better control of equipment, vehicles and other mobile assets.

We work with customers and partners in multiple markets, and English is a natural part of our day-to-day business.

We are a small, experienced team where people work closely across technology, support, sales and operations. That means short decision paths, broad responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

The role

Your main responsibility will be to support our customers and partners in their day-to-day use of our products and services.

You will answer questions, help solve problems and guide users when something is unclear or not working as expected.

Some issues will be straightforward. Others will require you to investigate further, check configurations, review available information or work together with colleagues in technology or operations.

An important part of the role is knowing how to communicate clearly and professionally — especially when a customer is frustrated, uncertain or needs help understanding a technical issue.

Because we are a small team, the role also includes some practical and operational tasks. You will work closely with fulfilment and may occasionally help with hardware preparation, configuration, shipments, returns and related administration.

What you will do

    Support customers and partners by email, phone and other support channels.
    Help users understand and use our products effectively.
    Troubleshoot technical and practical issues.
    Take ownership of support cases and follow them through to resolution.
    Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.
    Investigate issues before escalating them to colleagues.
    Work closely with technology, QA and fulfilment.
    Help with hardware preparation, configuration and operational tasks when needed.
    Document common questions and solutions.
    Identify recurring customer issues and help us improve our processes and product experience.

Who we think you are

You are someone who enjoys helping people and building good customer relationships.

You are patient, clear and professional in your communication, and you are comfortable dealing with both simple questions and more challenging situations.

At the same time, you have a good general understanding of technology and enjoy figuring things out.

You do not need to know everything from the start, but you should be comfortable learning new systems, asking the right questions and investigating a problem before passing it on.

You are also comfortable working in a small team where people help each other and where the role may vary from day to day.

We would like you to have

    Experience from customer support, technical support, IT support or a similar customer-facing role.
    Good general technical understanding and strong computer skills.
    A genuine interest in helping customers and providing a good service experience.
    Strong communication skills.
    Excellent English, both spoken and written.
    Good Swedish, both spoken and written.
    The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.
    A structured and solution-oriented way of working.
    The ability to stay calm and professional when dealing with difficult or urgent customer situations.

Nice to have

Experience in one or several of the following would be valuable, but is not required:

    Technical support or application support.
    Basic SQL or working with data.
    APIs or system integrations.
    IoT or connected devices.
    GPS, telematics or vehicle-related technology.
    Mobile connectivity and SIM-based devices.
    Hardware configuration or installation.
    Ticketing and support systems.

You do not need to be a developer or advanced technical specialist.

We are looking for someone who can combine good customer service, sound judgement and enough technical understanding to solve problems confidently.

What we offer

    A broad and varied role with real responsibility from day one.
    The opportunity to work closely with both customers and colleagues across the business.
    A small-team environment with short decision paths and plenty of room to influence how we work.
    The chance to build a strong understanding of both our products and our customers.
    A role where you can grow through practical experience rather than being limited to a narrow support function.
    30 days of annual leave.
    A generous wellness allowance and wellness package.
    An international working environment where both Swedish and English are part of everyday communication.

Why this role is different

This is a broad role with close contact with both customers and colleagues.

You will not simply process tickets. You will build relationships with customers, understand their needs and help make sure their issues are genuinely resolved.

At the same time, you will work close enough to our technology and products to develop a strong understanding of how everything fits together.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to build both technical knowledge and customer responsibility in a small team where your contribution matters.

This role could be a great fit if...

You enjoy customer contact and are good at creating trust.

You are technically comfortable without needing to be a specialist.

You like solving problems and taking ownership.

You enjoy variety and working closely with different parts of a business.

And you care about giving customers and partners a good experience — even when something has gone wrong.

If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.

  • Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.

  • Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.

  • Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise, Payments
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the Team

We are building a new Enterprise Payments team – a dedicated motion focused on winning and expanding large enterprise customers around Airwallex’s payment acceptance solutions.

This is a greenfield opportunity: you will be among the first Enterprise hires in the Enterprise team, helping define the sales playbook, shape GTM strategy, and close the deals that put Airwallex on the map in the enterprise payment acceptance category.

What You’ll Do

New Business & Pipeline Generation

  • Own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles from prospecting through to contract signature, with deal sizes typically $250K+ ARR

  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of enterprise prospects through outbound prospecting, partner referrals, field events, and industry networks

  • Conduct white space analysis and account planning to prioritise highest-potential opportunities within your territory

  • Run structured, consultative sales processes: discovery, value proposition design, stakeholder mapping, commercial negotiation, and close

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage and build trust with multiple senior stakeholders – CFO, CPO, Head of Finance, IT and Procurement – across complex buying committees

  • Deliver compelling executive-level presentations and business cases that connect Airwallex’s payment acceptance capabilities to specific customer outcomes

  • Represent Airwallex at industry events, conferences, and customer roundtables to build brand presence in the enterprise payment acceptance market

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to run proof-of-concepts and tailored demos that showcase platform value

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Enterprise Payments product team to relay customer insights and influence roadmap priorities

  • Collaborate with Marketing on territory demand generation, ABM campaigns, and competitive positioning

  • Coordinate with Implementation post-close to ensure a seamless handover and strong early adoption

  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene – accurate pipeline data, forecasting, and activity logging in Salesforce

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Develop deep expertise in enterprise payment acceptance, card acquiring, payment service providers, payment orchestration, fraud prevention, and checkout optimisation to credibly position Airwallex against competition

  • Stay current on market trends, customer procurement patterns, and the competitive landscape to sharpen your sales approach

  • Contribute to the development of the Enterprise Payments GTM playbook — messaging, objection handling, competitive battlecards

Who You Are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

jobs.title: Huoltoasentaja Päijät-Hämeen alueelle
jobs.description:
Ramirent vuokraa rakennuskoneita asiakkaiden työmaille ympäri Suomen. Ramirentin toimintaperiaatteisiin kuuluu niin laadukkaan palvelun kuin tuotteiden tarjoaminen, mikä tarkoittaa hyvin huollettua kalustoa ja tässä huoltoasentajamme ovat avainroolissa! Huollamme koneet määräaikana sekä korjaamme puutteet sekä viat ammattitaitoisesti. Pidämme huolen siitä, että vuokrakalustomme on asiakkaitamme varten aina siistinä ja hyvässä toimintakunnossa.

Etsimme nyt Päijät-Hämeen alueelle (Lahti – Hollola - Nastola) ammattitaitoista liikkuvaa huoltoasentajaa monipuolisiin työtehtäviin vahvistamaan huoltotiimiämme.

**Tärkeimpiä työtehtäviäsi:**

- Erilaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt monipuolisen kaluston parissa

- Huolto-, sekä korjaustyöt Ramirentin asiakkaiden työmailla, mutta tarvittaessa myös Ramirentin toimipisteissä

- Huoltojen ja korjausten kirjaaminen nykyaikaisten järjestelmien avulla


**Toivomme sinulta:**

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta koneiden korjaus- ja huoltotoiminnoista

- Kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- Halua oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista ja ammattitaitoa

- Kykyä oma-aloitteiseen itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- Nostolaitetarkastajan sertifiointia, mahdollisuus myös kouluttautua työn ohessa


Tärkeintä on, että työkalut pysyvät kädessäsi ja olet motivoitunut huollon ammattilainen!

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle**

Työtäsi on tukemassa modernit järjestelmät ja osaava tiimi sekä koko alan suurimman toimijan asiantunteva henkilöstö. Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen ja mielekkään työporukan. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisia urapolkumahdollisuuksia ja hyvät työsuhde-edut mm. lounas- ja virike-etu ja kattavan työterveyshuollon palvelut. Lisäksi koko henkilöstömme on mukana bonusohjelmassa.

**Lisätiedot ja hakeminen:**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Huoltopäällikkö Jesse Nieminen aikavälillä klo 9–15 puhelimitse numerosta 0500333573 tai sähköpostitse osoitteesta jesse.nieminen@ramirent.fi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen hakuportaalimme kautta viimeistään 13.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä paikka täytetään heti.

jobs.title: Rakennusalan osaajia (sopii hyvin vasta valmistuneelle)
jobs.description:
Rakennusalan osaajia talotehtaalle Oulun lähialueelle

Oletko juuri valmistunut rakennusalan ammattilainen ja valmis ottamaan ensimmäisen askeleen työelämässä? Nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus kartuttaa arvokasta työkokemusta taloteollisuuden parissa!

Etsimme vasta valmistuneita rakennusalan osaajia, joilla on hyvä asenne työntekoon, halu oppia uutta ja motivaatio kehittyä ammattilaisena. Aikaisemman työkokemuksen puuttuminen ei ole este – tärkeintä on reipas ja oma-aloitteinen asenne sekä halu tehdä töitä.


Mitä tarjoamme?

* Mahdollisuuden saada ensimmäistä työkokemusta rakennusalalta
* Työskentelyn nykyaikaisessa talotehtaassa
* Työt tehdään sisätiloissa, joten sinun ei tarvitse olla sääolosuhteiden armoilla
* Mahdollisuuden oppia käytännön työtehtäviä kokeneiden ammattilaisten kanssa
* Kaksivuorotyön, joka tuo vaihtelua työpäiviin
* Hyvän mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista ja rakentaa vahvaa pohjaa tulevalle uralle


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* Rakennusalan koulutusta – olet esimerkiksi vastavalmistunut rakennusalan ammattilainen
* Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta
* Halua oppia ja kehittyä
* Ahkeruutta ja luotettavuutta
* Valmiutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä
* Omaa autoa, sillä työpaikalle ei pääse julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla

Jos olet juuri valmistunut ja mietit, mistä saisit ensimmäisen oman alan työpaikkasi, tässä voi olla sinulle loistava mahdollisuus päästä näyttämään osaamisesi ja kartuttamaan arvokasta kokemusta!

Älä jää odottamaan sitä ensimmäistä työkokemusta – tule hankkimaan se kanssamme!

TYÖT ALKAVAT HETI!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, koulutuksestasi ja siitä, miksi juuri sinä sopisit tehtävään.

Toimi nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikat heti sopivien tekijöiden löydyttyä!

Lisätietoja:

Marko Perander,

marko.perander@wirestaff.fi

WIRESTAFF on vahva ja kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija. Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset. Wire on meidän näköisemme — ei turhaa kiertelyä tai jauhantaa.

Etsimme nyt Etelä-Suomen alueelle (Helsinki – Vantaa – Espoo) ammattitaitoista liikkuvaa huoltoasentajaa monipuolisiin työtehtäviin vahvistamaan huoltotiimiämme.

**Tärkeimpiä työtehtäviäsi:**

- Erilaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt monipuolisen kaluston parissa

- Huolto-, sekä korjaustyöt Ramirentin asiakkaiden työmailla, mutta tarvittaessa myös Ramirentin toimipisteissa

- Huoltojen ja korjausten kirjaaminen nykyaikaisten järjestelmien avulla


**Toivomme sinulta:**

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta koneiden korjaus- ja huoltotoiminnoista

- Kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- Halua oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista ja ammattitaitoa

- Kykyä oma-aloitteiseen itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- Nostolaitetarkastajan sertifiointia, mahdollisuus myös kouluttautua työn ohessa


Tärkeintä on, että työkalut pysyvät kädessäsi ja olet motivoitunut huollon ammattilainen!

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle**

Työtäsi on tukemassa modernit järjestelmät ja osaava tiimi sekä koko alan suurimman toimijan asiantunteva henkilöstö. Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen ja mielekkään työporukan. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisia urapolkumahdollisuuksia ja hyvät työsuhde-edut mm. lounas- ja virike-etu ja kattavan työterveyshuollon palvelut. Lisäksi koko henkilöstömme on mukana bonusohjelmassa.

**Lisätiedot ja hakeminen:**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Huoltopäällikkö Jouni Suominen klo 9–15 puhelimitse numerosta 0407354104 tai sähköpostitse osoitteesta jouni.suominen@ramirent.fi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen ja palkkatoiveineen hakuportaalimme kautta viimeistään 13.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä paikka täytetään heti.

jobs.title: Aputyömies
jobs.description:
Etsimme ahkeraa, oma-aloitteista ja reipasta henkilöä, joka tarttuu tehtäviin hyvällä asenteella. Aikaisempi kokemus alalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on motivaatio, oppimishalu ja halu tehdä työnsä hyvin.

**Tarjoamme:**

- Monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen työn

- Mukavan työporukan

- Mahdollisuuden oppia ja kehittyä

- Asianmukaisen perehdytyksen


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta

- Luotettavuutta ja täsmällisyyttä

- Oma-aloitteisuutta

- Hyvää fyysistä työkykyä

- B-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Quality Engineer

At Koenigsegg, quality is engineered from the start. As a Product Quality Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of Engineering, Production, and Suppliers to solve complex technical challenges and help deliver some of the world's most advanced Megacars.

What you'll do

    Lead complex quality investigations using methodologies such as 8D, DMAIC, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone, and Root Cause Analysis.
    Drive resolution of issues related to product design, manufacturing, assembly, suppliers, materials, and process variation.
    Coordinate containment, corrective, and preventive actions while ensuring robust verification of implemented solutions.
    Collaborate closely with Design Engineering to improve product robustness, manufacturability, and reliability.
    Support production teams with hands-on problem solving on the shop floor.
    Contribute to product development through DFMEA, PFMEA, APQP, design reviews, and risk assessments.
    Drive continuous improvement and maintain quality documentation, standards, and compliance with automotive quality requirements.

Who you are

You are an analytical, hands-on engineer with a passion for solving complex problems. You take ownership, challenge existing ways of working, and collaborate effectively across functions in a fast-paced environment.

We believe you have

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering.
    5+ years of experience in automotive or manufacturing quality.
    Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, GD&T, metrology, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, and Lean Manufacturing.
    Experience with ERP/MES/QMS systems and supplier quality is an advantage.
    Experience in root cause analysis, using structured quality methodologies to resolve product design, manufacturing, assembly, and human relation deviations.
    Experience working and leading cross-functional teams - solving complex manufacturing issues.

Experience from high-performance automotive, motorsport, aerospace, or low-volume manufacturing is highly valued. Experience with composites, EV technologies, prototype builds, or launch quality is considered a plus.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

jobs.title: Agent de parc polyvalent
jobs.description:
Autonomie, contact client, matériel professionnel, polyvalence et travail concret sur le terrain Ta mission :
  • Gérer et organiser le parc de matériel en fonction des priorités de l'agence.
  • Vérifier l'état de fonctionnement du matériel avant et après location.
  • Accueillir les clients et leur fournir des explications claires sur l'utilisation du matériel.
  • Assurer la préparation, le rangement et l'optimisation des espaces du parc.
  • Réaliser des vérifications techniques de premier niveau et effectuer de petites interventions si nécessaire.
  • Collaborer avec l'atelier et l'équipe location pour garantir la disponibilité du matériel.
  • Suivre les stocks de consommables et signaler les besoins.
  • Respecter strictement les consignes de sécurité en agence.
  • Travailler dans un environnement dynamique, avec une forte orientation service et technique


Over het bedrijf
Jobmatch Nivelles recherche un Responsable pour un parc de location de matériel situé à Bruxelles. Mission en vue d'un poste fixe.
Ton profil :
  • Expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans un environnement technique ou opérationnel (logistique, maintenance, chantier).
  • Bonne compréhension du matériel et intérêt pour le domaine technique.
  • Sens du service client : assurer la conformité et la disponibilité du matériel.
  • Aisance avec le matériel et les clients sur le terrain.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe, en collaboration avec l'atelier et la location.
  • Rigueur, organisation et respect des procédures.
  • Maîtrise du français et du néerlandais à un niveau opérationnel.
  • Formation équivalente par expérience acceptée.

jobs.title: Secrétaire médicale expérimenté(e) | Waterloo
jobs.description:
Mission
En tant que Secrétaire Médicale Expérimentée, vous assurez le bon fonctionnement de l'accueil et du secrétariat du cabinet. Vous êtes le premier point de contact des patients et contribuez à offrir un accueil professionnel, chaleureux et efficace. Grâce à votre sens de l'organisation, votre discrétion et votre excellente présentation, vous gérez les tâches administratives quotidiennes en support aux différents praticiens du cabinet.
Responsabilités principales:

Accueil et relation patient
Accueillir les patients avec professionnalisme et bienveillance.
  • Assurer l'enregistrement administratif des patients.
Orienter les patients vers le praticien ou le service concerné.
  • Gérer les demandes d'information en présentiel et par téléphone.
  • Veiller à la qualité de l'expérience patient.
Gestion des agendas médicaux
Planifier, modifier et confirmer les rendez-vous.
  • Gérer les agendas de plusieurs médecins spécialistes.
  • Optimiser les plannings et anticiper les besoins organisationnels.
Assurer le suivi des annulations et des urgences.

Gestion téléphonique
  • Réceptionner les appels entrants.
  • Identifier les demandes et les transmettre au bon interlocuteur.
  • Fournir les informations administratives nécessaires aux patients
  • Assurer un suivi rigoureux des messages et demandes.


Gestion administrative
Constituer et mettre à jour les dossiers patients.
Rédiger et traiter les courriers administratifs.
  • Compléter et assurer le suivi des documents d'assurances, certificats et formulaires divers.
Scanner, classer et archiver les documents médicaux et administratifs.
Veiller à la confidentialité des informations conformément aux règles en vigueur.

Support aux praticiens
  • Assurer un soutien administratif aux chirurgiens, kinésithérapeutes et radiologue.
  • Garantir la bonne circulation des informations au sein du cabinet.
Participer au bon fonctionnement et à l'organisation quotidienne de la structure. Profil recherché Formation et expérience:
Formation en secrétariat médical ou administratif.
Expérience confirmée de minimum 3 ans dans une fonction similaire.
  • Une expérience en cabinet médical, maison médicale, clinique ou hôpital constitue un atout majeur.
Compétences :
  • Excellente maîtrise de la gestion d'agendas complexes.
  • Très bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et bureautiques.
  • Grande aisance téléphonique.
  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et administratives.
Bonne gestion des priorités et du stress.

Qualités personnelles:
Excellente présentation.
Élocution irréprochable.
Sens du service et de l'accueil.
Empathie et discrétion.
Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.
Esprit d'équipe.
  • Fiabilité et ponctualité.
  • Respect absolu de la confidentialité.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij administratief sterk én heb je een vlotte babbel? Krijg je energie van klanten helpen, denk je graag mee en spot je moeiteloos commerciële kansen? Dan ben jij de klantgerichte collega die we zoeken!

Als Customer Service Medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten: Je luistert naar hun vragen en behoeften, geeft deskundig advies en zoekt samen naar de best mogelijke oplossing. Dankzij jouw persoonlijke aanpak zorg je ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord en goed geholpen voelen.

  • Je staat klanten professioneel en vriendelijk te woord via telefoon, e-mail en chat.
  • Je luistert actief naar de klant en brengt zijn of haar behoeften en verwachtingen helder in kaart.
  • Je geeft advies en informatie op maat en denkt proactief mee over de beste oplossing.
  • Je herkent commerciële opportuniteiten en weet deze op een natuurlijke manier om te zetten in concrete acties.
  • Je verwerkt en registreert alle klantinformatie nauwkeurig en tijdig in het systeem.
  • Je volgt klantvragen en dossiers correct op en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nagekomen.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende interne afdelingen om klanten snel en efficiënt verder te helpen.
  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe de klantenservice verder kan worden verbeterd.

Kortom: jij combineert een klantgerichte aanpak met commerciële feeling en zorgt ervoor dat elke klantcontact een positieve ervaring wordt.

  • Je communiceert vloeiend in het Nederlands, zowel gesproken als geschreven, aangevuld met een aardig mondje Frans en Engels.
  • Je bent stressbestendig en klantvriendelijk. Je gaat altijd voor de beste oplossing voor het bedrijf én de klant.
  • Je kan vlot schakelen tussen verschillende kanalen.
  • Je blijft rustig en kan prioriteiten stellen.
  • Je past je gemakkelijk aan aan je gesprekspartner, zodat het gesprek zo optimaal mogelijk verloopt.
  • Zaterdagwerk (volledige dag) is geen probleem voor jou. (1 zaterdag op 2)

jobs.title: Assistent restaurantmanager
jobs.description:
Deze zaak staat voor betaalbaar en toegankelijk genieten van Belgische klassiekers, waarbij kwaliteit, lokale ingrediënten en gastvrijheid centraal staan. Het restaurant biedt een ruim aanbod aan maaltijden voor ontbijt, lunch en diner en wil een ontmoetingsplaats zijn waar families, vrienden en collega’s samenkomen.

Het is trots op zijn waarden van respect, teamwork, engagement, ondernemerschap, evolutie en kwaliteit, die de basis vormen van de bedrijfscultuur en de dagelijkse werking. Dankzij de ligging, de ruime parking, goede toegankelijkheid, wifi en nabijheid van belangrijke invalswegen is het restaurant vlot bereikbaar voor bezoekers uit Brugge en de ruime regio.


Jobomschrijving

Hoe ziet jouw dag er uit als Shiftleader keuken in dit familierestaurant?

Deze taken neem jij voor jouw rekening:

  • Je neemt het team mee en ondersteunt de dagelijkse planning en zorgt voor een duidelijke, praktische aansturing
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat alle toestellen correct zijn opgestart en perfect klaarstaan om tijdens de service vlot te draaien.
  • Met zorg en precisie bereid je koude gerechten, van frisse voorgerechten tot heerlijke desserts, die klanten meteen doen watertanden.
  • Je zorgt voor een nette en georganiseerde werkplek, want een goede service start in een propere en gestructureerde keuken.
  • Je ondersteunt collega’s waar nodig en werkt samen om het beste resultaat neer te zetten

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Wie ben jij als Shiftleader keuken in dit familierestaurant?

  • Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring in de keuken van een horecazaak
  • Je bent een echte teamplayer
  • Je hebt geen probleem met shiften en weekendwerk
  • Je hebt ervaring met aansturen binnen een klein team
  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels

jobs.title: Technical Customer Trainer
jobs.description:
Place of employment - Groot-Bijgaarden


Jobomschrijving

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a  Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.

Your Role

  • As a Technical Customer Trainer, you will be responsible for transferring technical knowledge to customers, workshops, fleets, and service partners. You will act as a key technical contact, ensuring that customers have the knowledge and tools needed to effectively use and maintain products and systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Training & Knowledge Transfer

  • Deliver technical training programs to customers, service partners, and network organizations.
  • Ensure accurate and effective transfer of technical product and system knowledge. 
  • Develop new training programs that respond to market demands and customer needs.
  • Create and maintain training-related system access and software credentials where required.
  • Conduct on-site customer training sessions and technical presentations at customer events.

Technical Support

  • Provide technical support to aftermarket customers.
  • Assist customers with technical questions related to products and systems.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for technical solutions and applications. 

Customer & Network Development

  • Maintain strong relationships with service workshops, fleets, and industry partners. 
  • Support the development and maintenance of commercial service networks.
  • Identify training opportunities and emerging market needs.

Your Profile:

Qualifications & Experience

  • You must have experience providing technical training in the automotive sector.
  • Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle systems and products.
  • Extensive experience within the automotive commercial vehicle sector, particularly involving trucks, buses, trailers, and air brake systems. 
  • Experience delivering technical training, coaching, or technical customer support. 
  • Well-established network within the commercial vehicle service industry is considered an advantage. 

 

Language Skills

  • Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.
  • Comfortable delivering training sessions to international audiences and expatriate teams. 

Personal Competencies

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Passion for teaching and developing others.
  • Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset. 
  • Highly motivated to learn and master new technologies and product portfolios.
  • Flexible and willing to adapt to customer requirements and training locations. 
  • Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Vi søker en dedikert og fleksibel medarbeider i 30% stilling til vår butikk på Jærhagen
jobs.description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

 

Brenner du for Retail? Elsker du salg og får energi av å yte topp service? Lar du deg inspirere av interiør, tekstil, møbler og trender? Trives du også med at du får dine daglige skritt i løpet av en arbeidsdag, og at en dag aldri er lik den neste? Da er vi i Kid kanskje en perfekt match for deg!

Vår butikk på Jærhagen søker en ny butikkmedarbeider i 30 % stilling.

Vi søker etter en selger som uten å tenke seg om møter våre kunder, kollegaer og leder med et stort smil og et «hei». Du utstråler energi og blir giret av å levere gode resultater. Du er i tillegg dedikert og fleksibel, og finnes ikke redd for å ta på deg verken nye oppgaver og ansvar.

 

 Vi har spurt våre kolleger om hva som er det beste med å jobbe i Kid, og da svarer de:

«Kid har gode verdier og evner å se enkeltindividene»

«Det er enkelt å lære seg å bli flink i jobben sin og det gir en god mestringsfølelse»

«Det legges til rette for gode fremtidsutsikter og Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver»

«Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!»

 

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • Sørge for at kundene våre får tidenes beste kundeopplevelse
  • Bidra til å skape en inspirerende butikk, som er kampanjeklar og som bugner av varer
  • Være en i teamet som ser hva som må gjøres av stort og smått og som tar initiativ, også før noen spør deg
  • Leverer oppgaver av høy kvalitet og i tide
  • Jobbe målrettet for å oppnå salgsmål

 

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Drømmer om en jobb i salg- og kundeservice
  • Er energisk, utadvendt og glad i folk
  • På en naturlig måte, skaper en god relasjon og kommunikasjon med kundene våre. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du snakker godt norsk.
  • Kan jobbe dag, kveld og helg og er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid
  • Trives med å jobbe ut ifra konsept, og det er en styrke om du i tillegg har estetisk sans
  • Trigges av resultater, og har ambisjoner på egne og andres vegne
  • Er «fremme i skoa», tar initiativ og liker at ingen dag er lik en annen

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En utfordrende stilling i en kjede med flotte kvalitetsprodukter
  • Spennende karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter for de som vil og kan
  • En «levende» bransje med store variasjoner, hvor den enkeltes innsats teller
  • Deltidsstillinger som fint kan kombineres med skole og utdanning
  • Et nettverk av butikker over hele landet som også gir muligheter for å jobbe i andre avdelinger
  • Et bonussystem for alle faste medarbeidere som er ansatt over 20%

 

Med en veldreven organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen, ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder er butikkleder. Du vil bli del av et sammensveiset team med dyktige kolleger, både i egen butikk, i regionen og som en del av et stort nordisk konsern.

NB! Vennligst ikke send søknaden din pr e-post til oss. Kun søknader som sendes via vår rekrutteringsportal vil bli vurdert. Gå inn på karrieresiden vår karriere.kid.no for å sende oss en søknad.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...

jobs.description:
Søk LIS2 indremedisin i Kirkenes - her kan vi tilby godt arbeidsmiljø, faglig utvikling og overskudd til livet utenfor jobb!

Vi ønsker velkommen til oss på medisinsk avdeling Kirkenes Sykehus, vi har ledig fast stilling som LIS2/3 i indremedisin (kardiologi, gastroenterologi, geriatri, lungesykdommer og nyresykdommer).  Vi holder til i moderne lokaler i et av landets nyeste sykehus. Vår avdeling består av 10 faste ansatte spesialister, 10 LIS2/3 og 6 LIS1 som tilsammen utgjør en gruppe med god indremedisinsk breddekompetanse og godt faglig fokus. Hos oss er det viktig med kollegialt samhold, det er kort vei til leder og kolleger, vi praktiserer en flat struktur og et raust og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

I tillegg til fine arbeidshverdager kan vi friste med en god jobb-hjem-balanse der du har overskudd til livet også utenfor jobb. På fritiden er det gode muligheter for friluftsliv sommer som vinter, vi har skiløype helt frem til personalinngangen og vi kan i tillegg friste med eksotiske og dagligdagse ting som nordlys på vei til nattevakt og reinsdyr på parkeringsplassen. Kirkenes kan by på kulturaktiviteter som kino og teater, festivaler både sommer og vinter, korps og flere kor. Det er også flere ulike idrettslag i kommunen, i tillegg til sykehusets eget bedriftsidrettslag Angina.

Vår tjenesteplan har både lengre og kortere friperioder, og dermed gode muligheter til reiser og opplevelser, og todeling av vaktdøgnet som innebærer at man ikke behøver å jobbe hele døgnvakter. Hos oss vil du få mulighet til å komme gjennom alle anbefalte kurs for spesialisering på normert tid, og det er faste studiedager i den rullerende arbeidsplanen. Arbeid som LIS2 i vår avdeling inneholder vaktarbeid, postarbeid og poliklinikk bredt innen det indremedisinske faget. Du vil bli godt fulgt opp av vår stab av faste overleger i avdelingen (indremedisinere, kardiologer, lungeleger, geriater, nefrolog, onkolog). Vi setter trivsel på jobb svært høyt, og tror at det bidrar til økt kvalitet i vår avdeling. Det er svært viktig for oss at alle våre ansatte skal ha tid til å praktisere god pasientbehandling. Det gjennomføres jevnlig simulering og teamtrening.

Vi har samarbeidsavtale med UNN om gjennomgangsstillinger som sikrer raskt forløp til spesialistgodkjenning. Vi kan også forsøke å legge til rette for at du kan fullføre spesialiseringen ved annet sykehus. Et spesialiseringsløp hos oss er dermed strømlinjeformet slik at det tar kortest mulig tid. jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Growth Sports
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - Growth Sports

Location: Basingstoke/London (can be based in either location, travel expected to other location)

Reporting to: Head of Commercial - Growth Sports

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and commercially driven Business Development Manager - Growth Sports to lead Hawk-Eye's expansion across existing sports and services where we already have a presence, including swimming, volleyball, horse racing and pickleball, as well as opening up sports where we do not yet operate.

This is a new business role at heart. The majority of your pipeline will come from your own outbound activity: researching target federations, leagues and event organisers, identifying the right people to approach and making first contact. You will take those conversations from an initial approach through proposal, pricing and negotiation to a signed contract, and then grow the relationship from there. Inbound enquiries and existing partnerships form an important part of the role, but the growth we are looking for will come from opportunities you create.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Business Development

  • Build and maintain a target list of federations, leagues, promoters, broadcasters and event organisers across existing and new sports, and keep it prioritised as the market moves.

  • Research each target properly before making contact, so that conversations start from their competition calendar, officiating challenges or broadcast commitments rather than a generic introduction.

  • Make first contact directly and consistently, using a mix of calls, email, LinkedIn and introductions, with structured follow-up rather than a single approach.

  • Use industry events, federation congresses and trade shows as opportunities to secure meetings, with outreach planned in advance and followed up afterwards.

  • Qualify opportunities early, establishing budget, decision makers, technical requirements and timelines, and focus effort where there is a realistic route to a deal.

  • Develop and present business proposals, commercial bids and responses to RFPs and tenders.

  • Manage your pipeline and forecasts accurately in the CRM, and revisit dormant or unsuccessful prospects on a planned basis.

  • Respond to inbound business development enquiries and qualify them alongside self-generated opportunities.

Client and Partner Engagement

  • Establish and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including federations, leagues, event organisers and broadcasters.

  • Navigate long, multi-stakeholder buying processes, including committee approvals, tender cycles and seasonal budget timelines.

  • Identify additional competitions, venues, territories and product lines to sell into existing accounts, rather than waiting for renewal conversations.

  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful execution of contracts and client deliverables.

Financial and Commercial Strategy

  • Develop cost sheets, pricing models and financial forecasts for new business opportunities.

  • Collaborate with the legal team to draft and negotiate contracts through to close.

  • Track and manage contract timelines, renewals and new agreements, opening renewal conversations well ahead of expiry.

  • Manage the invoicing schedule for each of your clients.

  • Monitor revenue performance and contribute to financial reporting and forecasting.

Internal Collaboration and Efficiency

  • Work closely with Commercial Managers across other sports to align business development strategies and share market intelligence and proposal content.

  • Develop efficient processes for proposal creation, contract management and revenue tracking.

  • Ensure a seamless transition from commercial discussions to operational execution.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A track record of winning new business that you sourced yourself, ideally against a revenue or new business target.

  • Experience of considered, complex B2B sales with cycles measured in months rather than weeks.

  • Experience in business development, sales or commercial strategy within the sports industry, or a comparable technology sector.

  • Knowledge of sports technology and the competitive landscape across both emerging and established sports.

  • Excellent financial and analytical skills to build cost structures and pricing models.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate commercial contracts with support from the legal team.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.

  • Confident use of a CRM to manage pipeline and forecasting.

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, sports management, marketing or a related field, or equivalent commercial experience.

Key Skills and Attributes

  • New Business Focused: Enjoys opening relationships from cold and takes ownership of generating their own pipeline.

  • Resilient: Comfortable with the pace and response rates of outbound work, and persistent without being pushy.

  • Strategic Mindset: Chooses targets carefully and can explain why a sport or account is worth pursuing.

  • Commercial Acumen: Understands market trends, financial models and business drivers.

  • Client-Focused: Strong relationship-building skills with a customer-centric approach.

  • Detail-Oriented: Manages multiple opportunities, contracts and financial details without letting follow-ups slip.

  • Collaborative: Works well across teams to drive efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Self-Motivated: Takes initiative and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Why Join Hawk-Eye?

  • Work with cutting-edge sports technology in a rapidly growing market.

  • Play a key role in shaping Hawk-Eye's presence in both existing and emerging sports, including sports we have never worked in before.

  • Be part of a global team with opportunities for career development and growth.

If you are a dynamic and ambitious commercial professional who enjoys creating opportunities rather than waiting for them, and you have a passion for expanding into new sports markets while strengthening our presence in current ones, we would love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Hawk-Eye is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all
employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion,
age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an
environment where everyone can reach their full potential.
