jobs.title: Boat Builder - Assembly
jobs.description:
Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team?

Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels. Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation - the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not just operating in Stockholm, but now attracting orders from around the world.

Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, which results in cutting energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels.

And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel–free lakes and oceans.

You can be part of the amazing team in Candela now! We are looking for a Boat Builder to support Candela’s future growth ambitions.

Your core responsibilities will include:

    Working hands-on with boat assembly, including installation of mechanical and electrical components, mounting hardware, and final outfitting
    Assembling systems such as interiors, deck equipment, and structural components according to drawings and instructions

    Performing adjustments and ensuring proper fit and alignment of assembled parts

    Using hand tools and power tools safely and efficiently during assembly operations

    Inspecting assembled components to ensure they meet quality standards and specifications

    Maintaining tools, equipment, and a clean work environment

    Documenting work according to company procedures

    Following safety rules and using provided personal protective equipment (PPE)

    Working in an international environment – our corporate language is English (including production)

What are we looking for?

You are a practical and detail-oriented person who enjoys working hands-on and building high-quality products. You have experience using tools and assembling mechanical or technical components. You thrive in a production environment with a fast pace and high standards, and you take pride in delivering quality work. You are eager to learn, adaptable, and enjoy being part of a collaborative and diverse team. You are also comfortable working in a workshop environment and using PPE as required.

Requirements:

    Ability to communicate in English in your daily work

    Experience working safely with hand tools and power tools

    Ability to read and work according to technical drawings and instructions

    Attention to detail and strong focus on quality

    Good physical condition and ability to work hands-on, including standing for extended periods and working in tight spaces

    Willingness to work in a production environment and follow safety procedures

Meritorious (nice to have):

    Experience from assembly work in production or workshop environments

    Experience from the marine or automotive industry

    Experience with installation of mechanical or electrical systems

Form of employment: Full-time with initial 6 month probation period

Start date: ASAP

Location/base: Rotebro

Team: Hull Assembly

Reporting to: Hull Assembly Production Area Manager

Why people love working at Candela?

At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels - we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges, and seeing the results in action - sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers! We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness. That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun - whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes, or cheering each other on during Candela Months, our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events.

We’re office-first but not office-only. We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person - but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated, and the ride is just as important as the destination.

Recruitment process:

We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well. Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR so please use our career website for you application.

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

jobs.title: Chaufførafløser - STARK Næstved
jobs.description:
Vil du sikre effektiv varelevering og være del af et professionelt fællesskab, der bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres? STARK Næstved søger en engageret Chauffør-afløser til at forme vores fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.

 

Din rolle som Chauffør

Du bliver en del af lager- og logistikken i STARK Næstved, hvor vi er 18 dedikerede medarbejdere, som målrettet arbejder med distribution og håndtering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, virksomheder og private. Som en del af lager- og logistikteamet hos STARK Næstved vil du:

  • Levere varer med STARK lastvogn med kran (8-25 TM), herunder læsse og aflæsse med truck. Dette medfører at du har kørekort til lastbil (C), krancertifikat (D), truckcertifikat og EU-kvalifikationsbevis.

  • Sikre god service ved levering til både store byggeprojekter og private kunder.

  • Repræsentere STARK i lokalområdet.

  • Overholde sikkerhedsstandarder og kvalitetskrav.

  • Samarbejde tæt med kollegaer for optimal planlægning og rettidig levering.

Vores nye Chauffør

Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som Chauffør er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde

  • Er dygtig til at organisere og planlægge og kan møde kunderne med en positiv og venlig tilgang.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært. Selvom erfaring med distributionskørsel og branchekendskab kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med transport, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest eller senest d. 1. Oktober 2026.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Næstved via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Næstved som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef René Boss Selliah på telefon +45 2892 0788.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

 

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

jobs.title: Barnevernskonsulent
jobs.description:
Vi søker erfaren og engasjert barnevernkonsulent til 100% fast stilling. 

Vil du gjøre en forskjell i barns liv – og jobbe i et lite, faglig sterkt miljø der du virkelig blir sett? 

 
Skiptvet kommune ligger sentralt plassert i Østfold og har om lag 3 900 innbyggere. Skiptvet ligger kun 15 min unna Askim, 25 minutter unna Sarpsborg og 30 minutter unna Fredrikstad. Vi er en oversiktlig kommune med korte beslutningsveier og et godt tverrfaglig samarbeid. Her er det rom for å være både fagperson og menneske – og du blir ikke en i mengden. 

Barnevernstjenesten i Skiptvet kommune har ledig en 100% fast stilling.  Vi søker en trygg, erfaren og faglig stødig barnevernskonsulent som har erfaring fra førstelinjetjenesten og ønsker å bidra med sin kompetanse og sitt engasjement. 

Om oss 

Barnevernstjenesten i Skiptvet kommune er organisert etter generalistmodellen. Det innebærer at alle saksbehandlere arbeider med hele saksløpet – fra undersøkelser til tiltak og fosterhjemsoppfølging, og vi utfører det meste av tiltaksarbeidet selv. Dette gir en variert arbeidshverdag og mulighet til å følge familiene tett over tid. Vi tror at trygge relasjoner er selve nøkkelen til endring og utvikling, og vi søker deg som har høy relasjonskompetanse og et sterkt engasjement for barnets beste. Arbeidstid er i utgangspunktet kl. 08:00–15:00 i sommerhalvåret og kl. 08:00–15:45 i vinterhalvåret. Vi har fleksitidsordning, og noe ettermiddagsarbeid må påregnes ved behov. 

Arbeidsoppgaver 

  • Mottak og vurdering av bekymringsmeldinger 

  • Gjennomføring av undersøkelser 

  • Oppfølging av hjelpetiltak i hjemmet 

  • Oppfølging av barn plassert utenfor hjemmet, herunder fosterhjem og ettervern 

  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med interne og eksterne aktører 

  • Saksbehandling etter barnevernsloven 

  • Bistand i rettsprosesser ved behov 

 

Kvalifikasjoner 

  • 3-årig barnevernsfaglig høyskoleutdanning (barnevernspedagog/sosionom), eventuelt annen relevant helse- eller sosialfaglig utdanning 

  • Erfaring fra førstelinjetjenesten i barnevernet er et krav 

  • Erfaring med Modulus er ønskelig

  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk 

  • Førerkort klasse B og disponere egen bil 

  • God forståelse for barnevernsloven, forvaltningsloven og tverrfaglig samarbeid 

 

Personlige egenskaper 

  • Du er faglig trygg, strukturert og har evne til å arbeide både selvstendig og i team 

  • Du møter barn og foreldre med respekt, tydelighet og relasjonskompetanse 

  • Du har høy arbeidskapasitet og er løsningsorientert 

  • Du har et stort engasjement for barn og unges oppvekstvilkår 

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt 

 

Vi tilbyr 

  • En meningsfull jobb i en kommune som tar barnevern på alvor 

  • Et nært og inkluderende fagmiljø med høy kompetanse 

  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling gjennom SmartBarnevern-samarbeidet 

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger (KLP) 

  • Gratis parkering og ladestasjon for elbil 

  • Lønn etter avtale – med mulighet for mastertillegg dersom relevant 

  • Kompetansetillegg for relevant videreutdanning med studiepoeng

 

Søknadsfrist:  06.09.2026
Tiltredelse: Etter avtale 

Politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse. Søknad sendes elektronisk via våre nettsider. Vitnemål og attester tas med til eventuelt intervju. 

Mangfold og offentlighet

Skiptvet kommune ønsker at ansatte skal representere mangfoldet i befolkningen, og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne og kulturell bakgrunn. Etter søknadsfristens utløp vil det bli utarbeidet offentlig søkerliste i tråd med offentlighetsloven. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn dersom søkeren har vesentlig grunn til det. Dersom anmodning om unntak ikke tas til følge, vil søkeren bli varslet. 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skiptvet kommune er en landbrukskommune med sentral beliggenhet i Østfold, mellom E6 og E18 og nærmeste jernbanestasjon ti minutter unna. Dette gjør avstanden til alle byene i Østfold kort, og under en time til Oslo. Kommunen har om lag 3900 innbyggere. I tillegg til landbruk er de fleste arbeidsplassene knyttet til kommunal virksomhet. Skiptvet kommune er en kraftkommune og har ikke eiendomsskatt. Skiptvet har et sentrum, Meieribyen, en kirke, og to skoler. kommunen har full barnehagedekning med i alt tre barnehager. Skolen er tredelt, der Vestgård skole er for 1-4. trinn og Kirkelund skole har mellomtrinn 5.-7., og ungdomstrinn 8. til 10. Kommunen er den største arbeidsgiveren med om lag 350 medarbeidere i hel- og deltidsstillinger. Kommunen yter tjenester i direkte kontakt med kommunens innbyggere, og i samarbeid med en stor og aktiv frivillig sektor. Kommunen har 400 hytter, de fleste med fin beliggenhet ved Glomma. Skiptvet kommune har en fantastisk natur med rike muligheter til fritids- og friluftsaktiviteter.

jobs.title: Director, Projects, Marine

Are you an experienced engineering professional with a passion for leading people and delivering high-quality project execution? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership and close collaboration with sales and clients? Would you like to be part of a global engineering and consulting organization, working across international teams and projects to deliver solutions for the marine industry?

Your role and the team

The team also supports project sales and business development.

As the Marine PMO, you will be working closely with the Elomatic Group PMO to ensure our project management processes are aligned and further developed according to business needs. You'll also work closely with sales to provide engineering and technology support, contribute to proposals, and strengthen client relationships. Additionally, you play a key role in ensuring effective collaboration between internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle, from initial sales activities to successful project delivery.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

jobs.title: Postdoctor in Botany
jobs.description:
Subject area

Botany (Plant Science)

Subject area description

The postdoctor will work on a Swedish Science Council-funded project using a comprehensive phylogenetic tree of southern African (SA) Asteraceae to evaluate the roles of long-distance dispersal, biome shifts, and environmental change as stimuli of taxonomic and phenotypic diversification. Having undergone a major evolutionary radiation in SA to yield a regional flora comprising ca. 2500 species which has occupied all available environments, from deserts to the alpine zone, Asteraceae offers an ideal system for studying the dynamics of diversification in a continental context. In addition, the physiographic and vegetation diversity of contemporary SA, and a Miocene-Pliocene history involving tectonism and climate change, provide the opportunity to test the agency of contemporary and historical factors as drivers of evolutionary diversification.

In addition to the above, the postdoctor will be required to develop an independent research project that makes use of GBG’s living collections and/or contributes to GBG’s conservation agenda. This project may be systematic, address questions relating to trait evolution and/or geographical distribution, or have an explicit conservation focus (e.g., relating to threat assessment and ex situ conservation practices).

There is a possibility to participate in international plant collecting trips.

The research will be supervised by Prof G Anthony Verboom (University of Gothenburg and GBG), Dr Nicola Bergh (GBG), and Dr Félix Forest (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew). The postdoctor will also work closely with a PhD student whose research examines the diversification consequences of intercontinental long-distance dispersal.

Duties

    Conduct primary research leading to the publication of at least three papers, two relating to the diversification of SA Asteraceae and one relating to the GBG-based project (see above). Analytical methodologies potentially include bioinformatic processing of sequence data, phylogenomic analysis, GIS-based spatial analysis, and comparative macroevolutionary analysis.
    Attend local and/or international conferences for the purpose of presenting research findings and contribute to fundraising to support such travels.
    Deliver seminars and participate in journal clubs and other academic fora at BioEnv and GBG.
    Potentially contribute to teaching in BioEnv, up to 10% of full-time employment.
    Organize and run a limited number of training events for GBG scientific and curatorial staff, such as a series of short introductory R workshops (including Rstudio, ggplot, and tidyverse).

Eligibility

The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.

To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.

In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.  

Assessment criteria

The suitability of applicants will be assessed based on (i) documentary evidence submitted at the time of application, (ii) a short oral presentation given at the time of interview, and (iii) response to interview questions. A subset of applicants will be invited for interview.

Required qualifications for employment:

    PhD in evolutionary biology or systematics.
    Experience of data management and statistical analysis in R.
    Working knowledge of phylogenetic inference and comparative macroevolutionary analysis
    Ability to work well both independently and as part of a group.
    Organizational skills and ability to co-lead and coordinate a large project which involves processing and analysis of large amounts of data.
    Interest in field work.
    Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications for employment:

    Advanced knowledge of plant taxonomy, systematics, and evolution.
    Experience of processing and analyzing high-throughput genomic data, spatial data (e.g., SDM), and/or big data (i.e., on an HPC cluster).
    Experience of working in a team.
    Willingness to mentor undergraduate students.
    Driver’s license.

Personal qualifications:

Given the expectation of independent research development, we require someone who is independent and self-motivated. Since the postdoctor will be expected to collaborate closely with a PhD student and colleagues at both BioEnv and GBG, we are also looking for someone who is collegial, a good communicator, and capable of working as part of a team.

The most qualified candidates, in relation to the assessment criteria in the advertisement, are invited for an interview.

Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.

Employment

The employment is temporary, lasting two years, 100% full-time, placed at the Department of Biological and Environmental Science. Starting date 11 January 2027 or, by agreement, as soon as possible thereafter.



Application

Read the full ad and submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline.  



Applications must be received by: 2026-09-14

jobs.title: Försäljingsförhandlare
jobs.description:
Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är ett inhemskt vitamin försäljningshus. Vi säljer hälsoprodukter som möjliggör en hälsosammare och bättre livsstil. Vi rekryterar nu nya heltids arbetare till vårt försäljningsteam.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är en del av HL-Family Oy. HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hyvinvointitukku.fi/rekrytointi/.

jobs.title: Meeting & Events Staff - Extra help
jobs.description:
Are you a service star who loves to be where the action is?

We are looking for a Conference Staff Member to join our team at The Edge Hotel in Tromsø. You are the go-to person who ensures our guests have a flawless experience from the first cup of coffee to the final presentation.

What you'll do:

As a Conference Staff member, you are the face of our meeting rooms and represent the Meeting & Events department in all their activities, meetings and events. 

Your day will include:

  • Welcoming guests and making them feel at home with all the info they need, verified.
  • Prepping the rooms – making sure furniture, snacks, and technology are 100% ready.
  • Technical support – helping guests connect their devices to our systems and making sure the Wi-Fi, projectors, webcams and microphones work properly.
  • Event flow – Have a problem solving mindset, being on hand to solve problems quickly so the meetings never stop and customers gain confidence and trust in our abilities.
  • Coordination – working with all other hotel teams to keep everything on schedule.
  • Mental work – Multi tasking, taking responsibility and servicing multiple meetings at the same time is part of our daily challenges. This position will benefit high performance staff that are always looking for something to do. 
  • Physical work – Moving furniture, desks, tables, chairs & various equipment. Our rooms are very flexible on setups and each meeting or conference have their own agenda. So we need to setup the furniture accordingly. We are also responsible for receiving all hotel deliveries.  

This is a temporary position for an Extra help contract with a start date to be agreed upon. The position requires working varied shifts, including evenings and weekends.

You’ll shine here if you are:

  • A "people person" who stays calm, happy and smiling even when it’s busy and stress levels are high.
  • Comfortable with tech and not afraid to plug in cables or restart a router or troubleshoot a guest PC.
  • Fluent in English, (Norwegian is beneficial) to communicate clearly with all our guests, local and international.
  • Detail-oriented – you notice if a chair is crooked or a water bottle is empty before the guest does.
  • High work rate and self sufficient.
  • A person that loves to exceed at work for their team.

Bonus points for: 

  • Experience in events, hotels, or restaurants.
  • A background in tech or AV support.

We value the power of diversity within Strawberry. Different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas create a unique and inspiring work environment.

What we offer:

  • An exciting and varied work environment with a fast pace.
  • The right tools and support to flourish both professionally and personally.
  • Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels.
  • Four free hotel nights each year (remove if it’s not a position with a fixed contracts for at least 12 months of 20% or higher).
  • 25% discount on food & beverages at all our restaurants & bars.
  • Sweet deals on experiences, travels, retail and lots more!
  • Experience at the busiest conference center in the Northern part of Norway.

About us

We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 166 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.

Ready to start an exciting journey with Strawberry? 

Apply today and be part of creating unforgettable experiences! Applications are reviewed continuously, and positions may be filled before the deadline. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

Note (This position does not include accommodation)

Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:



Är du en person som uppskattar en varierad arbetsdag och har erfarenhet av CNC‑maskinbearbetning? Är du serviceinriktad, nyfiken och tycker om att utvecklas tillsammans med andra? Då kan du vara den vi söker till Verkstadssupport inom Support Prototype and Production.

Detta är en dagtidstjänst och en visstidsanställning på cirka 12 månader, med stora möjligheter till förlängning.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt uppdragSom medarbetare inom Verkstadssupport Teknik har du en viktig roll i att supporta produktionen, R&D och övriga verksamheter med tillverkning av alla slags detaljer. Du arbetar med att säkerställa att tillverkning av detaljer sker enligt ritning, instruktion och standard. I rollen ingår framförallt att skära fram detaljer i CNC styrd vattenjet, bockning och materialhantering i verksamheten. Du blir en del av ett team där vi samarbetar, delar kunskap och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet.



PlaceringsortTjänsten är placerad i Örebro.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 30 augusti 2026. Välkommen med din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem.

För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef eller rekryterare: Kristina Kanestad, Manager Support Prototyp & Production, kristina.kanestad@epiroc.comMaria Tedsjö, Recruitment Specialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com  

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:

•    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som trivs med variation i arbetet och som gillar att samarbeta med andra. Du är serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Du är nyfiken och har en vilja att utvecklas, både i din roll och tillsammans med verksamheten. Du tycker om att ta initiativ, driva arbetet framåt och bidra till förbättringar i verksamheten. Vidare arbetar du strukturerat och har en god förmåga att prioritera i en vardag där tempot kan variera.



Vi ser att du har en gymnasieutbildning, gärna med teknisk inriktning, samt erfarenhet från liknande arbetsuppgifter. Det är meriterande om du har generell verkstadsvana, så som erfarenhet av svarvning, fräsning eller borrning. Vi ser gärna att du har ett teknikintresse. B-körkort krävs för tjänsten.

Er dette aktuelt for deg? Send søknad eller ta kontakt på e-post: markus@personellgruppen.no

 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Fagbrev som betongarbeider er en fordel, men lang erfaring kan kompensere for manglende fagbrev
  • Erfaring fra arbeid i Norge er en stor fordel

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og forståelse av norsk og/eller engelsk

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med hyggelige kolleger

  • Hjelp til å skaffe bolig ved behov

Personellgruppen ansetter kontinuerlig kandidater til flere typer stillinger og prosjekter over hele landet. Dersom du har erfaring fra tekniske fag eller prosjektarbeid, oppfordrer vi deg til å ta kontakt.

 

 

_____________________________

 

We are hiring Concrete Workers for projects across Norway

 

We are looking for skilled concrete workers for projects with immediate start. The work will take place on projects in different locations across Norway.

Interested? Send your application or contact us by email: markus@personellgruppen.no

 

Desired qualifications:

  • Trade certificate as a concrete worker is an advantage, but long experience can compensate for lack of formal certification
  • Experience working in Norway is a strong advantage
  • Experience with formwork, reinforcement, and concrete casting
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently
  • Good communication skills and understanding of Norwegian and/or English

We offer:

  • A good working environment with friendly colleagues
  • Projects with good possibilities for extension
  • Competitive conditions, insurance, and pension scheme
  • Assistance with accommodation if needed

Apply as soon as possible – hiring takes place on an ongoing basis.

 

Personellgruppen continuously recruits candidates for several types of positions and projects across Norway. If you have experience in technical trades or project-based work, we encourage you to get in touch.

jobs.title: Finance and Business Development Specialist with Focus on China
jobs.employer: BRÖDERNA HANSSONS I GÖTEBORG EXPORT AKTIEBOLAG
jobs.description:
About the Job

Hanssons is a seafood trading company based in Gothenburg, Sweden. Following its acquisition by Bohai Aquatic Products, a company based in Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, Hanssons is entering a new stage of development with increased focus on international cooperation, financing and business development between Sweden and China.

We are now looking for a Finance and Business Development Specialist to support the company’s work with cross-border financing, group coordination and business development. The role involves close cooperation with both Hanssons in Sweden and the parent company in China.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

    Support the company in identifying and preparing financing opportunities through Chinese banks and financial institutions.

    Help strengthen communication and cooperation between the parent company and the Swedish subsidiary.

    Support the parent company’s understanding of Hanssons’ operations, market position, financial situation and business needs.

    Assist Hanssons with group reporting, budget follow-up, cash flow analysis and financial planning.

    Develop and evaluate financing solutions for Hanssons’ planned new facility construction through Chinese banks and financial institutions.







Qualifications

We are looking for a candidate who has:

    A master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, international business or another relevant field.

    Experience in auditing, financial analysis, accounting, controlling, corporate finance, banking communication, international trade or business development.

    Good understanding of financial statements, budgeting, cash flow and corporate finance.
    Experience working with Chinese companies, Chinese banks or China-related business processes.

    Very good knowledge of Mandarin Chinese and English, both spoken and written.

    The ability to work independently and coordinate communication between parties in different countries and time zones.

Knowledge of Swedish is meritorious but not required. Experience from the seafood industry, food trading, import/export or international trading business is also meritorious.

Personal Qualities

As a person, you are structured, responsible and analytical. You have strong communication skills and enjoy working in an international environment where cooperation with people from different business cultures is required. You are detail-oriented, commercially minded and able to handle both financial and business-related matters in a professional way.

Great importance will be placed on personal suitability.

We Offer

We offer a key role in an international company with strong business links between Sweden and China. The position provides an opportunity to work closely with company management and contribute to the company’s continued development in financing, group coordination and international business development.

jobs.title: Sustainability Engineer
jobs.description:
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.



In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.



As a Sustainability Engineer, you will join our Manufacturing team and play an important role in strengthening our environment, health and safety practices at factory level. You will help build a safer, more sustainable workplace by supporting systems, programs, and behaviors that protect people, reduce risks, and enable long-term business performance.



Impact You’ll Own

    Drive a strong safety and sustainability culture that supports our ambition of zero incidents.
    Improve environmental, health, and safety performance by identifying risks, strengthening compliance, and implementing continuous improvements.
    Enable informed decision-making through effective deployment of sustainability systems, employee training, and reliable performance reporting.



What You’ll Do

    Develop and deploy environment, occupational health and safety systems, programs and procedures.
    Advise and coach managers and supervisors on sustainability practices and safe behaviors.
    Identify workplace risks and support actions to eliminate or reduce hazards.
    Plan and execute inspections, audits, risk assessments and emergency preparedness activities.
    Support sustainability projects and propose solutions to improve performance.
    Maintain training records for employees, contractors, and visitors.
    Report sustainability performance indicators accurately and on time to relevant stakeholders.



Skills & Capabilities

Must-haves

    Relevant education in the environment, working environment, safety, chemistry, engineering or similar
    2-3 years of experience in environment, occupational health and safety within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English is a requirement for this position.
    Good knowledge of environment, occupational health and safety legal requirements and practical risk assessment.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigation skills.
    Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
    Experience working with audits, inspections, incident investigations, or corrective actions.
    Ability to coach, influence and support stakeholders at different levels.



Nice-to-haves

    Knowledge of ISO standards such as ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and / or ISO 50001.
    Project management experience or relevant local EHS certifications.



Rewards & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive rewards package including collective barging agreement, health insurance, occupational pension, 30 vacation days a year, ATK, a generous sport allowance and beneficial parental leave to name a few.



You will also have the opportunity to grow your career in a global organization, contribute to meaningful transformation, and be part of a team working towards a smoke-free future.



Application Process

To join our growing team, apply until the 6th of September. Submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated confidentially and screened on the on-going basis. Relocation support is not offered for this role.



The recruitment process consists of phone screening, online assessments, and at least two interview stages. Interviews with candidates are planned to take place from the end of August and early September.



Equal Opportunities Statement

We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.



We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know. We’re here to help you succeed.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
jobs.description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Digital Product Designer - Design System

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Digital Product Designer in the Design System team, you’ll play a key role in evolving and scaling H&M’s customer-facing design system across app and web. You will help create a cohesive visual language that strengthens H&M brand expression while enabling product teams to deliver high-quality experiences efficiently and consistently.

This is a role for someone with exceptional UI craft and strong systems thinking. You understand that great design systems are more than components and documentation — they are the foundation that brings coherence, quality and brand differentiation across every digital touchpoint.

You’ll work at the intersection of brand, design and technology, translating design principles and brand identity into scalable foundations, tokens, components and guidelines that work seamlessly across iOS, Android and web. You have a sharp eye for visual detail, understand what elevates a digital experience and can balance aesthetic excellence with platform-specific best practices.

You will:

    Drive the evolution of H&M’s design system foundations, visual language and component library across app and web.
    Translate brand identity into scalable design foundations, guidelines and reusable patterns.
    Create alignment and visual coherence across iOS, Android and web while respecting platform-specific conventions.
    Define and refine design tokens, typography systems, spacing systems, colour systems and interaction principles.
    Partner closely with designers, engineers and product teams to ensure consistent implementation and adoption.
    Provide guidance and direction on visual quality, UI patterns and brand alignment across product teams.
    Champion accessibility best practices and ensure inclusive design is embedded into system foundations.
    Facilitate design reviews, workshops and discussions that drive alignment across a large product organisation.
    Stay up to date with emerging design, fashion, digital and consumer experience trends and identify opportunities to evolve the design system.
    Contribute to design system governance, documentation and community engagement across the organisation.

The role is based in Stockholm, with an expectation of being onsite at least 4 days per week.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will join the Digital Product Design organisation at H&M and become part of the Fabric Design System Product team.  

You’ll work closely with experience designers, design leads, engineers and product teams across app and web. You will collaborate with colleagues in Design, Product, Engineering and Brand to ensure H&M delivers a consistent, high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints.

You will also act as a trusted expert and partner to the wider design community, helping teams make informed decisions about visual design, interaction patterns and brand expression.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

    Extensive experience designing and evolving design systems for large-scale digital products.
    Exceptional UI and visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating attention to detail and design craft.
    Deep understanding of cross-platform design across iOS, Android and web and their native patterns.
    Strong experience translating brand principles and visual identities into scalable digital systems.
    Expertise in typography, colour, spacing, layout and visual hierarchy.
    Experience defining and implementing design tokens and system foundations.
    Strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive design practices, including WCAG guidelines.
    Experience collaborating closely with engineers and understanding the realities of implementation.
    Experience influencing and aligning multiple stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
    Proven experience working with Figma and modern design system tooling.

Extra consideration will be given to candidates who have:

In this role, you will support the development of vehicle programs throughout key milestones. As a Program Controller, you will work closely with the Program Manager and provide support on all financial topics to help steer programs efficiently and effectively.

The role focuses on controlling program investments as well as monitoring the profitability of vehicle programs throughout their full lifecycle. jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ruovesi
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: AIFM Risk Management, Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
AIFM Risk Management, Manager

Department: Funds

Company Description

ABOUT IQ-EQ

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 5,800+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.      
                                                                              
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

As a Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and enhancing the risk management framework for alternative investment funds managed by the AIFM. You will support the Head of Risk Management in leading the risk management team, ensuring robust risk governance, and acting as a key point of contact for senior management, clients, and governing bodies on risk management matters. You will be responsible for the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of all material risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the firm's risk appetite.

You will:

• Serve as the back-up for the Head of Risk Management, taking over key responsibilities when needed and ensuring continuity of leadership.
• Support the Head of Risk Management in daily team management, including coordination, task allocation, and staff development.
• Support the implementation, maintenance, and regular update of the Risk Management Procedure (RMP), policies, procedures, registers, and framework.
• Assist in identifying applicable risk types, proposing measurement methodologies and limits.
• Support the development, monitoring, and updating of risk profiles for all AIFs under management, ensuring alignment with investment strategies and regulatory standards.
• Assist the team in performing pre-trade investment compliance controls.
• Monitor and regularly review the adequacy of risk indicators.
• Prepare and review quarterly risk management reports for the AIFs. Report material risk issues, breaches, and emerging risks to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies, and ensure appropriate remediation actions are taken.
• Collaborate with the onboarding team to assess risks of new products and projects, ensuring business growth aligns with the firm's risk appetite.
• Contribute to the preparation of annual CSSF Risk Management reports and Annex IV (AIFMD) reporting.
• Advise internal and external stakeholders on complex risk management matters and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds.
• Lead the analysis of new regulations and assess their impact on risk management activities for both funds and the company.

What we offer

• Comprehensive remuneration and pension: motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Wellbeing: additional social benefits
• Flexible working: we recognise the value of working flexibly and want to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.

Qualifications

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in risk management within the asset management or fund industry
• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg AIFM regulatory environment, including SFDR, and alternative investment strategies.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an asset.
• In-depth knowledge of Annex IV Reporting is highly desirable.
• Advanced IT skills (e.g., VBA, SQL, Python) are a plus.

Additional information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.  

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to oury people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,800+ employees - from 94 nationalities, acrosfyts 25 countries - to each achieve their potential.  
Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

The manager acts as a hands-on a technical expert within the Core Team Accounting contributing to high-quality client delivery achieves impact through technical oversight, review, guidance and knowledge transfer.

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis) & Responsibilities

- Act as a technical reviewer for accounting deliverables prepared by team members and GCD, including:

• Bookkeeping
• Annual financial statements
• Management and regulatory reporting
• BCL reports
• CIT and VAT returns and related tax calculations

- Ensure that work delivered complies with:

• Applicable accounting standards (BeGAAP, Lux GAAP; IFRS / US GAAP where relevant)

• Regulatory and client‑specific requirements

- Identify technical risks, inconsistencies, or errors and ensure appropriate remediation.

- Manage a portfolio of clients (primarily SPVs and alternative investment funds located both in Belgium and in Luxembourg), acting as the technical reference for accounting matters.

• On‑the‑job guidance

• Written guidance, checklists, or technical notes

- Maintain professional relationships with external service providers, including auditors, tax advisers, law firms, and banks.

- Verify adherence to internal procedures and participate in process reviews.

• Ability to review, challenge, and validate accounting work

• Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively across teams

• Collaborative and approachable, acting as a technical partner

Requirements

• Computer/program knowledge: Microsoft office, Demasy

Languages: Native French or Dutch, Fluent in English and French/Dutch, any other language would be an advantage

We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. jobs.title: Business Manager - Finance (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

About the SnT:

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

We offer an attractive position for a full stack software engineer to work in close cooperation with our research teams, particularly within the Computer Vision, Machine Intelligence and Imaging (CVI2) research group headed by Prof. Djamila Aouada. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and real-world software engineering, turning complex research outcomes into impactful applications.

Your role:

This is a Full Stack Engineer role with a rich and varied technology stack. You will work across the full application layer, from building interactive browser-based 3D interfaces to designing robust backend services and APIs, while integrating AI capabilities through modern LLM frameworks and SDKs. The role sits at the intersection of applied AI engineering and real-time 3D visualization, leveraging technologies such as Three.js, WebGL, and LLM orchestration frameworks to build intelligent, geometry-aware applications. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to applied AI research while working with a modern, diverse set of technologies at the forefront of the field.

The position holder will be required to perform the following tasks:

• Build browser-based 3D visualization experiences using libraries such as Three.js and WebGL to render and interact with complex geometric data
• Design intuitive, user-facing interfaces that effectively communicate research concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from early-stage prototyping through to deployment and maintenance
• Engage with industrial partners to understand their requirements and help translate research into practical, deployable solutions

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• Experience with Three.js and WebGL, including scene management, geometry interaction, camera controls, and rendering optimization for complex 3D models
• Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, e.g. Lang Chain, LlamaIndex, and LLM APIs, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, including context engineering and API integration for building production-grade AI-powered features
• Experience with Python and at least one server-side web framework such as Flask or FastAPI, including building and maintaining REST APIs
• Comfortable with modern DevOps practices including Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
• Nice to have: Familiarity with CAD Kernels like Open CASCADE, or experience with 3D modelling, CAD design software, or 3D printing workflows

The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

Your Role...
The holder of the position will be a member of the Department of Education and Social Work within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
She/he is expected to:
• Develop and maintain research activities — with national embedding and of (inter)national relevance — explicitly focusing on school management and school development in fundamental education (e.g. pedagogical leadership, organisational management and change management, implementation of educational policies on the ground, quality development and assurance, communication and collaboration, professional competencies and continuing professional development, data and assessment literacy), possibly including the leveraging of digital opportunities (e.g., collaborative technologies), thus identifying and (further) developing best practices that can feed back into both teacher training and the school system;
• Exercise leadership internally and externally both in their field of knowledge and, as a leading educationist, apply their general knowledge and skills as a researcher and scholar;
• Develop and sustain the scale and quality of teaching and learning in the full range of the Faculty's study programmes in Education;
• Undertake tutoring and internship supervision of BScE and BFP students, and engage with national education actors and stakeholders;
• Undertake doctoral and post-doctoral supervision and mentoring, further contributing to the development of doctoral education and training; and
• Undertake leadership roles that ensure that the Faculty further strengthens its position as a leading European multicultural and multilingual site of research and teaching in the field of educational and social sciences.

Teaching areas
The holder will mainly be teaching in the Bachelor en Sciences de l'Education, the new Bachelor en Formation Pédagogique and the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).
The holder will also lead the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).

What we expect from you…
• PhD in educational sciences or a closely related field (a multi/interdisciplinary research profile is particularly welcome);
• A minimum of five years of postdoctoral experience acquired in a university or comparable research centre (teaching and/or school management and development experience in a fundamental education setting is an advantage);
• An outstanding research record in educational and social sciences;
• International research and teaching experience (teaching experience in basic training and/or specialisation programmes for fundamental school teachers is an advantage);
• Proven ability to acquire research funds and conduct cross-national research projects;
• Knowledge of and familiarity with Luxembourg's multilingual educational system and its actors is considered an advantage;
• Willingness to engage in teamwork in teaching and research groups; and
• Ability to work autonomously.
Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

In Short...
• Contract type: CDI - this position is offered at the Full Professor or Associate Professor level, depending on qualification. Both levels are tenured. At the Associate Professor level, a possibility of promotion will be given after 5 years upon positive evaluation
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week

Please send your application to Prof. Dr. Robert Harmsen (Dean of the Faculty) and submit your documents via the “Apply for job” button below within timeline established including:

The Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM) belongs to the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. We combine basic and translational, biomolecular and computational research to address critical questions in human health and disease with a main focus on cancer biology. We investigate mechanisms that govern tumor initiation, migration and invasion, metastasis, cell cycle control, the tumor microenvironment and drug resistance by using a combination of experimental in vitro, in vivo and in silico approaches. Next to its research mission, DLSM is coordinating all teaching programs in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing and Allied Health Professions.
Health and Medicine are a strategic priority of the University of Luxembourg and are presently in an ambitious phase of development. This strategic expansion requires additional expertise in teaching pharmacology across various fields, including Medicine, Life sciences, Nursing, and Allied Health Professions.

Expertise in computational approaches - such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, or other data-driven methodologies - will be an asset.
