This position will contribute to the development of digital and face-to-face methods for public involvement, by shaping the theories, methodologies, and tools that underpin participatory knowledge production in human services. Active in research, innovation and teaching, the position holder will, in particular:

• Analyse and develop innovative approaches to service user engagement, public outreach, and multi-stakeholder dialogue focusing on unequal power relations and conﬂicting interests. These approaches should combine data-intensive digital tools with face-to-face interventions, enabling exchanges between human service providers and hard-to-reach populations. Examples include collaborative digital platforms, co-creative living labs, interactive exhibitions, and multisensorial participatory interventions
• Organize participatory events and lead the development of the department's outreach initiative ALICES (Agora Luxembourgeoise partICipative de l'intErvention Sociale) - a living lab launched in 2023 that engages with Luxembourg's human services sector
• Design and theorise participatory interventions and public outreach within the context of human services as well as in empirical research methods
• Teach conceptual and methodological courses in the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives (BSSE), playing a key a key role in its ongoing development and expansion. The postholder will also have the opportunity to contribute to the construction of a projected new Master's programme and to teach within the doctoral and lifelong learning programmes of the university

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Dr. Boris Traue, Director of the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives, Email: boris.traue@uni.lu

Your profile

• A doctorate in sociology, social work, education, anthropology or related ﬁelds
• A minimum of three years of postdoctoral experience acquired at a university or comparable research institution. Experience in participatory, qualitative, and digital research methodologies is essential
• Documented experience in at least two thematic areas among: digital and face-to-face user involvement; engagement of underserved or marginalised publics; and academic outreach and knowledge dissemination strategies
• An international research proﬁle demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications
• Ability to develop conceptual frameworks that integrate both face-to-face and digital participatory interventions. Experience in user-centred digital technologies and visual or multi-sensorial strategies for reaching vulnerable publics is desirable
• Involvement in outreach initiatives
• Experience in the acquisition of external research project funding, conference participation, and collaboration in national and international research and/or policy initiatives
• University-level teaching experience at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels should be documented

Language requirements

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual context. The person hired on this position must be proﬁcient in English and French. Additional knowledge of German is advantageous. The University encourages its staﬀ to learn German (and other languages) and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A modern and dynamic university with a personal atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment and skilled support staff. High-quality equipment. Close ties to the business world and to the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban site with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and with numerous non-academic partners such as ministries, local governments, associations, NGOs, …
• Competitive salary and benefits packages. Very good opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and work-life balance

How to apply

Applications should be submitted online only and contain:

• Cover letter
• Detailed CV, including periods of absence from work (or where the eﬀect has been equivalent to absence) including family-related leave and career breaks
• Complete list of publications and copies of 3 recent publications relevant for the ﬁeld of the position
• Copies of diplomas
• List and short description of external research funding acquired over the past 5 (ﬁve) years
• List of PhD theses supervised
• List of teaching activities over the past 5 (ﬁve) years, including courses taught
• Statement of research, teaching and other activities planned at the University of Luxembourg
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment on the application.

Please indicate their relationship to you

Applications should be addressed to Prof. Dr. Robert Harmsen (Dean of the Faculty).
We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by 30th of November 2025. Applications will be handled in strict conﬁdence.

Gender equality:

The University of Luxembourg is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staﬀ and aims to eliminate obstacles to recruitment of female professors and their career development. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.
The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion and diversity as key values. We are fully committed to removing any discriminatory barrier related to gender, and not only, in recruitment and career progression of our staﬀ.

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:

You will join the Data Management Office (DMO) and play a key role in driving its implementation, governance and continuous development. • Leading or contributing to transformation projects impacting master datas, including requirements definition, testing, deployment, adoption and post-implementation follow-up;

• Multicultural, diverse teams encouraging collaborative work;

Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

All applications will be treated confidentially.

The position to be filled

adwäisEO is looking for an experienced AI & Data Technical lead to define and drive the technical strategy of its data team in support of innovative Earth Observation (EO) data valorization, and to carry out projects as project manager, expert, developer or operator in a small team of 3 people to be embedded in a larger team made of the grouping of sister companies' teams.

The role is centered around the survey, design, development, optimization and deployment of state-of-the-art machine learning/deep learning algorithms as well as the training & deployment of generative AI models (geo-VLM) to enhance current workflow on EO imagery processing & analysis.

The candidate will work on the development of deep learning and AI processes to support the generation of innovative new data derived information. The activities will include the development of advanced models and pipelines such as foundation model for EO data, Vision transformers and attention-based architecture for multimodal dataset and scalable workflows leveraging High-Performance Computing (HPC).

She/he will be contributing to:

    • Survey of and feedback on technological progress in the deep learning and machine learning technology evolution in the domain,
    • Design and development of deep learning algorithms for EO imagery and related datasets
    • Development of related documentation (Algorithm baseline, functional analysis)
    • Definition of data requirement for processing chain.
    • Writing engineering documentation and technical reports in English.
    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

Must Have Requirements

Profile

• 5-8 years of experience in AI and data science algorithm development (preferable for satellite Remote Sensing or imagery/video data).

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

• Experience with Deep Learning and/or simple Machine Learning techniques, attention- based architecture, foundation model (adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating and, where relevant, pre-training foundation models for Earth Observation data -Vision and Large Language models in particular);
• Proficiency in python with solid object-oriented programming practices and experience building modular, scalable pipelines;
• Strong hands-on proficiency in PyTorch; (familiarity with TensorFlow or other ML frameworks is an advantage);
• Hands-on experience with popular specialized libraries (rasterio, xarray, geopandas, terratorch);
• Familiarity with Linux environments;
• Knowledge of Rest API for querying EO data repositories (e.g. STAC), with expertise in creating, validating, and maintaining robust training datasets;
• Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning or deep learning models in production environments;
• Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized AI applications;
• Experience designing, developing and maintaining model inference APIs or services;
• Good understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, versioning and retraining;
• Hands-on experience with GPU-based training and/or inference, HPC/Slurm;
• Practical experience with at least one production computing environment, such as cloud platforms, Kubernetes-based infrastructures or HPC systems.

Behavior skills (Soft Skills)

• Analytical, critical and proactive mind;
• Very good task prioritization and organization: ability to allocate tasks and track progress;
• Very good technical mentoring (supporting and upskilling junior profiles);
• Very good communication skills: acting as the link between the technical team and management/other departments;
• Fluency in English (spoken and written) is essential;
• High degree of autonomy and decision-making;
• Versatility: comfortable operating at a hands-on capacity while coordinating the team's work.

Being considered as a plus:

• Knowledge of other programming or coding languages such as IDL, C, C++;
• Experience with physical modelling (e.g. hydraulic, hydrology, crop, …);
• MLOps Skills (Docker, microservices);
• Experience with HPC, distributed training, or GPU-accelerated computation;
• Knowledge of Satellite data processing;
• PostDoc in Remote Sensing or ML.

❖ Supplementary Health insurance,

jobs.description:
Smiler du med øjnene, har du sans for detaljer, og trives du i et miljø med tempo og faste tidsrammer?
Så er det måske dig, der er vores nye rengøringsassistent hos Toma Facility.

Arbejdsopgaver
Du bliver en del af et team, der sikrer høj rengøringsstandard i et område med mange daglige brugere. Dine opgaver vil omfatte rengøring af fællesområder, servicefaciliteter og personalerum.

Arbejdstid

7,5 timer ugentligt fredag og lørdag med mødetid kl. 21.30

Din profil

  • Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel

  • Du kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og detaljer

  • Du er serviceminded, fleksibel og trives i et travlt miljø

Kontakt Serviceleder Rizwan Bashir på mail: rizwan.bashir@toma-as.dk

Send din ansøgning med billede og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende inviterer kvalificerede ansøgere til samtale.

Ansøgning sendes til: job@toma-as.dk

jobs.title: IT/OT Infrastructure Team Lead
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating stability, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring critical technology environments support both business and manufacturing operations? This is your opportunity to take ownership of a critical IT/OT infrastructure landscape and make a broad impact across operations, technology strategy, and service delivery.

About the job

You lead the daily operations and execution of IT/OT infrastructure services, ensuring a secure, stable, and cost-effective environment that supports both business and manufacturing operations. Your focus is on operational leadership, technology governance, service delivery, and coordination. You report to the Manager, Security & Infrastructure.

Job responsibilities

    Lead and coordinate daily activities and priorities across the IT/OT Infrastructure team.
    Drive operational excellence, service delivery, and resolution of infrastructure-related issues.
    Own the IT/OT infrastructure portfolio, technology roadmap, and lifecycle planning activities.
    Manage suppliers, service providers, technology partners, contracts, and licensing agreements.
    Ensure compliance with infrastructure standards, security requirements, and governance obligations.
    Identify and drive opportunities for automation, standardization, optimization, and continuous improvement.

Location

This position is based in Sandviken.

Your profile

You bring a broad understanding of IT and OT infrastructure technologies, combined with the ability to build strong relationships across business functions, technology teams, and external partners. Comfortable navigating a complex environment, you balance operational priorities with commercial considerations and long-term objectives.

Your background includes

    Extensive experience in Infrastructure management & technologies.
    Strong understanding of infrastructure standards, security requirements, and compliance obligations.
    Proven track record in managing contracts, licensing, support agreements, and stakeholder management.
    Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformations and modernization initiatives across a global context.
    Experience in turning infrastructure challenges into opportunities through strategic optimization and cost-efficient innovation.

You're collaborative and communicative with stakeholder management skills, enabling you to build trust, align business and technology needs, and establish productive vendor partnerships. With a proactive mindset, you continuously look for ways to improve, standardize, and simplify operations while effectively managing priorities and delivering results.

Our culture

Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

Contact information

Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Tommy Påhls, hiring manager, at tommy.pahls@sandvik.com

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

Recruitment Specialist: Gustaf Sjögren

How to apply

Send your application no later than August 31, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0094502.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com

jobs.title: Architecte du bâtiment (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Architecte Responsable d'Agence capable d'allier expertise technique, pilotage de projets et esprit entrepreneurial.
Votre mission
Rattaché à la Direction Générale du groupe, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et opérationnelle de l'agence de Barcelone.
Vous intervenez sur les projets de l'esquisse jusqu'à la réalisation, tout en participant à la structuration de l'activité locale, à la coordination des équipes et au développement futur du pôle Barcelone.
Vos principales responsabilités
Expertise technique et suivi des projets
- Assurer la mise au point des projets de l'esquisse au DCE : plans, coupes, façades, carnets de détails ;
- Établir et superviser les pièces écrites et graphiques relatives aux dossiers administratifs : PC, PA, permis de démolir ;
- Produire et suivre les pièces graphiques relatives aux marchés de travaux ;
- Gérer, coordonner et synthétiser les éléments des différents intervenants : maîtrise d'ouvrage, services d'urbanisme, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle, partenaires techniques ;
- Analyser la faisabilité technique des projets et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Développement, coordination et management
- Participer à la structuration de l'agence de Barcelone et de ses méthodes de travail ;
- Contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration et au pilotage progressif des futures équipes ;
- Développer un réseau de partenaires et représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur ;
- Participer au développement de nouvelles activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives innovantes.
Profil recherché
- Formation Architecte ou équivalent ;
- Expérience confirmée en cabinet d'architecture, bureau d'études, ingénierie, construction ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation bâtiment : ERP, RT 2012, RE 2020, Code du Travail, ICPE, PMR, CDAC/CNAC ;
- Maîtrise des outils professionnels : Autocad, Revit, Photoshop, SketchUp, BIM ou équivalent ;
- Expérience en coordination de projets, pilotage d'activité ou management appréciée ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et capacité à structurer une activité locale ;
- Rigueur, réactivité, sens du relationnel et goût pour le travail en équipe ;
- Goût pour l'innovation constructive et les environnements internationaux.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compétence technique, nous recherchons une personne capable de s'investir durablement dans un projet ambitieux, avec l'envie de participer activement à la construction et au développement d'une organisation appelée à jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration :
- CDI ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des partenaires du groupe ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Kokenut huskyopas Pure Lapland / Wild Husky Rovaniemi Oylle
jobs.description:
**Kokenut huskyopas – tule mukaan Lapin talvikauteen!**

Onko sinulla kokemusta huskyvaljakon ajamisesta ja asiakkaiden opastamisesta? Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**

Työtehtäväsi

Huskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen

- moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta

- asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin

- huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät

- varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito

- asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.

**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

Hvem er vi?

Vores danske kontor i Málaga har eksisteret siden 2012, og vi støtter forskellige NGO-projekter. Kontoret er kendt for sin inkluderende kultur og stærke sammenhold. Her bliver du en del af et team med 50 kollegaer på tværs af aldersgrupper, og du møder alle ansatte i løbet af dagen.

  • En kultur, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og inklusion.

Vil du være en del af vores team?

At tage til udlandet og arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kan være en berigende oplevelse, både personligt og professionelt.

Her er nogle fordele, det kan have for din karriere fremadrettet:

  • Når du arbejder i udlandet, udvider du dine horisonter og får indsigt i forskellige kulturer og arbejdsmetoder.

  • Det gør dig mere åben og fleksibel, hvilket er værdifulde kvaliteter i et globalt arbejdsmarked.

  • Arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kræver stærke kommunikationsevner og evnen til at overbevise og engagere potentielle donorer. Disse kompetencer er eftertragtede i mange erhverv, da de viser, at du kan formidle budskaber effektivt og skabe positive relationer.

  • Derudover skaber du et internationalt netværk af kontakter og forbindelser, som kan være nyttige for din fremtidige karriere.

  • At have erfaring fra udlandet viser også, at du er initiativrig og villig til at tage chancer, hvilket kan imponere fremtidige arbejdsgivere.

  • Fundraising-arbejde kan føre til muligheder inden for marketing, salg, og nonprofit-organisationer, hvor dine kommunikative færdigheder og evnen til at opbygge relationer er afgørende.

  • Endelig viser det, at du kan tilpasse dig forskellige arbejdsmiljøer og håndtere udfordringer med positivt engagement. Dette gør dig til en attraktiv kandidat på arbejdsmarkedet, da virksomheder ofte søger medarbejdere, der kan navigere i en global kontekst og bidrage til deres vækst og udvikling.

jobs.title: Huoltoneuvoja
jobs.description:
Haemme kasvavaan joukkoomme **Huoltoneuvojaa**, jolla on jo kokemusta korjaamotoiminnasta ja joka viihtyy monipuolisessa asiakaspalvelu- ja työnjohtoroolissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat autohuollon asiakaspalvelu, korjaamon työnjohto, ajanvaraukset, varaosatilaukset sekä päivittäinen yhteistyö asiakkaiden, asentajien ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaan huoltokokemus on sujuva alusta loppuun.

**Meistä**

Autosta Oy on Espoon Muuralassa toimiva autohuolto- ja rengasalan yritys, jonka lisäksi harjoitamme kuljetusliiketoimintaa. Olemme osa arvostettuja **Mekonomen Autohuolto- ja Vianor-ketjuja**, mikä tarjoaa asiakkaillemme laadukkaat palvelut ja työntekijöillemme vahvan tuen päivittäiseen tekemiseen.

Liiketoimintamme kasvaa jatkuvasti, ja etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ammattilaista mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuttamme.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- Kokemusta autohuollon huoltoneuvojan tehtävistä tai korjaamotyöskentelystä

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti kiireisessäkin työympäristössä

- Sujuvaa tietokoneen ja erilaisten ohjelmistojen käyttöä

- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sekä asiakaspalveluun riittävää englannin kielen osaamista

- Positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Kiinnostusta autoalaa ja sen jatkuvaa kehittymistä kohtaan

- Autoalan koulutus, tekninen osaaminen, sekä kokemus esimerkiksi AutoFutur korjaamojärjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

- Vakituisen työpaikan kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaasi ja yrityksen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

- Joustavan työnantajan, joka arvostaa työntekijöidensä panosta

- Hyvät henkilöstöedut

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi autoalan ammattilaisena


**Arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Täysipäiväinen työ on mahdollista toteuttaa myös neljän arkipäivän työviikkona hieman pidemmillä työpäivillä. Lisäksi työskentelemme ainoastaan arkipäivisin, joten viikonloput jäävät vapaaksi.**

Meillä työtä tehdään hyvässä hengessä ja yhdessä joukkueena. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, reipasta asennetta ja halua palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

**Hae mukaan tiimiimme**

Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi, jotta hakemus tulee huomioiduksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Santtu. Arjen kiireiden vuoksi pyydämme mahdolliset puhelintiedustelut arkipäivisin klo 17 jälkeen.

Hakemukset Santtu Niemiselle osoitteeseen etunimi.sukinimi@autosta.fi ja puhelintiedustelut numerosta nolla neljä nolla 555 29 23.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotikuntoutus ja turva-auttamistiimi, Kirkkonummi
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia vakituisiin työsuhteisiin Kirkkonummen kotikuntoutustiimiin. Tehtävään kuuluu kotikuntoutuksen lisäksi vuoroja turva-auttamistehtävässä. Työskentelyalue voi tarpeen mukaan muuttua tai laajentua.

Kotikuntoutus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun muassa Läntisen sairaala-alueen, Seniori-infon ja alueellisen kotihoidon kanssa, vastateten sairaalasta kotiutuvien ikääntyneiden kotiutuksista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksesta kotona, turva-auttamisen käynneistä, sekä palvelutarpeen arviosta yhdessä Seniori-infon kanssa.

Lähihoitajan työ kotikuntoutuksessa on asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa itsenäistä, asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Tavoitteena on mahdollistaa asiakkaan toimivaa arkea ja tukea kotona asumista.

Lähihoitajan työhön kuuluvissa turva-auttamisvuoroissa keskeisiä vastuualueita ovat turva-auttamisasiakkaiden hälytystehtävien vastaanotto sähköisen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja vaihtuvien asiakkaiden kotiin jalkautuminen itsenäisesti. Asiakkaan luona tehdään tilannearvio ja arvio tämän kotikuntoisuudesta. Käynnillä annetaan asiakkaan tarvitsema välitön ensiapu ja muu tuki, arvioidaan lisäavun tarve ja tarvittaessa järjestetään se asiakkaalle. Käynneillä on mahdolisuus muiden ammattiryhmien konsutointiin.

Työhön kuuluu myös turvapuhelinten ja muiden turvalaitteiden asennus asiakkaille ja turvalaitteiden toiminnan tarkistaminen.

Kirjaaminen on iso osa niin kotikuntoutuksen kuin turva-auttamipalvelun työtä. Käynneillä tehdään kirjaukset Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmään sekä raportoidaan tarvittaessa eteenpäin toisille ammattilaisille. Yhteistyötä tehdään eri viranomaistahojen, kuten kotihoidon ja sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystyksen kanssa.

Työssä pääsee takuuvarmasti hyödyntämään monipuolisesti lähihoitajan osaamista!

Työssä korostuvat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, vastuullisuus sekä tiimityöskentelytaidot. Työyksikkö ja esihenkilö ovat tukena ja varmistavat, että työ sujuu. Työ on moniammatillista. Tiimiin kuuluu lähihoitajien lisäksi sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, sekä lääkäri.

Työ on jaksotyötä, johon kuuluu aamu- ja iltavuoroja sekä viikonlopputyötä.

Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana, joten haethan pian - odotamme hakemustasi!

Työpaikan osoite: Jokiniityntie 2, 02400 Kirkkonummi
Työaika: 114h 45min/ 3 viikossa
Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Lähihoitajan nimikkeellä toimivalta edellytetään oikeutta käyttää tehtävään soveltuvaa nimikesuojattua ammattinimikettä. Eduksi katsotaan osaamisalana perustason ensihoito, sairaanhoito ja huolenpito tai pelastajatutkinnon perustason ensihoidon suuntautumisvaihtoehto.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- ruotsin kielen taito on eduksi
- ajokortti on pakollinen
- lääkehoitolupa ei ole pakollinen, mutta se tulee suorittaa koeajan puitteissa

Toivomme, että
- ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita
- tunnet sote-alan päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön
- olet yhteistyötaitoinen: kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti ja osaat arvioida asiakkaan tilanteen ja hoidon tarpeen nopeasti
- pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- sinulla on valmius itsenäiseen kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden kotona

Arvostamme
- ensiapuosaamista
- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoitotyöstä ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat
- uusien järjestelmien ketterä käyttöönottokyky
- aiempaa kokemusta työssä tarvittavista järjestelmistä (Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

1.1.2024 lukien tehtävään valitun on esitettävä itseään koskeva lain 741/2023 28 §:n mukainen iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote.


Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Butcher / meat cutter
jobs.description:
Tenon Luonnontuote is looking for a skilled professional butcher for reindeer meat processing for autumn 2026.

The work starts at the beginning of October, when the reindeer season begins, and continues until the end of November.

Main duties: deboning and cutting reindeer meat, cutting and sawing meat, packing meat products, assisting in the production of meat products, other tasks related to meat processing.

We are looking for an experienced and reliable butcher with professional skills in meat cutting. Experience with reindeer meat is considered an advantage.

Language requirements: Finnish or English.

Free accommodation. We provide free accommodation next to the workplace for the entire duration of the employment.

Work in the beautiful Arctic North. Tenon Luonnontuote is located in Nuorgam, the northernmost village in Finland and the European Union, right next to the Norwegian border.

Working in Nuorgam offers a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful Arctic nature, spectacular landscapes, outdoor activities and, as autumn progresses, the possibility of seeing the Northern Lights.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Engagement Manager | Carve-out | Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for an Engagement Manager with significant experience from operational related M&A projects, specifically within carve-outs. The role is part of our Nordic practice and can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, working closely with colleagues and clients across the region.





Your key responsibilities



As an Engagement Manager in EY-Parthenon’s dedicated carve-out practice, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients navigate complex carve-out transactions and separation programs. Working across the full deal lifecycle, from pre-sign strategy and diligence through post-sign execution, you will support both buy-side and sell-side engagements.



In this role, you will help organizations make critical decisions that shape business performance, operational readiness, and long-term value creation. You will work closely with leading corporates and investors on high-profile, complex transactions, while also contributing to the continued growth and evolution of our market-leading carve-out practice, capabilities, and team. Some of the key responsibilities include;



    Leading buy- and sell-side carve-out engagements from pursuit and scoping through delivery and client management
    Driving carve-out analyses, standalone operating model design, cost assessments, separation planning, and TSA scoping
    Establishing and leading Separation Management Offices for Day 1 and IPO readiness programs
    Supporting the development and expansion of our carve-out offering
    Mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture





Skills and attributes for success



    Proven experience leading carve-out and separation programs across the deal lifecycle, gained within strategy consulting, transaction advisory, corporate development, M&A, or a related environment.
    Strong understanding of operational M&A and value creation, with the ability to translate complex transaction challenges into actionable solutions.
    Master’s degree in business and economics, Engineering or equivalent
    Great communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and preferably Swedish or another Nordic language
    Ability to structure and solve complex problems and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders





Ideally, you’ll also



    Have experience from post-signing related activities, including sign-to-close planning, cutover planning, and PMO / Deal team support throughout the transaction life cycle
    Experience from other technical separation related topics, including vendor and/or customer contract separation, legal entity structuring and optimization
    Have experience leading value creation related projects, both identification and quantification as well as execution
    Being a team player with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels in EY and with clients, both in the Nordics and internationally





What We Look For



    An agile, business and growth-oriented mindset. We’re looking for innovative individuals who can work in an agile way and adapt to a changing business environment
    Curiosity and a purpose-driven approach. We seek people who see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to build a better working world
    Inclusivity. We value individuals who embrace diverse perspectives and work inclusively to build safety and trust





What we offer you



You will join a collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment where you will receive significant responsibility early on and you could develop rapidly as a professional. By joining our team, we offer:

    Opportunity to work on complex and high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in high-stakes transactions environments
    High-performing, inclusive, collaborative, fun, and entrepreneurial team culture
    Modern offices in central locations in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, and flexible ways of working as part of our Nordic Hybrid Model.

Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.

jobs.title: Electrical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

In the role of the Electrical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements, and demobilization after immersion. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Supervise the installation of temporary TE systems in the Tunnel elements whilst planning and coordinating with other stakeholders to optimize the available time window. Troubleshoot during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle. Procure small materials and equipment.

The Electrical Supervisor supervises the use and installation of the following equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Qualifications:

The TE systems Electrical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems electricians and Commissioning Engineers

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connect the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available.

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. jobs.title: Requirements Engineer
jobs.description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._


_Why Basemark? Basemark offers you the chance to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a collaborative, international environment. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

jobs.title: Durability and Sensor Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a technically broad engineering role in an advanced automotive development environment, working closely with chassis systems and wheel suspension. The focus is on turning measured forces and simulation data into better durability decisions, from sensor design and calibration to CAE-based stress and strain analysis.

A large part of the role is about connecting theory with real-world testing. You will help ensure that strain gauge solutions and other sensor setups generate reliable data for model correlation and laboratory testing, while also supporting the long-term durability of components and systems. You will work cross-functionally with CAE engineers, design teams and test stakeholders, which gives you real influence on both technical direction and engineering quality. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy combining simulation, hardware and testing in work that directly shapes vehicle durability.

Job Description

    You will lead sensor design activities with a focus on strain gauge applications for vehicles and test rigs.
    You will drive the workflow from design input and test needs to sensor concept, placement strategy and final calibration.
    You will define load ranges, identify testing needs and perform strength simulations to support sensor design.
    You will design physical components and sensor solutions, using detailed stress and strain analysis to optimize strain gauge placement.
    You will plan and oversee calibration activities to secure accurate and reliable measurement data.
    You will perform stress and strain CAE simulations for chassis systems and components during the design phase.
    You will provide recommendations to improve durability in ongoing programs and design concepts.
    You will contribute to developing durability requirements, targets and technical guidelines together with the wider engineering organization.
    You will collaborate across CAE, CAD and physical testing to connect analytical work with practical validation.

Requirements

    MSc in Mechanical Engineering.
    Knowledge of Wheel Suspension design.
    Documented knowledge and a few years of experience from the durability domain.
    Experience of the CAE tools Ansa, Abaqus and nCode, as well as the CAD tool CATIA.
    Broad knowledge of the vehicle design process.
    Experience in writing requirements and technical guidelines.
    Ability to work across disciplines and balance theoretical modeling with hands-on testing and analysis.
    Fluent in English, written and spoken.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer & Team Lead to Wioniq Nordic // Borås
jobs.description:
Wioniq Nordic is a pioneer in smart IoT solutions for the water, energy, and construction sectors. With our new brand identity and ambitious growth targets leading up to 2028, we are heading into an exciting future. Our innovative platform monitors and protects critical infrastructure worldwide, and we are now looking for you who want to be part of our journey and contribute to developing the next generation of solutions. Together with us, you will have the opportunity to help shape the smart and sustainable societies of the future.

About the role

You’ll take on a central role as a hands-on Fullstack Developer while also leading and coordinating a technical team of approximately 5–7 people. A significant part of your day will be spent developing alongside the team, building robust and scalable solutions and contributing to the continued evolution of our IoT platform.

Alongside your own development work, you’ll provide direction for the team by setting priorities, coordinating the day-to-day work and helping remove blockers. You’ll also collaborate closely with other teams and stakeholders across the organization, making sure technical priorities are aligned with customer needs and business goals. When requirements shift or the scope changes, you know how to reassess, prioritize and keep the work moving forward.

You’ll be involved throughout the entire journey, from concept to production, working with a modern tech stack including Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Vue3, Kubernetes and PostgreSQL. Here, leadership means staying close to both the technology and the people, creating clarity, communicating across teams and making sure everyone is moving in the same direction.

We’re looking for someone who..  …is an experienced developer who enjoys staying close to the technology while taking an active role in leading and supporting others.

You’re curious, hands-on and comfortable taking ownership, but you also have the ability to step back, see the bigger picture and understand where your focus will make the most difference.

You’re a strong communicator who can connect with different personalities, roles and stakeholders. You listen, ask the right questions and know how to turn complex discussions into clear decisions and next steps. When priorities compete or circumstances change, you stay calm, reassess what matters the most and create a clear path forward.

As a leader, you build trust through both your technical knowledge and the way you work with others. You enjoy supporting and challenging your colleagues, sharing knowledge and creating an environment where people can take ownership, collaborate and deliver great work together.

    

6+ years of experience in fullstack development, working with Go and/or TypeScript/Node.js and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue, React or Angular

    

3+ years of experience as a Team Lead or in a similar technical leadership role

    

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different personalities, roles and stakeholders

    

Proven ability to prioritize, create structure and keep delivery moving when requirements or scope change

    

Experience working in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux) is a plus

    

Post-secondary education i Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

    

Fluent in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus

About Wioniq Nordic  As part of the Wioniq Group, operating across Europe, we at Wioniq Nordic are proud to be a driving force in creating more sustainable and smarter cities, industries, and buildings. We believe in technology’s ability to simplify, improve, and transform, and that’s exactly what we do. Through our IoT solutions, we already help over 400 companies across the Nordics optimize and monitor their critical systems in real time, from district heating and water to energy flows and building monitoring.

Our ambition is to make the complex simple and give our customers full control, where every decision is based on smart insights. Through a powerful platform and intelligent devices, we ensure that our automated solutions meet customer needs at every stage, detecting deviations, minimizing operational disruptions, and providing decision support that saves money, resources, and contributes to a better environment. At Wioniq, we are driven by curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to create change. We look forward to welcoming more like-minded individuals who want to help build a more sustainable and intelligent future for infrastructure around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow / Yliopistotutkija (Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature, within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). jobs.title: 1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history / 1-2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa kirjallisuustieteessä tai historiassa (The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities, VERSITAS project)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Huhtinen / Försäljare, Sale Huktis
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

MYYJÄ, SALE HUHTINEN, 12 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää Sale Huhtiseen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Myyjän työtehtävissä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtäviä, mm. asiakaspalvelutyötä kassalla ja hyllytystä. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.

Me Sale Huhtisessa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta(10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
-5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtuntitulospalkkioonyrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 30.8.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa apulaistoimipaikkapäällikkö Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE HUKTIS, 12 H/VECKA, TILLSVIDAREANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Huktis för en tillsvidareanställning. Som försäljare får du arbeta mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter, bland annat kundservice i kassan och varuplock. I ditt dagliga arbete ingår också att se till att butiken är ren och trivsam samt att säkerställa produkternas exponering och tillgänglighet.

På Sale Huktis brukar vi säga att vi har ett helt vanligt jobb. Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng – tvärtom!

Vi önskar att du
- möter du kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- har en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- har förmåga att ta i bruk nya system
- har möjlighet att jobba i varierande arbetsskift – också under högtider.
Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 30.8.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger biträdande enhetschef Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.description:
