Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) de Marketing & Communication capable d'accompagner la structuration de l'image du groupe et la création de supports commerciaux clairs, professionnels et directement exploitables.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, vous participez à la mise en place et à l'amélioration des outils de communication d'AXOR Ingénierie.
Votre rôle sera de rendre les activités du groupe plus lisibles, plus professionnelles et mieux présentées auprès des clients, partenaires et équipes commerciales.
La mission porte principalement sur la création, la mise à jour et l'harmonisation des supports de communication et de présentation du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Supports marketing et communication
- Créer, mettre à jour et harmoniser les plaquettes commerciales du groupe ;
- Préparer des supports de présentation clairs pour les rendez-vous clients, partenaires et commerciaux ;
- Structurer les documents de présentation des activités : structures métalliques, ingénierie, enveloppe du bâtiment, solutions constructives ;
- Participer à l'amélioration de l'image de marque et de la cohérence visuelle des supports ;
- Mettre à jour les contenus de communication existants : site internet, présentations, documents internes et commerciaux ;
- Coordonner si besoin les échanges avec les prestataires externes : graphistes, web, imprimeurs, traducteurs.
Appui au développement commercial
- Travailler avec la Direction et les équipes commerciales pour clarifier les messages, offres et argumentaires ;
- Produire des supports simples, professionnels et utilisables rapidement sur le terrain ;
- Participer à la valorisation des projets, références, partenaires et savoir-faire du groupe ;
- Proposer des améliorations concrètes pour renforcer la visibilité et la crédibilité d'AXOR Ingénierie ;
- Accompagner progressivement la communication autour des nouvelles activités du groupe.
Profil recherché
- Expérience en marketing, communication, création de supports commerciaux ou communication d'entreprise ;
- Très bonne capacité rédactionnelle et de synthèse ;
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de présentation et de mise en page ;
- Capacité à transformer des informations techniques en supports clairs et professionnels ;
- Profil autonome, structuré, rigoureux et orienté concret ;
- Sens de l'organisation, réactivité et capacité à travailler avec plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
- Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, BTP, ingénierie ou international serait appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel apprécié ;
- Anglais apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une vraie compétence en marketing et communication, nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre rapidement les enjeux du groupe, de structurer des supports utiles et de contribuer concrètement à son développement.
Cadre de la collaboration
- Mission freelance / prestation ;
- Présence régulière à Barcelone souhaitée, avec possibilité d'organisation hybride selon profil ;
- Démarrage possible rapidement ;
- Collaboration évolutive selon les livrables, les résultats et les besoins du groupe ;
- Possibilité d'évolution vers un temps plein ou une collaboration plus durable selon profil.

jobs.title: Senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for up to two senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering for permanent employment at the School of Science and Technology.

Subject area

The subject area for this position is Electrical Engineering.

Background

We are looking for up to two new colleagues to strengthen our teaching and research related to electrical engineering, at the intersection of electrical engineering, robotics, and autonomous systems. Topics of interest include control theory, signal processing, sensors, electronics and mechatronics; potentially extending towards robot manipulation, robot perception and machine learning. If you are passionate about advancing knowledge in these fields and enjoy working in an internationally connected research and educational environment, we would love to hear from you.

The positions are based at the school’s unit for computer science, which conducts education in both computer science and electrical engineering, and is home to the research environment AASS (applied autonomous sensor systems) which is a dynamic and multi-disciplinary constellation at the intersection of computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The successful candidate is also expected to interact with the university-wide centre for AI, Robotics and Cybersecurity (ARC). See also: https://www.oru.se/english/research/university-wide-centres/arc-ai-robotics-and-cybersecurity-center/

Duties and responsibilities

As a senior lecturer, you will divide your time between teaching at all levels, research, and any associated public engagement activities.

On the teaching side, you will contribute to courses spanning the breadth of electrical engineering, from foundational to advanced level. This includes courses in electrical circuits and electronics, digital electronics, control theory, digital signal conditioning and processing, and electrical machines. Over time you will be expected to develop your own courses. Teaching encompasses supervision, examination, course development and administration, planning and evaluation. Teaching can be done in Swedish and English. On the research side, you are expected to publish in relevant international venues and attract external research funding. You will be integrated into the research environment with possibilities to establish an independent research agenda connected to the unit's general topics.

There are also opportunities to take on leadership roles in research and education (for example, shaping degree programmes or leading a research team) and to contribute more broadly to the development of the unit's activities.

Qualifications

Those qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer are applicants who have demonstrated teaching expertise and been awarded a doctoral degree in a subject matter relevant for the position, or has the corresponding research competence or some other professional expertise that is of value in view of the subject matter of the position and the duties that it will involve.

A general eligibility criterion for teaching staff at Örebro University is to have completed courses on teaching and learning in higher education corresponding to 10 weeks. Knowledge and skills equivalent to such courses may also be assessed to establish whether these provide eligibility. A teacher who at the time of appointment lacks such training or the equivalent competence, must complete the required courses no later than within two years of taking up the position.

Assessment criteria

To see the job advertisement and the assessment criteria in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260201

Information

This is a permanent full-time position. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience, and positions announced are, where appropriate, subject to a trial period.

For more information about the position, contact head of unit Martin Magnusson, +46 19 30 38 70, email: martin.magnusson@oru.se, or head of school Henrik Olsson, +46 19 30 12 36, email: henrik.olsson@oru.se.

At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.

Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.

Application

The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.

For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:

    Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
    CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
    Teaching portfolio (as instructed in Örebro University's guidelines:  https://www.oru.se/globalassets/inforum-en/key_documents/human-resources/template-for-teaching-portfolio.pdf)
    Research portfolio
    Publication list
    Relevant scientific publications (maximum of five and in full-text format)
    Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

More information for applicants will be found on our career site: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/

The application deadline is 2026-08-31. We look forward to receiving your application!

After the application deadline, no supplements can be made electronically. If you have scientific publications that cannot be attached electronically to the application, please cite them in your application and contact hr@oru.se.

As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.

As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja teline- ja sääsuojapalveluihin Rauman telakalle
jobs.description:
**_Etsimme työnjohtajaa teline- ja sääsuojapalveluihin Rauman telakalle_**

_Olemme teline- ja sääsuoja-alalla Euroopan suurimpia toimijoita ja Suomessa yksi suurimmista rakennusalan aliurakoitsijoista. Asiakaskuntamme on laaja; toteutamme asiakkaillemme teline- ja sääsuojausprojekteja sekä rakennuksilla että teollisuudessa._

_Olemme osana tuotantoa mukana rakentamassa niin maailman suurimpia risteilijöitä kuin muitakin moderneja aluksia, tarjoten asiakkaillemme turvalliset työskentelyolosuhteet sekä huolletun ja toimivan vuokrakaluston. Näissä projekteissa poikkeuksetta yhdistyy sujuva palvelu ja vankka ammattitaitomme._

_Tässä tehtävässä toimit osana Väli-Suomen työnjohtotiimiä, jossa kollegoinasi toimivat pitkän linjan ammattilaiset. Työnjohtotiimi ei toimi yksin, vaan ammattimaista tukea työhön tarjoavat Ramirentin tuotehallinta, suunnittelu, projektitoimisto ja logistiikka._

_Työnjohtajana vastaat teline- ja sääsuojatyömaistasi. Valvot ja vaadit työturvallisuuden ehdotonta noudattamista, joka on yrityksessämme keskiössä. Toimit Ramirentin edustajana asiakkaan suuntaan esimerkiksi työmaakokouksissa ja muissa sidosryhmätilanteissa. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittyä myös tarjouslaskennassa._

_Emme odota, että olet täysin valmis työnjohtaja. Hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot yhdistettynä oppimispotentiaalisi ovat avainasemassa tässä tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta. Tarjoamme sinulle erinomaiset puitteet ja kattavan perehdytyksen työssä menestymisen tueksi. Tehtävään valittavalle tullaan tekemään turvallisuusselvitys, mikä on edellytys työsuhteen aloittamiselle._

**_Hakijalta toivomme:_**

- _Tuloksentekokykyä_

- _Kykyä kokonaisuuksien hallintaan_

- _Rakennusalan teknistä koulutusta (esimerkiksi insinööri/rakennusmestari, myös vastavalmistuneet huomioidaan) tai rakennusalan kokemusta_

- Kokemusta telineasennuksista

- _Työnjohtokokemusta (ml. esihenkilökokemusta) ja hyviä ihmissuhdetaitoja_

- _Hyviä yleisiä IT-taitoja_

- _Kielitaitoa: Äidinkielentasoinen suomi ja sujuva englanti ovat välttämättömiä_


**_Ramirent tarjoaa sinulle:_**

- _Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon palvelut_

- _Ison palvelualan yrityksen tuen_

- _Vakavaraisen ja arvostetun brändin, jonka laatuun voit luottaa_

- _Sitoutuneet kollegat positiivisessa työyhteisössä_

- _Hyvän perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen tehtävään_

- _Vastuullisen tehtävän ja mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä kehittyä_


**_Kiinnostuitko?_**

_Lähetä CV sekä vapaamuotoinen hakemus palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 6.9.2026 hakuportaalin kautta. Hae pikaisesti, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan kandidaatin löytyessä!_

_Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Aluejohtaja Panu Makkonen, p. +358 400 920 638 arkisin klo 8-16._

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Nolato MediTech develops and manufactures polymer products and systems for global Medtech and Pharma customers. We offer extensive turnkey solutions within plastic and silicone molding, as well as innovative assembly solutions.

Do you want to combine engineering expertise with customer collaboration in an industry where quality, structure and long-term partnerships matter?

As a Sales Engineer, you will be the technical-commercial link between our customers and Nolato MediTech. You will help turn customer needs into robust manufacturing solutions, working closely with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling throughout the quotation and project process.

About the role

In this role, you will support sales within the contract manufacturing of medical devices. You will lead and structure the technical-commercial dialogue from request for quotation to signed agreement, ensuring that customer requirements are understood, evaluated and translated into feasible, high-quality solutions.

Rather than selling a standard product, you will work with complex, customer-specific projects and long product life cycles. Your engineering background will enable you to engage confidently in technical discussions, coordinate input from internal specialists and explain our proposed manufacturing set-ups clearly to customers.

You report directly to the Managing Director, who holds the overall sales responsibility. You will work closely with a senior Sales Account Manager, who will provide mentoring and commercial support. The position supports our facilities in Hörby and Lomma and is based at our Hörby site.

Main responsibilities

    Develop business opportunities with new and existing customers in line with Nolato MediTech’s strategy and established ways of working.
    Act as a technical-commercial contact for customers, clarifying requirements, coordinating technical input and supporting discussions on manufacturing solutions.
    Drive, coordinate and prepare quotations in accordance with the Quotation Review process, working with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling.
    Support the evaluation of manufacturability, technical risks, quality requirements and proposed production set-ups during the quotation phase.
    Communicate and negotiate product pricing, services and commercial terms together with the relevant internal stakeholders.
    Lead and facilitate Business Review meetings with customers, ensuring follow-up on technical, commercial and operational topics.
    Work closely with the Medical Solutions business area to align customer strategies, pipeline activity and business opportunities.
    Ensure that technical and commercial commitments are clearly documented and handed over effectively to the project and operational teams.



Background and skills

We welcome candidates at an earlier stage of their commercial career who bring a strong technical foundation and the motivation to develop in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience from sales, application engineering, project engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering or technical project coordination is valuable, but extensive sales experience is not a requirement.

    Education — A university degree in engineering, for example mechanical engineering, materials/polymer engineering, industrial engineering, biomedical engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
    Technical understanding — Ability to understand and discuss technical solutions, manufacturing processes, drawings, specifications and production set-ups with customers and internal specialists.
    Relevant environment — Experience from medical devices, life science, contract manufacturing or another technically advanced and regulated industry is an advantage.
    Structured working style — Ability to document, coordinate and follow defined processes in a complex project environment.
    Communication — Strong communication skills and the ability to build confidence with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    Languages — Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written.

Profile

We believe you are someone who:

    Is curious about technology and enjoys understanding how products and manufacturing processes work.
    Can translate customer needs into clear questions and practical next steps for internal experts.
    Works in a structured and methodical way, with attention to quality and detail.
    Uses the organisation’s expertise naturally and knows when to involve the right people.
    Builds long-term, trust-based relationships with customers and colleagues.
    Is comfortable developing into a commercial role and taking responsibility for customer dialogue over time.
    Has a professional, collaborative and confident manner in discussions and negotiations.

We offer

    A key technical-commercial role in a growing medical technology company.
    A structured organisation with clear mandates, processes and decision paths.
    Close collaboration with experienced colleagues in sales, engineering, quality and regulatory affairs.
    Mentoring and support as you develop your technical-commercial career.
    Long-term development opportunities within Nolato MediTech and the Nolato Group.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application via hr.meditech@nolato.com and attaching your CV and cover letter.

The last day of application is 2026-09-13

If you want to know more about the position, please contact:

Managing Director; Hanna Ingesson, 072-237 46 42, hanna.ingesson@nolato.com

HR Director; Stefan Hasselblad, 0768–617183, stefan.hasselblad@nolato.com

jobs.description:
Etsimme **AC-kokkia** ja -**tarjoilijaa** Kilpisjärvelle ruska-ajan sesonkiin.

_AC-kokki:_

Työskentely alkaa heti ja kestää **syyskuun loppuun** asti.

AC-kokin tehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisesti keittiön työtehtäviä, kuten:

- aamupalavuorojen tuurauksia

- buffetin valmistusta ja ylläpitoa

- à la carte -ruokien valmistusta

- keittiön muita päivittäisiä työtehtäviä.


Etsimme reipasta ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää kokkia, jolla on hyvä asenne ja halu tehdä laadukasta ruokaa sesongin kiireessä.

_Tarjoilija:_

Tarjoilijan työt alkaa heti ja kestävät **lokakuun loppuun** asti.

Työhön kuuluu asiakaspalvelua, anniskelua sekä ravintolan päivittäisiä tarjoilijan tehtäviä. Arvostamme positiivista asennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja hyvää asiakaspalvelutaitoa.

Työskentely Kilpisjärvellä

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä upeissa Lapin maisemissa ruskan aikaan. **Majoitus järjestyy soluasunnossa hintaan 282 €/kk.**

Molemmissa tehtävissä on **mahdollisuus jatkaa työskentelyä talvikaudella**.

**Työkieli on suomi. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele englanniksi lähetettyjä hakemuksia.**

**Palkkaus matkailu- ja ravintola-alan TES sekä kokemuksen mukaan.**

Jos kiinnostuit, lähetä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen rekrytointi@teampa.fi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, aiemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, kumpaa tehtävää haet.

jobs.description:
Haemme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Lvi-asentajaa. Päivittäiset työtehtävät muodostuvat vaihtelevissa kohteissa lvi-huoltotöistä, remonttikohteista, saneeraustyömailla työskentelystä kuin myös uudistyömailla työskentelystä. Kuitenkin pääsääntöisesti huolto- ja remonttikohteiden parissa. Niin taloyhtiökohteissa kuin yksityisasiakkaiden luona sekä remonttialan yritysten kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta: Tarkkaa ja tarmokasta otetta työhösi sekä luonnollisesti hyvää ammattiosaamista. Hitsaustaito luetaan eduksesi. Ymmärrys lämpöpumppu- ja kaukolämpölaitteista luetaan myös eduksesi. Olethan valmis oppimaan uutta sillä pyrimme aina mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös tarjoamaan kouluttautumista henkilökunnallemme. C-kortti luetaan myös eduksesi, tarvittaessa voimme kustantaa sinulle myös ajokortin suorittamisen.

Paikka täytetään heti kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä meihin niin sovitaan haastatteluaika ja istutaan kahvin kanssa katsomaan että olisiko juuri sinusta meille tuleva asentaja.

We are seeking an experienced TIG welder for our client company in Vihti for a long-term position. If you have strong experience in aluminium welding and are interested in a long-term job with diverse projects, you might be the person we are looking for!

About the role

In this role, you will work on a wide variety of welding tasks, as the welded products vary. The work is carried out in modern and well-lit facilities in two shifts 40 hours per week. Material thicknesses range from approximately 1 to 20 millimeter. If you are relocating from another location, we can assist with accommodation arrangements if needed. Welding tests will be required before starting the work.

We expect from you

* Solid experience in TIG welding, especially with aluminium

We offer you

* Competitive salary based on your skills and experience

You will be employed by Wellpack, a company founded in 2013 that provides high-quality staffing services. Wellpack connects skilled workers with quality jobs and contributes to building employment in Finland.

How to apply

Please submit your application as soon as possible via the Apply link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our system. In your application, describe your experience in industrial work, skills, and education background. We will contact selected candidates for interviews during the application period. Applications are processed continuously and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information about the position, contact Wellpacks recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Help Engineers Solve Real-World Technical Problems Across Europe from Porvoo, Finland**

At Thermetrics Europe, we support engineers, researchers, manufacturers, and technical organizations with precision thermal and moisture measurement technology, application expertise, service, calibration, and technical support.

We may be a young European company, but we are not starting from scratch. We have more than 40 years of Thermetrics technology, engineering experience, and industry knowledge behind us.

We're now building the next stage of Thermetrics Europe, and we're looking for a **Technical Support Engineer – Service & Support** to join our growing team in Porvoo, Finland (you must be already located in Southern Finland).

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, varied engineering role. You'll provide technical support to customers, assemble and test our products in Porvoo, travel throughout Europe for installations and service, troubleshoot equipment, perform calibrations, train customers, and help them get the most from their Thermetrics systems.

You'll also work closely with our engineering team in the US, bringing customer and field experience back into product development and continuous improvement. No two days will look exactly the same. You might be troubleshooting a system remotely in the morning, preparing equipment for shipping items in the afternoon, and traveling to a customer site the following week.

Travel is approximately **25% or less**, throughout Europe, occasionally including trips to outside Europe as well.

**Help Build the Support Team**

We're building our European support organization as we grow, which means this isn't a role where every process is already written and every responsibility has been neatly assigned. There will be trial and error, problem solving, and plenty of wearing different hats.

You'll have opportunities to help develop service procedures, documentation, customer support processes, training materials, and new ways of working. Sometimes you'll be doing the technical work. Sometimes you'll be helping figure out how the technical work should be done.

We're looking for someone who enjoys that kind of environment.

You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to be curious, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, and able to look at a problem and say: "We haven't done this before. Let's figure it out."

**Team Player. Independent Problem Solver.**

You'll be part of a small, collaborative team, but field service also requires you to be comfortable working independently.

When you're at a customer site, you may be the technical person in the room. You'll need to assess the situation, troubleshoot on the go, make good decisions, communicate clearly, and keep working toward a solution even when conditions aren't perfect.

We're looking for someone who:

- Works well as part of a small team.

- Can work independently in the field.

- Enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and problem solving.

- Stays calm when things don't go according to plan.

- Takes ownership of problems and follows them through to resolution.

- Knows when to solve a problem independently and when to reach out for help.

- Is willing to pitch in wherever needed as the company grows.

- Communicates well with both technical and non-technical customers.


**What You'll Bring**

**Required:**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated equipment, engineered products, field service, commissioning, or technical support.

- Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A practical, hands-on approach to technical problem solving.

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% internationally, mostly alone

- Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative international team.

- Native or professional working proficiency in English.

- Valid Driver's License


**Nice to have:**

- Experience with scientific instrumentation or laboratory equipment.

- Experience with thermal, environmental, textile, or PPE testing.

- Experience with calibration, validation, commissioning, or field service.

- Familiarity with SolidWorks, Python, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.

- Finnish or Swedish language skills.


**Why Thermetrics Europe?**

You'll be joining a company with the technology and experience of an established global organization, while having the opportunity to help shape a young and growing European operation.

You'll work with advanced thermal testing technology, support customers across Europe, collaborate with experienced engineers internationally, and have a direct influence on how our European service and support organization develops.

This is a role for someone who wants to build, not just maintain.

If you enjoy solving real-world engineering problems, working with customers, troubleshooting in the field, and helping build something that is still taking shape, we'd like to hear from you.

**Location:** Porvoo, Finland (Itä-Uusimaa)

**Employment:** Full-time, with trial period

**Travel:** Up to 25%, mostly Europe

**Education**: Bachelors (Required)

**Language**: English, Professional or Native (Required), and Finnish/Swedish, Working (Preferred)

jobs.title: Elämyskaupan liiketoimintapäällikkö
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIEKSA

Etsimme elämyskaupan liiketoimintapäällikköä johtamaan, rakentamaan ja kehittämään tulevaisuuden matkailu- ja elämysliiketoimintaa Pohjois-Karjalassa.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään liiketoiminnan johtamisen, matkailun, elämykset ja kaupallisen kehittämisen ainutlaatuisessa toimintaympäristössä. Vastaat Bomba Safaris ja Koli Safaris - Karelian Adventures & Experiences liiketoiminnasta, Koli Ski rinnetoiminnoista sekä PKO matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupan tapahtumatuotannosta ja tuotteistuksesta. Tavoitteena on kasvattaa ja kehittää kokonaisuutta entistä vahvemmaksi, ympärivuotiseksi ja kansainvälisesti kiinnostavaksi elämyspalveluiden kokonaisuudeksi.

Tehtävässäsi pääset
johtamaan ja kehittämään liiketoimintaa sekä vastaamaan sen budjetista ja tuloksesta
rakentamaan ympärivuotista elämystarjontaa kotimaisille ja kansainvälisille matkailijoille
tunnistamaan uusia mahdollisuuksia ja kehittämään uusia tuotteita, palveluita ja elämyksellisiä konsepteja
johtamaan henkilöstöä ja vahvistamaan osaamista, työyhteisöä ja asiantuntijuutta
suunnittelemaan ja edistämään investointeja, jotka tukevat liiketoiminnan kasvua ja tulevaisuuden asiakastarpeita
kehittämään määrätietoisesti turvallisuutta, laatua ja asiakaskokemusta
rakentamaan vahvoja kumppanuuksia alueen toimijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
vastaamaan kokonaisuuden kaupallisesta kehittämisestä ja löytämään uusia tapoja kasvattaa myyntiä ja kannattavuutta.

Odotamme sinulta
Sinulla on vahva kaupallinen ote ja kyky nähdä metsä puilta – ja mahdollisuudet siellä, missä muut näkevät vain nykytilan. Osaat yhdistää strategisen ajattelun käytännön tekemiseen ja viet ideat suunnitelmallisesti toteutukseen.
Olet kokenut esihenkilö, joka innostaa ihmisiä, rakentaa toimivia tiimejä ja saa aikaan tuloksia yhdessä muiden kanssa. Ymmärrät asiakaskokemuksen, palveluliiketoiminnan ja kannattavuuden välisen yhteyden ja haluat kehittää niitä kokonaisuutena.

Matkailu- ja elämysliiketoiminnan tuntemus on tehtävässä eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme kehittämishaluista ja kaupallisesti ajattelevaa esihenkilöä, jolla on kyky tarttua mahdollisuuksiin ja rakentaa uutta.

Mikä tekee tehtävästä erityisen?
Pääset työskentelemään Kolin ja Bomban ainutlaatuisessa matkailuympäristössä, jossa luonto, kulttuuri, tapahtumat ja elämykset kohtaavat. Tehtävässäsi sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, millaisia kokemuksia alueen matkailijoille ja asiakkaille tulevaisuudessa tarjotaan.
Tämä ei ole tehtävä, jossa vain ylläpidetään olemassa olevaa. Tässä tehtävässä rakennetaan seuraavaa lukua.

Jos innostut liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, ihmisistä, elämyksistä ja siitä, että hyvästä ideasta tehdään kannattavaa ja mieleenpainuvaa asiakasliiketoimintaa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. PKOlaisena saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja PKOn kattavat henkilöstöedut. (https://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut) Meillä työnantaja on vakuuttanut jokaisen työntekijän myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella, ja liikkumistasi kannustamme Epassilla. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa. Palkkaa maksamme alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

Tule rakentamaan Pohjois-Karjalan seuraavia elämyksiä kanssamme.

Hakuaika päättyy 31.8.2026.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa matkailukaupan toimialajohtaja Satu Näsärö p. 040 5379 201, voit soittaa hänelle 20.8. klo 14.30-17.00 tai 24.8. klo 10.00-14.00.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product Engineering
jobs.description:
About Varnish Software

Varnish Software is a Scandinavian-based tech company developing caching technology for some of the world's biggest players in the content delivery market. Our technology helps businesses worldwide improve website performance, deliver video streams, and scale their infrastructure.

About the role 💼

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our new Product Engineering team. While Varnish is known for its general purpose caching engine (OSS and Enterprise), our team is focused on building new products to solve real-world needs, where caching is just one of the components. It’s a bit like developing LEGO sets.

We are currently building a Data Fabric suite of products designed to address infrastructure challenges, including (but not limited to):

  • Virtual Registry: Caching packages, Docker images, and other software artifacts.

  • Artifact Firewall: Preventing and mitigating software supply chain attacks.

  • S3 Cache: On-prem caching of S3-compatible object stores.

  • AI Storage Accelerator: Speed up AI training and inference workloads.

You will have a high degree of technical freedom and ownership, as we prioritize quality over quantity and work on long-term ongoing projects. The solutions you help create will be deployed both on-prem by customers and used to build managed platforms and services.

What You Will Do

We primarily develop our tools in Go, but Rust is becoming increasingly relevant for our critical high-performance components.

You will be building self-hosted, distributed systems that need to deploy across a wide range of customer environments. Your core responsibilities will include:

  • System Architecture & Implementation: You will not just be implementing features, you will participate in architecting the "Data Fabric" suite. This involves solving complex concurrency, networking, and data consistency challenges. It’s a lot of fun!

  • Technical Ownership: We are looking for an engineer who thinks beyond the ticket. You will take ownership of entire components, from the initial RFC/design phase through to implementation and testing.

  • Drive Innovation: You are expected to be a vocal part of the engineering process. We need you to challenge our architectural assumptions, propose alternative technical approaches, and help us avoid local optima in our design decisions.

  • Good Code: You will contribute to a culture of high code quality, writing maintainable, testable code and participating in rigorous code reviews.

Who You Are

We are looking for a developer who is driven by solving problems, not just closing tickets.

  • Solid Engineering Foundation: You have strong experience in backend software development. While our stack is primarily Go, we value deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, concurrency, and distributed systems over specific syntax.

  • Product-Minded: You understand that code is a means to an end. You have enough industry knowledge to understand why we are building these products and can make technical decisions that align with market needs.

  • Innovator & Challenger: You are not afraid to voice a different opinion or challenge architectural decisions. Varnish Software has a flat company structure and thrives on individuals taking ownership.

  • Versatile: You understand the complexities of self-hosted software. You are comfortable navigating the blurry line between application code and the infrastructure it runs on (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux).

  • Self-Driven: You manage your own time effectively, take initiative without waiting for permission, and contribute to a friendly, humble, and collaborative team culture.

About the team 💙

Our Research & Development team develops and maintains the Varnish Software products, which includes Varnish Enterprise, Varnish Controller and Varnish Traffic Router. We're a group of open-minded, friendly, and curious software engineers, eager to exploring and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in content delivery.

We embrace a company culture inspired by innovation and teamwork. For us, a sense of belonging, equality and trust is key for building high performing teams who thrive as professionals and individuals. 

We're based in Oslo, Karlstad and Paris. 

Benefits, Perks & Salary Range 🙌

At our Varnish Software, we believe that a happy and healthy team is the foundation of our success. That's why we offer a range of benefits and perks:

  • Flexible working arrangements 🏡

We know that life doesn't always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. That's why we offer flexible working arrangements to help you balance your professional and personal life. This role requires You to be able to work from the Oslo office (Nydalen) at least once a week.

  • Generous parental pay 🧑‍🍼

We believe in supporting our employees through all life stages, ensuring you can enjoy quality time with your little one without financial worries. Join us and experience a workplace that truly values work-life balance and family wellbeing.

  • Vacation 🏖️

We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation. That's why we offer 26 vacation days, enjoy more time to travel, unwind, and spend quality time with your loved ones.

How to Apply

Eligibility: You must have the legal right to work in Norway or hold unrestricted work authorization within the EU/EEA that allows you to work in Norway at the time of employment. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Ready to join our team?
Simply click the "Apply" button to start your application process. We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to our success. Don’t hesitate - take the first step towards your new career with us today!

When we’ve different perspectives and approaches, we grow together to create innovative solutions and contributions to software development and to our customers. With this diversity, we have one thing in common; we’re fun and friendly. And we’re in this together!

jobs.title: Secondary Engineer
jobs.description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as hydrogen, data centers and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

**The Opportunity**

We are offering a position as a Secondary Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Integration business. This role will be in Vaasa, where we have the team and an office.

The business unit designs and delivers complete substations for distribution and transmission grids. We are offering an interesting position in an international project environment and various development possibilities in the areas of design and engineering, research, and development. Because each project is different, your responsibilities will range widely and may include managing all aspects of secondary design from initial planning to final delivery.

Daily responsibilities include preparing design drawings, drafting essential construction documents, conducting engineering calculations, and overseeing commissioning processes. At Hitachi Energy, you will have the opportunity to apply your design expertise across diverse projects, both domestically in Finland and internationally.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

- Prepare and review substation documentations, for example, single line diagram, protection diagrams, interlocking diagrams, AC and DC drawings, calculations, control and protection panel drawings, IED configurations, cabling and bills of materials.

- Provide technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.

- Provide technical support during pre-FAT and FAT stage, handling installation and commissioning activities. Prepare project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.

- Participate in testing and commissioning.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project manager, design (Lead, Primary, Civil and commissioning), planner, quality assurance, and supply chain, to ensure seamless project integration and successful outcomes in international project environment.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and encouraging employee involvement in problem-solving and process enhancement.

- Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Finnish or Swedish.

- Demonstrated proactivity, results orientation, strong interpersonal and teamwork abilities.

- Willingness to participate in international projects.

- Willingness to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.

- Previous experience in engineering work related to high and medium voltage substations is considered an asset.

- Experience in design software such as E3, AutoCAD, PCM600 is considered as an advantage.

- Understanding of substation control and protection systems is also considered beneficial.

jobs.title: S-Päällikkö-valmennus, Varsinais-Suomi, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
TURKU

Kasva päälliköksi ihan tavallisissa töissä – epätavallisen hyvässä porukassa!
Haluaisitko rakentaa uran kaupan tai ravintola-alan esihenkilönä – sellaisessa työssä, jossa arki on sopivasti vauhdikasta, ihmiset ovat keskiössä ja pääset oppimaan tekemällä?

Haemme nyt viittä S-Päällikkö-valmennettavaa kasvamaan tulosvastuullisiksi päälliköiksi Turun Osuuskauppaan. Valmennettavat työllistyvät kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, ja noin puolentoista vuoden mittainen valmennus alkaa 24.11.2026. Valmennuksen aikana saat vahvat valmiudet esihenkilötehtäviin sekä liiketoiminnan ja ihan tavallisen arjen johtamiseen.

Tässä haussa kaupan alan tehtävät sijoittuvat market-toimialalle eli Saleihin, S-marketeihin ja Prismoihin. Ravintola-alalla haemme valmennettavia ensisijaisesti nopean syömisen yksiköihin, kuten lounaskahviloihin ja Hesburgereihin.

Mitä S-Päällikkö-valmennus sisältää?

S-Päällikkö-valmennus yhdistää käytännön työssäoppimisen ja liiketoimintaosaamisen kehittämisen. Valmennuksen aikana työskentelet Turun Osuuskaupan eri yksiköissä Varsinais-Suomen alueella ja pääset tutustumaan toimialasi arkeen ihan käytännössä. Valmennus edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa sekä arkisin että viikonloppuisin toimipaikkojen työvuorojen mukaisesti. Meillä päälliköt eivät johda vain toimistosta käsin, vaan ovat mukana siellä missä tapahtuu: asiakkaiden, tuotteiden, annosten, tiimin ja päivän pienten säätöjen keskellä.

Työssäoppimisen aikana pääset palvelemaan asiakkaita, kehittämään yksikön toimintaa, huolehtimaan myyntikuntoisuudesta sekä osallistumaan liiketoiminnan päivittäiseen johtamiseen. Välillä on rauhallisempaa, välillä päivät ovat vauhdikkaita, mutta juuri siinä tavallisessa arjessa opitaan, miten hyvä työpäivä, toimiva tiimi ja tuloksellinen liiketoiminta rakennetaan.

Valmennus suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti aiemman kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella. Jokaiselle valmennettavalle nimetään henkilökohtainen tuutori, joka toimii esihenkilönäsi, tukee oppimistasi ja auttaa rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopivan kehittymispolun.

Valmennus toteutetaan yhteistyössä Jollas Instituutin kanssa. Käytännön työn lisäksi osallistut lähijaksoille yhdessä muiden alueosuuskauppojen valmennettavien kanssa, suoritat verkko-opintoja ja oppimistehtäviä sekä toteutat projektityön. Näin saat monipuolisen näkemyksen niin omasta toimialastasi kuin koko S-ryhmän liiketoiminnasta.

Valmennuksen hyödyt valmennettaville
Saat kokonaisvaltaisen käsityksen toimialasi liiketoiminnasta ja opit katsomaan arkea myös lukujen, tavoitteiden ja toimintaympäristön kautta.

Pääset työssäoppimisjaksojen kautta kehittämään yksiköiden ja henkilöstön toimintaa ihan oikeassa arjessa.

Ymmärrät esihenkilötyön kokonaiskuvan ja saat valmiudet toimia esihenkilöroolissa Turun Osuuskaupassa.

Verkostoidut S-ryhmän ammattilaisten kanssa ja saat hyvän käsityksen S-ryhmän liiketoimintakokonaisuudesta.


Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen, Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut, ePassi-edun sekä mahdollisuuden henkilöstörahastoon. Tehtävän palkkaus on 2552 € kuukaudessa. Lisäksi kuulut tulospalkitsemisen piiriin, joka antaa mahdollisuuden ansaita lisäpalkkiota tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta. Ihan tavallisia töitä siis – mutta epätavallisen hyvillä eduilla ja mahdollisuuksilla kasvaa.

Millaisia valmennettavia etsimme?

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinua innostavat asiakaspalvelu, myynti, liiketoiminta ja tavoitteellinen työskentely. Työskentelyotteesi on aktiivinen ja rohkea, ja tartut ennakkoluulottomasti uusiin haasteisiin. Viihdyt ihmisten parissa, rakennat luottamusta ja yhteistyötä ympärilläsi sekä toimit sujuvasti monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä.

Et säikähdä sitä, että päällikön työssä arki on välillä hyllytystä, tarjoilua, asiakaspalvelua, organisointia, palautteenantoa, kiirepiikkejä ja pieniä yllätyksiä. Meillä arvostetaan sitä, että asioihin tartutaan, työkaveria autetaan ja hommat hoidetaan yhdessä maaliin.
Lisäksi sinulla on soveltuva AMK-tutkinto tai olet valmistumassa lähiaikoina, ja pystyt työskentelemään sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Odotamme, että sinulla onjo jonkin verran kokemusta työelämästä ja ymmärrystä työyhteisössä toimimisesta. Aiempi kokemus kaupan tai ravintola-alalta on eduksi, mutta meille tärkeintä ovat oikea asenne, oppimishalukkuus ja potentiaali kehittyä tulevaisuuden päälliköksi.

Kiinnostuitko? Sitten hakemaan!

Jos ihan tavalliset työt ja epätavallisen hyvä kasvupolku päällikkötehtäviin houkuttavat, lähetä hakemuksesi S-Päällikkö-valmennukseen 30.8. mennessä. Kerro hakemuksessasi, mikä motivoi sinua hakemaan valmennukseen, ja liitä mukaan CV:si.

Rekrytointiprosessi sisältää ryhmä- ja yksilöhaastattelun. Haastatteluista jatkoon etenevät ehdokkaat suorittavat henkilöarvioinnin.

Jäikö jokin mietityttämään? Tuutorit ja nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava vastaavat mielellään kysymyksiisi arkisin klo 9–15 välillä.

Kaupan alan tuutori:
Prismajohtaja Piia Laine puh. 010 764 4033

Matkailu- ja ravitsemuskaupan tuutori:
Ryhmäpäällikkö Katja Honkanen puh. 010 764 4219

Nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava:
Emil Gustafsson puh. 050400 0506

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Research Fundraiser  80% - 100%
jobs.description:
Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
Eawag is currently developing its institutional fundraising activities to strengthen support for research, infrastructure, and strategic initiatives. To drive these efforts and foster meaningful engagement with philanthropic and funding partners, we are looking for a dedicated  
Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Would you like to help shape the fundraising activities of an internationally renowned environmental research institute? As part of the ETH Domain, Eawag offers a unique opportunity to build and further develop institutional fundraising in a collaborative and purpose\-driven environment. You will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop sustainable funding partnerships with foundations, institutional funding organisations, philanthropic partners and selected major donors. Working closely with researchers, the Directorate and the Communications team, you will develop compelling funding concepts that communicate Eawag's scientific strengths and strategic objectives in a clear and attractive way to funding partners  
This position offers you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy, as well as the opportunity to actively shape Eawag's fundraising activities and strategic partnerships.  
Your responsibilities  
Conduct research, analysis and identification of potential funding partners, in particular foundations and private major donors.  
Assess and evaluate research projects regarding their fundraising potential.  
Work closely with researchers to develop audience\-specific fundraising materials, such as funding cases, project proposals and progress reports.  
Build and maintain long\-term relationships with funding partners and donors, support the acquisition of new partners and manage funding partnerships throughout the entire funding cycle.  
Manage administrative fundraising processes, including contract management, payment processing and maintenance of data in the CRM system.  
In close collaboration with the Communications team, plan and coordinate visits and events for existing and potential funding partners and develop fundraising\-specific content for Eawag's communication channels.  
Your qualifications  
At least five years of professional experience in fundraising, ideally in foundation fundraising, institutional fundraising or major donor fundraising.  
Proven track record in developing successful funding proposals as well as establishing and maintaining long\-term funding partnerships.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with a strong service\-oriented mindset. You build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and collaborate effectively with different research groups.  
A structured and independent working style, with strong organisational skills.  
A strong interest in scientific topics, particularly environmental research; experience in research, higher education, environmental sustainability or healthcare is an advantage.  
Confident use of common digital tools, including CRM systems.  
You have excellent command of German or French and good knowledge of the other language. You are fluent in English at a professional level and able to communicate and negotiate confidently.  
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.

jobs.description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Senior Consultant \- Assurance \- Technology Risk  
The opportunity  
Our Consulting business offers a broad range of functional and cross\-country services dedicated to providing high\-value and trusted advice to clients, with a specific focus on business transformation programs.  
Your key responsibilities  
You will gain insights into cutting\-edge IT environments and into our global methodology. Your focus: analysis, evaluation and optimization of processes, structures and systems  
As a member of interdisciplinary specialist teams, you will audit operational IT systems and information portals with regard to internal control and risk and compliance management. This includes migration tests, third party attestation \& certification, IT risk assessments, information security assessments and data analytics/information management

jobs.title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
jobs.description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

jobs.title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently

Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Analyser les plans, les dossiers d'exécution et les spécificités liées aux bâtiments existants.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences techniques.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux, les mandataires et les partenaires du projet.

Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.  
Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution.

Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à réaliser des projets d'envergure, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés dans le domaine du terrassement et des infrastructures. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de terrassement, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents intervenants.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux et équipements nécessaires.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais et des coûts.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine du terrassement.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.

November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.

Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.

Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.  
Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.  
Verantwortung für interne und externe Payroll\-Audits als zentrale Ansprechperson seitens HR sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten und korrekten Bereitstellung von Dokumentationen, Daten und Abstimmungen.

Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in Kombination mit einem Diplom als «HR Fachmann / Fachfrau» oder «Sozialversicherungsfachmann / Sozialversicherungsfachfrau» oder Payroll Experte.  
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung in SAP HCM.  
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Sozialversicherungs\-, Steuer\- und Arbeitsrecht.  
Gute Kenntnisse in Workday und SAP HCM.  
Sehr gute Excel\-Kenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten für Payroll\-Reporting, Abstimmungen und Datenvalidierungen.  
Hohe Genauigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.  
Fähigkeit, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen, Verbesserungsinitiativen voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen pragmatisch umzusetzen.  
Dienstleistungsorientierte, proaktive und selbständige Arbeitsweise.

Kantine.

modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.  
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.  
Home\-Office\-Möglichkeiten.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
In this role, you will join Accelleron on a 10\-month maternity leave cover assignment, ideally starting on November 1, and independently manage Swiss payroll operations for more than 1,000 employees. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle while acting as the subject expert for payroll, time \& absence, social security and tax matters. jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Private PA to the Chairman & CEO
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant \& Private PA to the Chairman \& CEO  
About the Company  
A privately owned investment holding based in Zurich. Through its operating companies, it develops strategic resources at origin, alongside proprietary investments in emerging technologies.  
The Zurich team is small and senior, with short decision paths — this role has direct visibility and impact.  
We are looking for an organized, responsible, and proactive assistant who combines classic executive assistance to our Chairman \& CEO with corporate and office support for the Zurich team — and, distinctively, with private and family support for the principal. This is a true right\-hand role spanning both the professional and private spheres, suited to someone who enjoys variety, takes genuine ownership, and treats discretion as second nature.  
Key Responsibilities  
Executive Assistance to the CEO  
Book and manage international travel (flights, hotels, visas), both European and global  
Proactively manage the CEO's calendar across time zones, anticipating conflicts and protecting focus time  
Prepare meeting briefings, agendas, and follow\-ups; track action items to completion  
Track and process expenses per the group's expense policy  
Act as first point of contact for the CEO's calendar and correspondence, exercising sound judgment on prioritization and access  
Corporate \& Governance Support  
Support board meeting logistics (scheduling, board packs, resolutions)  
Maintain document retention and archiving across group entities  
Track statutory and filing deadlines  
Liaise with external providers (fiduciary, insurance broker, external counsel, banks) on administrative matters  
Private \& Family Support  
Schedule and track personal appointments for the principal and family (medical, dental, and similar), including reminders and follow\-ups  
Coordinate children's school administration and communications, extracurricular activities, and related logistics — largely in German  
Plan and book private and family travel and holidays  
Handle household administration: insurance policies, vehicle matters (registration, servicing, appointments), property\-related paperwork, and coordination of contractors and service providers  
Manage personal errands, purchases, gifting, and restaurant and event reservations  
Serve as a reliable point of coordination between the office, the household, and the family  
Office Management \& Cross\-Jurisdictional Coordination  
Support day\-to\-day operations of the Zurich office (supplies, facilities, visitors, mail)  
Assist with administrative coordination across the group's international entities  
Candidate Profile  
Required  
Experience as a Personal/Executive Assistant, Private PA, or in a comparable role supporting senior leadership, a principal, or a family  
Fluent English and German (written and spoken) — German is essential for schools, medical providers, and Swiss administration  
Experience organizing complex international travel  
High discretion; able to handle confidential legal, HR, financial, family, and household information responsibly  
Comfortable working closely with a family as well as an executive team, and able to move naturally between the two  
Proactive, hands\-on, solutions\-oriented; comfortable in a small, lean team without heavy bureaucracy  
Strong MS Office skills; comfortable learning new tools  
Valid Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship  
Advantageous  
Prior experience in a family office, private household, or entrepreneur\-led environment  
Familiarity with the Swiss school system and local administrative processes  
Additional languages (e.g., French)  
Working Arrangements  
This is an on\-site role based in central Zurich during normal office hours. Given the private\-support dimension, occasional flexibility outside standard hours is expected for time\-sensitive personal or travel matters; this is managed reasonably and reciprocated with flexibility in return.  
What We Offer  
Direct, daily exposure to the Chairman/CEO, the COO, and board\-level operations in an entrepreneurial, international holding group  
A genuinely varied role combining classic PA/EA work, corporate operations exposure, and private/family support  
A position of real trust with meaningful autonomy and short decision paths  
A small, senior, non\-bureaucratic team  
Central Zurich office location  
Competitive compensation, commensurate with the breadth and seniority of the role  
How to Apply  
Please submit your CV and a short cover note via this platform. The employer is not named at this stage for reasons of strategic confidentiality. Full company details will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates before the interview process.  
We are an equal opportunity employer and treat all applications in strict confidence. jpidc09433ejm jit0833jm jiy26jm
