jobs.title: Human Factors Engineer & Service Lead
jobs.description:
At Ypsomed, we are shaping the future of medical technology together \- with the aim of sustainably improving the quality of life for people with chronic conditions. We promote an open corporate culture in which diversity is valued, and new perspectives are welcome. Our employees take responsibility, work in an interdisciplinary manner and develop innovative solutions with real added value for society.  
As our Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead, you will build and grow Ypsomed's Human Factors service offering for pharmaceutical partners worldwide. You will advise customers on Human Factors strategies, lead international HF programs, and contribute to innovative combination products. With your expertise, you will help deliver user\-centered solutions that support successful regulatory approvals.  
Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead \| 80 \- 100%  
Ref. No. 7961  
Location: Burgdorf \| Hybrid  
Your main tasks  
Take end\-to\-end responsibility for establishing Human Factors (HF) as a service offering and drive the acquisition of HF service projects in close collaboration with Business Development  
Act as a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical customers on HF strategies for combination products, with a strong focus on efficient regulatory pathways and ensuring that service offerings are aligned with customer needs  
Conduct and coordinate international HF studies, including setting timelines and budgets and planning, monitoring, and documenting formative, summative, and comparative use HF studies, including studies involving large participant cohorts  
Manage external consultants, vendors, and testing facilities as required  
Lead or support HF activities related to Instructions for Use (IFU) and user interfaces as part of the overall HF program  
Create, maintain, and review usability engineering documentation required for regulatory submissions, such as study reports, HF reports, and threshold analyses, in close collaboration with customer teams and internal stakeholders  
Collaborate closely within the Science \& Evidence team to translate insights from HF studies and user populations into strategic publications, evidence\-generation activities, and market differentiation  
Stay current with the global HF regulatory landscape and contribute to shaping Ypsomed’s position in collaboration with industry bodies and consortium representatives  
Your profile  
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Usability Engineering, Product Design, Psychology, or a related field, combined with at least 7 years of professional experience as a Human Factors consultant, including experience within the combination product or related medical device industry  
An entrepreneurial mindset, a strong sense of ownership, strong business acumen, and a clear understanding of how to develop, position, and scale value\-adding service offerings in a customer\-focused environment  
Extensive hands\-on experience in planning, conducting, and documenting large\-scale Human Factors studies for medical devices and/or combination products, as well as strong project management skills and proven experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously  
Experience with international development programs and regulatory submissions across key markets, including the United States (FDA), the European Union (EU MDR), China (NMPA), and Canada (Health Canada)  
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with English proficiency at C1 level or above; German is an asset. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures in diverse, international environments  
Willingness to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time, including to the United States; authorization to travel to the United States is therefore required  
Ypsomed \- making the treatment of chronic diseases possible  
More than 2,000 employees worldwide develop and produce injection and infusion systems for self\-medication with the Ypsomed Group. We are a successful, rapidly growing, family\-owned company headquartered in Burgdorf (CH) with various production sites and subsidiaries around the world. With our market\-leading products and solutions, we enable people all over the globe to self\-treatment. Despite chronic diseases such as diabetes, obesity, or certain types of cancer, they are provided with the greatest possible quality of life.

Workforce Acquisition \& Engagement Partner  
Your future place of work

jobs.description:
Our Corporate Treasury Transformation Team is looking for a highly motivated colleague to join the team.  
Senior Consultant \- Treasury Transformation Advisory  
Discover KPMG – Become part of our team  
With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose\-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.  
Senior Consultant \- Treasury Transformation Advisory  
Location: Zurich  
Workload: 100%  
Start Date: By agreement  
Support Treasury Transformation projects by preparing analyses, models and presentation materials  
Assist in mapping and improving cash management, payments, liquidity forecasting and FX processes  
Help design and document In\-House Bank and Payment Factory concepts with guidance from senior team members  
Contribute to TMS activities (Kyriba, SAP, FIS): requirements gathering, testing, data preparation and training materials  
Build business cases and simple ROI calculations with clear assumptions  
Support the design and improvement of cash flow forecasting and FX risk management processes, including exposure identification, forecasting logic, data quality, governance and management reporting  
Coordinate meetings and follow\-ups with clients, banks and internal teams  
Take ownership of defined work packages and grow into increasing responsibility  
Your contribution to KPMG  
This is what makes you successful  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering or similar  
2 \- 4 years of experience in finance, treasury, banking or consulting (internships included)  
Strong analytical skills; confident with Excel and PowerPoint; basics knowledge of data tools (e.g., PowerBI, SQL or ) are a plus  
Curiosity for Treasury Transformation, cash management, payments and FX  
Structured, reliable and proactive; comfortable communicating with stakeholders  
Fluent in English; German or French is a plus  
Eligibility to work in Switzerland; willingness to travel occasionally  
Team player mindset with a desire to learn and pursue certifications (e.g., ACT, TMS)  
Your benefits  
Unlock Your Potential  
We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future\-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  
Grow at KPMG  
Mentoring and Networking  
At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  
From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.  
Flexible Working  
With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  
Work at KPMG  
Additional Benefits  
Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.  
Generous Parental Leave  
We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.  
Inspired by Innovation  
At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.  
An inclusive culture  
Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  
Values \& Culture  
Health \& Wellbeing  
We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self\-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities\-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.  
Pension Fund  
We offer above\-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.  
Our Commitment  
Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.

jobs.description:
Events Planning Manager  
People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:  
This is what you move with us  
Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high\-profile business events and bespoke celebrations \- across two of the most distinguished houses in Switzerland. As Events Planning Manager, you guide the entire planning journey from proposal through to operational handover, ensuring that every event is accurately planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina.  
Your Mission:  
End\-to\-End Event Planning: From the qualified enquiry through proposal and contract to the operational handover \- including accommodation, meeting rooms, catering, technical requirements and personal guest preferences.  
Client Experience: You guide your clients through every stage of the planning process: briefings, site inspections, amendments and professional follow\-up \- always prompt, polished and personalised.  
Administrative Excellence: Preparation of contracts, confirmations, function sheets and Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), maintenance of all event files in PMS and CRM, and monitoring of deposits and payment schedules.  
Operational Interface: You lead the internal event planning meetings and liaise closely with Banqueting, Kitchen, Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management and Front Office across both hotels.  
Leadership \& Development: You lead and coach our Events Coordinator(s) day to day, set priorities and establish shared planning standards, templates and processes.  
Room to Shape: You play an active part in building the new integrated Events organisation of the Kulm Group and develop best practices for both hotels.  
This is you  
Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Events Management or Business Administration and at least three years of experience in hotel events, conference services or event planning, ideally covering meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment.  
Organisational Talent: Outstanding attention to detail, a sure instinct for priorities and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously with composure.  
Process \& Systems Knowledge: Confident command of PMS, CRM and event management systems, along with excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills.  
Personality: Dependable, solution\-oriented and calm under pressure; you build lasting relationships with clients and with every operational department.  
Language Skills: Fluent and stylistically assured German and English, written and spoken; further languages are a plus.  
Start: October or by agreement.  
If you would like to shape the future of Events at the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your full application.

Verantwortung für Ausschreibungen, Vergaben, Nachtragsmanagement sowie Projektabrechnungen  
Baustellencontrolling, Rapportwesen sowie laufendes Kosten\- und Qualitätsmanagement  
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits\-, Qualitäts\- und Umweltvorschriften  
Pflege bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie aktive Unterstützung bei der Akquisition neuer Projekte

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bauwesen (z. B. Dipl. Bauleiter, Techniker HF, Bauführer SBA, Bauingenieur FH oder Architekt FH)

Erfahrung in der Beratung von Bauherrschaften sowie in der Erstellung von Kostenschätzungen, Kostenvoranschlägen und Offerten  
Unternehmerisches Denken sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kosten\- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

Gute Kenntnisse der SIA\-Normen sowie der Bauadministration (z. B. Messerli oder MS Megabau)

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
Application Deadline: August 26, 2026\.  
Department: DFAT \- Geneva.  
Employment Type: Permanent \- Full Time.  
Location: Australian Permanent Mission, Geneva  
Workplace: Onsite  
Compensation and Benefits: CHF 95,784 / yeat, 20 days annual leave, 50% employer contribution to health insurance and accident insurance, and to a retirement fund.  
Applications are sought from persons interested in employment within the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
The successful applicant will be engaged as a locally engaged staff member by the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
Please be advised that the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva does not assist with relocation. Any costs associated with taking up the position would be the responsibility of the successful candidate.  
A standard probity check will be undertaken prior to commencement for the successful applicant.  
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.  
The Fair Work Act 2009 is not intended to apply to the employment of Locally Engaged Staff (LES) at Australia’s overseas diplomatic and consular missions. The successful candidate’s terms and conditions of employment will be governed by the laws of Switzerland.  
The Human Resources Section based in the Australian High Commission, London is responsible for managing all recruitment processes across the European region. To apply, please click here . Please direct any other queries by writing an Write an email.

jobs.title: Femme / Valet de Chambre
jobs.description:
Intitulé du poste:  Femme / Valet de Chambre
Département : Housekeeping
Supérieur hiérarchique: Gouvernante et Property Manager.
Lieu de travail: Établissement hôtelier de luxe – Hôtel 5 étoiles, résidences privées et chalets de prestige.
Type de contrat
•    CDD saisonnier
•    Temps plein
•    Horaires variables incluant les week-ends, jours fériés et périodes de forte activité
Mission du poste
La Femme / le Valet de Chambre est responsable de l'entretien, du nettoyage et de la remise en état des chambres, suites, appartements, chalets et espaces privatifs confiés, dans le respect des standards de qualité de l'établissement. Il/elle veille à offrir aux clients un environnement irréprochable, confortable et accueillant, tout en garantissant la discrétion, la confidentialité et un service d'excellence.
Responsabilités principales
Entretien des chambres et espaces privatifs
•    Assurer le nettoyage complet des chambres, suites, appartements et chalets selon les standards de l'établissement.
•    Effectuer les remises à blanc et les recouches.
•    Nettoyer et désinfecter les salles de bains.
•    Changer le linge de lit, le linge de bain et les peignoirs.
•    Réapprovisionner les produits d'accueil, minibars, consommables et fournitures.
•    Contrôler le bon fonctionnement des équipements et signaler toute anomalie technique.
Qualité et standards de luxe
•    Garantir une qualité de nettoyage irréprochable jusque dans les moindres détails.
•    Respecter les standards de présentation définis par l'établissement.
•    Préparer les chambres selon les demandes spécifiques des clients (VIP, anniversaires, demandes particulières, etc.).
•    Vérifier que chaque chambre est prête à accueillir les clients dans les meilleures conditions.
Gestion du linge et du matériel
•    Utiliser correctement les produits de nettoyage et les équipements mis à disposition.
•    Veiller au bon entretien du matériel de travail.
•    Réapprovisionner quotidiennement son chariot de service.
•    Gérer le linge sale et le linge propre selon les procédures internes.
•    Respecter les procédures de gestion des objets trouvés.
Hygiène, sécurité et environnement
•    Respecter les normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et les procédures internes.
•    Utiliser les produits d'entretien conformément aux recommandations.
•    Respecter les consignes relatives au tri des déchets et aux démarches environnementales de l'établissement.
•    Maintenir les offices, réserves et locaux Housekeeping propres et organisés.
Relation client
•    Saluer les clients avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.
•    Répondre aux demandes simples des clients ou les orienter vers le service compétent.
•    Faire preuve de discrétion et respecter strictement la confidentialité des informations concernant les clients.
•    Représenter en permanence les valeurs et l'image de l'établissement.
Travail en équipe
•    Collaborer avec les Gouvernantes, la Réception, la Maintenance, le Spa, le Room Service et les autres départements.
•    Participer aux briefings quotidiens.
•    Informer immédiatement sa hiérarchie de toute anomalie ou situation particulière.
Profil recherché
Formation
•    Formation en hôtellerie ou Housekeeping appréciée.
•    Une formation interne peut être assurée.
Expérience
•    Expérience d'au moins 1 an dans un poste similaire souhaitée.
•    Une expérience en hôtellerie de luxe (4 ou 5 étoiles), palaces ou résidences de prestige constitue un atout majeur.
Compétences techniques
•    Maîtrise des techniques de nettoyage hôtelier.
•    Bonne connaissance des produits d'entretien.
•    Connaissance des standards de qualité de l'hôtellerie de luxe.
•    Capacité à organiser efficacement son travail.
•    Respect strict des procédures internes.
Compétences personnelles
•    Sens aigu du détail.
•    Excellente organisation.
•    Discrétion et confidentialité.
•    Rigueur.
•    Rapidité d'exécution.
•    Sens du service.
•    Polyvalence.
•    Esprit d'équipe.
•    Bonne condition physique.
•    Gestion du temps et des priorités.
Langues
•    Une connaissance du français ou de l'anglais est souhaitée.

jobs.title: Social Media & Community Engagement Officer
jobs.description:
Join MSF OCG as a Social Media & Community Engagement Officer in Geneva!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
The mission is to develop and implement MSF Switzerland's organic social media approach for French-speaking audiences, strengthening audience engagement and supporting broader digital supporter journeys. Ensure social media channels contribute to awareness, engagement, advocacy and supporter acquisition through relevant content, community engagement and platform-specific practices.

Tasks & Responsibilities
Define and implement the organic social media approach : define and implement the organic social media strategy for French-speaking audiences, ensuring channel priorities, editorial choices and audience engagement support MSF Switzerland's digital engagement objectives.
Develop and maintain social media standards and playbooks: develop and continuously improve platform-specific playbooks, editorial standards and community engagement practices to ensure consistency, quality and effective use of social media channels.
Lead social media editorial planning and content adaptation: lead the planning, adaptation and editorial framing of social media content, ensuring messages are relevant, accessible and aligned with audience needs, organisational priorities and platform requirements.
Monitor and optimise social media performance: in collaboration with the digital analyst, analyse performance data, audience insights and engagement trends to identify opportunities, improve content effectiveness and refine social media approaches.
Manage and strengthen online communities: manage community engagement across priority social media channels, fostering meaningful interactions and encouraging audiences to take appropriate actions within the broader digital engagement journey.
Coordinate digital initiatives: coordinate and contribute to digital projects, campaigns and activations, ensuring alignment between social media activities and wider digital communication objectives.
Contribute to digital innovation and knowledge sharing: identify emerging trends, platform developments and best practices, translating insights into recommendations that enhance digital engagement activities and organisational learning.
Supervise and support the Digital Engagement Unit intern: supervise, guide and develop the French-speaking Digital Engagement Unit intern, ensuring quality delivery, skill development and alignment with team priorities.

Your profile
Education
Bachelor's degree in digital communication, digital marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience
Experience in digital communication with a focus on social media management.
Experience developing and implementing organic social media strategies, editorial planning and platform-specific content approaches.
Experience engaging online audiences and supporting digital engagement objectives.
Experience contributing to cross-functional projects and campaigns.
Experience supporting or supervising junior contributors is an asset

Languages
French : fluency.
English : C1.
German is an asset (B1).

Skills/ Technical competencies
Knowledge of organic social media management, particularly Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Understanding of audience engagement, content performance and social media analytics.
Understanding of platform trends, content formats and community management practices.
Awareness of humanitarian communication principles and sensitive operational contexts.
Editorial judgement and content adaptation.
Audience engagement and relationship building.
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Planning and project coordination.
Collaboration and stakeholder management.
Adaptability in changing environments.
Creativity and trends adaptation.

Terms of employment
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
Open-ended contract
Working place: Geneva
Ideal start date: October 2026
Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is September  6th, 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det "senere" sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Hvorfor vælge udlandet som din nye start?
Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Mange virksomheder tilbyder oplæring, betalt ferie og interne udviklingsprogrammer, så du kan vokse i jobbet.

Praktiske overvejelser:

Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

jobs.title: GENOPSLAG – Administrativ pædagogisk konsulent søges til Enfamilie – 37 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
Vi genopslår stillingen og søger fortsat den rette kollega til Enfamilie.

Har du en socialfaglig forståelse, er du stærk på skrift, og trives du med at skabe struktur, kvalitet og overblik? Så kan det være dig, vi søger som vores nye administrative pædagogiske konsulent.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen og kombinerer socialfaglig kvalitetssikring med administrative og koordinerende opgaver.

Om stillingen

Som administrativ pædagogisk konsulent får du en central rolle i Enfamilies daglige arbejde. Du skal understøtte den socialfaglige kvalitet og samtidig være med til at sikre, at dokumentation, registrering, planlægning og administrative arbejdsgange fungerer i praksis.

Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med både ledelsen og vores socialfaglige konsulenter.

En væsentlig del af stillingen handler om skriftlig socialfaglig dokumentation. Du skal derfor kunne læse kritisk, formulere dig præcist og have blik for forskellen mellem konkrete observationer og faglige vurderinger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være

  • Kvalitetssikring af samværsbeskrivelser.

  • Udarbejdelse af statusrapporter på baggrund af den samlede dokumentation.

  • Udarbejdelse af underretninger på baggrund af observationer og dokumentation.

  • Kvalitetssikring af socialfaglige formuleringer, objektivitet, grammatik og sprog.

  • Planlægning og opdatering af vagter i Planday.

  • Udarbejdelse og opdatering af samværsplaner.

  • Kalenderstyring og koordinering.

  • Opdatering og dokumenthåndtering i Sofus.

  • Booking og koordinering af samværslokaler.

  • Udarbejdelse og opdatering af interne procesbeskrivelser.

  • Administrativ opfølgning på sager.

  • Koordinering mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

  • Udvikling af skabeloner og optimering af administrative arbejdsgange.

  • Diverse administrative og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

Har en pædagogisk, socialfaglig eller anden relevant faglig baggrund og gerne erfaring med socialfagligt arbejde og dokumentation.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • er stærk skriftligt og kan formulere dig fagligt, præcist og professionelt

  • har forståelse for socialfaglig dokumentation

  • kan skelne mellem observationer, vurderinger og antagelser

  • har sans for detaljer uden at miste det samlede overblik

  • arbejder struktureret og systematisk

  • følger op på dine opgaver og tager ansvar for, at de bliver afsluttet

  • kan håndtere flere forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsdag

  • trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde

  • er fortrolig med IT og har let ved at lære nye systemer.

Erfaring med eksempelvis samværsbeskrivelser, statusrapporter, underretninger eller andet socialfagligt skriftligt arbejde vil være en fordel.

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

Du får en alsidig stilling, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af Enfamilies daglige drift og kvalitetssikring.

Vi arbejder med børn og familier, og derfor er faglighed, ordentlighed og kvalitet i dokumentationen afgørende for os.

Samtidig søger vi en kollega, som har lyst til at bidrage til struktur, gode arbejdsgange og et godt samarbejde i hverdagen.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen.

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til info@enfamilie.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan Enfamilie kontaktes på 22 85 98 33.

Læs mere på www.enfamilie.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Ny centerleder til Ilskov Hallen
jobs.description:
Vi mangler en ny centerleder i Ilskov Hallen

er det dig?

Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for idræt, fællesskab og lokale aktiviteter i Ilskov? Som centerleder får du ansvaret for, at Ilskov Hallen fortsat er et velfungerende samlingspunkt for byens borgere, foreninger og gæster.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

-Drift og vedligehold: Dagligt tilsyn med hallen, rengøring, klargøring, mindre reparationer og opfølgning på fejl og mangler.

-Administration: Håndtering af bookinger, udlejning, fakturering og kontakt til brugere og foreninger.

-Udendørs og praktiske opgaver: Ansvar for udearealer og løbende vedligehold.

-Arrangementer: Planlægning, koordinering og afvikling af arrangementer i Ilskov Hallen.

-Samarbejde: Tæt samarbejde med halbestyrelsen, foreningerne, skolen, daginstitutionen og øvrige brugere af hallen.

 

Vi forventer

-Du er imødekommende, serviceminded og god til mennesker.

-Du arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt.

-Du kan planlægge og strukturere din egen arbejdsuge. Som udgangspunkt fordeles arbejdstiden på hverdage fra mandag til fredag, men der kan forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde i forbindelse med arrangementer og aktiviteter.

-Du trives i mødet med mennesker i alle aldre – fra de yngste brugere til de ældre – og møder alle med et smil og god service.

-Du behersker dansk i skrift og tale.

-Du har almindelige IT-færdigheder og er fortrolig med at arbejde på computer. Vi bruger Conventus til bookinger, men kendskab til systemet er ikke en forudsætning – du vil naturligvis blive oplært. Kontrakter og fakturering foregår ligeledes digitalt.

 

Vi tilbyder

-Et tæt samarbejde med halbestyrelsen og foreningerne i Ilskov.

-En central rolle i lokalsamfundet.

-En varieret og alsidig hverdag.

-Et selvstændigt job med stor frihed under ansvar.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Mail: rene@mt-aps.dk

 

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Ilskov Hallen, Mølleskovvej 3, 7451 Sunds.
Ansættelse: 25-30 timer ugentligt eller efter nærmere aftale.
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.
Ansøgningsfrist: 31. august 2026. Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at ansætte den rette kandidat, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

**English skills are a plus.**

- a job for the full winter season, from **November 2026 until the end of March 2027**

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each otherâs company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions. 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, acting as a central hub across leadership, ensuring seamless execution of executive priorities, governance processes, internal workflows, and organizational operations. The incumbent is expected to anticipate needs, proactively improve systems, and drive efficiency across tools, processes, and leadership workflows. 

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs. 

\n


What you will do

Executive & Leadership Support

Financial & Operational Support

  • Liaise with Finance as required to ensure timely and accurate processing of financial documentation  

 

Office & Operational Management

What you have

Education

What's in it for you?

jobs.title: Autolakerer til opstart af ny afdeling i Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.description:
Job Description â Billing Officer

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Reporting To: Finance Manager / Accounts Manager

Experience: 2â4 years in billing, invoicing, or accounts-related roles

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, bills, credit notes, debit notes, and related billing documents.
  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and billing procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple invoices and deadlines efficiently.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as Tally, SAP, Odoo, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of VAT, TDS, and other applicable tax-related billing requirements.
  • Experience in handling high-volume billing operations.
  • Good understanding of sales, inventory, and accounts receivable processes.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical & Analytical Ability
  • Time Management
  • Problem-Solving
  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of invoice generation
  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

About the Role

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic.   • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing & Communications
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Marketing & Communications to tell the garden3d story across the internet, from wherever in the world you happen to be.

More details if you check our original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development

At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index Space — Community

A network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK — Media

At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations
https://www.thelightphone.com/
https://www.mill.com/
https://www.ingredient-ai.com/

The Head of Marketing & Communications Role

The garden3d Head of Marketing & Communications has one mandate: make sure everything we put on the internet is compelling and interesting. garden3d is a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and each needs its own voice, its own audience, and its own drumbeat of work worth sharing. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person decides what we make, where it runs, and whether it clears our bar.

 

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our studios, spaces and people gravitate around New York, so there's some pull to be here, and a good part of this job is noticing what's happening in our world and turning it into content. But we already work across timezones, and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

 

This role will interface with studio leads, designers, developers, editors, animators, photographers, community managers, event producers and ad platforms across every garden3d vertical.

Simply, this person can easily context shift between our massively diverse set of workstreams, find the most compelling stories, and get them produced at an exceedingly high bar.

 

This person owns our channels end to end: the garden3d Substack, our podcast, Instagram, X, and the paid accounts behind them. They collab with our team, and a rotating cast of freelance editors, designers and animators, and they run the calendar that keeps a dozen workstreams shipping on time. They think in PESO terms (paid, earned, shared, owned) with the weight on shared and owned media - paid is a tool they use deliberately, and traditional press is a bonus, but not generally where we focus.

 

The ambition runs past marketing a services business. garden3d TK is our young experimental media company, and this role is its engine: books, screenplays, music, media, activations: a record label for ideas. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, a network of community spaces and an open P&L and sees the best content brief on the internet.

 

Responsibilities & Mandates

‍Quality never less than 8/10

We aspire for 10/10, celebrate 9/10 and never publish anything that’s not an 8/10 - visually, narratively, and in production quality. This person holds that bar across every post, video, essay and episode on every vertical, and would rather kill a piece than let a 6 out the door. Their feedback makes work better and faster, without micromanaging the people who make it.

Social That Stops the Scroll

They carry a current, practitioner-level read on how each platform works right now: what arrests someone mid-scroll, how a hook earns the next three seconds, why a format lands on TikTok and dies on LinkedIn. Short-form video is a first-class craft here, not an afterthought.

️A House of Brands, Each in Its Own Voice

Sanctuary Computer doesn't sound like XXIX, and neither sounds like Index. They manage several messaging columns at once, keeping each brand's tone distinct while the umbrella story stays coherent.

Case Study Production

Every client engagement across our creative agencies should end in a case study worth reading. They own that production line - interviewing the team, shaping the narrative, art-directing the assets - and ship case studies that win each studio its next project.

️Websites That Put Our Best Foot Forward

Our websites are usually the first place a prospective client or hire meets us. They own the strategy behind every garden3d site - what it says, what work it shows, and how clearly it communicates what each studio can do - and they keep sites, decks and other collateral current as the work moves, so what people find is sharp and true.

️Editorial Ownership

The Substack, the podcast, and our transparency publications (like the open-source P&L we release every year) are theirs to run: the calendar, the standards, the growth. They capture what happens in our spaces - Index, USB Club, and the communities around them - and turn it into work worth sharing.

Producing, Paid & Distribution

They direct producers, editors and freelancers like a showrunner: briefs are clear, deadlines are real, and many workstreams move at once without dropping quality. They run paid spend on Meta, Instagram and wherever our audiences live - building audiences, running A/B/C tests on both narrative and adset, and owning budgets against results they can show.

Data-Driven Reporting & ROI

They measure what our content actually does - audience growth, engagement, leads, pipeline influenced - and report on it plainly. Paid spend, organic effort and production time all get judged on return, and next quarter's plan follows the numbers.

Presence IRL

garden3d shows up in person: events, conferences, talks, Index programming, and the dinners and openings where our world gathers. They decide which touchpoints are worth our time, get us there looking like ourselves, and bring back stories worth publishing.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The producers and creatives they direct do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is real, and the taste rubs off.

Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years 

  • Turning garden3d TK into a real experimental media brand: books, screenplays, music, and shows
  • Growing our podcast into a property with its own audience
  • Launch campaigns for new Index spaces, USB Club drops, and community programs
  • Making our annual open-source P&L release a media moment
  • Standing up a small content studio that serves all four studios' new-business pipelines
  • Building the systems (and hiring the people) that let us publish more often, while aspiring for a 10/10 content, and never dropping below an 8/10
Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 8+ years in marketing, content or brand leadership, with real time inside creative studios, agencies or founder-led companies
  • A portfolio that proves exceptional taste - visual, narrative, and tone of voice
  • A design background and/or fluency & comfort producing own visual assets at the required quality level in Figma when necessary
  • Experience owning a company's web presence: site strategy, messaging, and keeping capabilities collateral current
  • Exceptional project management: content calendars, production pipelines, many workstreams at once
  • Short-form video fluency: they've shipped work for Reels, TikTok and Shorts and can say why each piece performed
  • Extensive experience & comfort managing creatives & producers (editors, designers, animators, freelancers) and getting better work out of them than they'd make alone
  • Hands-on experience running paid social on Meta, Instagram and other platforms: audience building, budget ownership, and A/B/C testing across narrative and ad set
  • Working fluency in the PESO model, with a point of view on where paid, earned, shared and owned media each earn their keep

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience producing a brand's IRL presence: events, conferences, talks, and the follow-through that turns them into content
  • Podcast or audio production experience
  • Comfort/experience managing multiple messaging columns in a house of brands
  • Newsletter growth experience, Substack especially
  • Community & events marketing: programming, launches, IRL moments
  • Photography, motion or editing chops of their own
  • Fluency with AI production tools, plus the judgment to know when not to use them
  • A press & media network (traditional PR isn't the focus, but relationships help)
  • Experience marketing to design & engineering decision-makers at companies like our clients
  • Book publishing or long-form media experience
  • Experience growing a services business's story into a consumer-scale audience
Who you are

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators. It will begin with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $75 - $120 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. If this individual exceeds expectations by the end of the 4-month period, we'll shape a permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as our audiences and revenue do.

Finally, after a period of proven success in this role (12 - 24 months), this individual will become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

‍How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative:** Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals:** Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here.

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! We’re excited to hear from you! ❤

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Company: HinoGo Oy

Location: Tampere, Finland (Initial Hybrid transition to On-Site work in Helsinki)

Compensation: €2,200 / month

**About the Role**

HinoGo Oy is an agile startup developing a next-generation real-time roadside assistance and

mobility platform. As we actively prepare our single core product for international expansion, we

are looking for a versatile Full Stack Web & Mobile Engineer to join our development team.

Because our technical ecosystem powers a single, high-performance platform, this role requires

strong, hands-on contributions across both web and mobile layers. A central technical pillar

involves maintaining and scaling our deep custom WordPress infrastructure (custom themes,

complex plugin architecture, and advanced technical SEO) alongside our modern mobile

(Flutter) and backend stacks.

We prioritize practical problem-solving, hands-on architectural experience, and production-

shipped code over purely theoretical credentials.

**Key Responsibilities**

Advanced WordPress Architecture: Develop, maintain, and refactor custom WordPress

themes from scratch and maintain a large, complex set of custom PHP/JavaScript

plugins powering business logic and portals.

WordPress Technical SEO & Tracking: Implement and maintain deep technical SEO

architectures within WordPress (clean structure, page speed optimization, schema

markup), integrated with Google Ads API, Google Tag Manager, and conversion

tracking.

Full-Stack & Mobile Development: Build and maintain web backend/frontend services

and cross-platform mobile app features using Node.js, Python, React, and Flutter.

UI/UX to Production Code: Translate Figma wireframes and UI designs directly into

clean, performant, and responsive web and mobile components.

Workflows & AI Integration: Build robust automations using n8n and Cloudflare Workers,

while safely integrating modern AI tooling into daily pipelines and data operations.

Third-Party & API Integrations:

Payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, recurring subscriptions, Tap to Pay).

Real-time telecom workflows (e.g., Twilio for SMS/voice, Zadarma/VoIP for IVR

and PBX dispatch routing).

Server & Operations: Handle routine Linux cloud hosting environments, deployment

workflows, reporting scripts, and spatial/location-based data logic.

**Requirements**

Strong WordPress & PHP Expertise: Deep, practical experience building custom themes

and developing/maintaining large, modular custom WordPress plugins from scratch

(without relying on bloated page builders).

Strong Technical SEO for WordPress: Proven track record in on-page/technical SEO,

performance optimization, and marketing analytics integration (Google Tag Manager,

Google Ads API).

Full-Stack & Mobile Capabilities: Solid hands-on proficiency across modern stacks:

JavaScript/React, Node.js, Python, and Flutter.

Design-to-Code Execution: Proven capability to translate Figma mockups into

production-ready frontend code.

Multi-Role Mindset: Ability to handle multiple technical responsibilities within a focused,

single-product startup setup.

Language: Strong professional working proficiency in English (both written and spoken).

Education: Degree or ongoing higher education studies in Software Engineering,

Computer Science, or a related field.

**Nice-to-Have (Added Advantages)**

Experience with telecom/VoIP integrations (Twilio, Zadarma, PBX/IVR).

Familiarity with mapping or GIS tools (e.g., spatial routing logic, ArcGIS).

Basic working knowledge of Finnish (helpful for local documentation and administrative

tasks).

Active membership in professional computing or engineering bodies (e.g., IEEE, BCS).

What We Offer & Work Conditions

Global Exposure: Opportunity to collaborate directly with an international technical team

on a live, expanding platform.

Hands-on Multi-Stack Exposure: Real-world cross-functional experience across web,

mobile, cloud infrastructure, and automated systems.

Work Arrangement: Initial short-term hybrid setup, transitioning to mandatory on-site

presence in the Helsinki region. Candidates must be prepared to work on-site/relocate

accordingly.

jobs.title: Position, navigation and timing (pnt) engineer (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
As a fully owned subsidiary of Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran Electronics & Defense Australasia Pty Ltd (SEDA) delivers and supports various products including high-performance optronics and inertial navigation equipment.



Headquartered in Sydney, SEDA brings local expertise in the integration of optronics and navigation systems for the air, land, and naval platforms of the Australian and New Zealand Defence Forces.



In this role, you will be responsible for the design, integration, and verification of resilient PNT solutions for complex systems operating in challenging environments. You will work across system architecture, GNSS and timing engineering, sensor fusion, and assured PNT technologies, collaborating closely with software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.



This role is suited to an engineer with strong systems thinking, hands-on technical depth, and experience delivering high-reliability navigation and timing solutions.



In addition, the PNT Engineer provides technical input and subject matter expertise during proposal, capture, and tender phases.





In this role, you will be responsible for:



Systems Engineering & Architecture

o Gather, analyse and formalise internal and external stakeholders' needs relating to resilient PNT systems.

o Define end-to-end PNT system architectures integrating GNSS, INS, IMUs, aiding sensors (odometers, altimeters, computer vision), atomic clocks, time servers and Navwar software.

o Develop and maintain PNT architecture, design, and interface documentation, including SAD, SSDD, and interface control documentation.

o Develop simulation environments to characterize PNT solution performance and robustness.



PNT Engineering

o Knowledge on Safran's Inertial Navigation product lines (INS, IMU, gyroscope and accelerometer sensors), address questions and provide training to customers and industry partners.

o Knowledge on Safran's Timing product lines (clocks, time servers), address questions and provide training to customers and industry partners.

o Design, integrate and support PNT solutions for trials, demonstrations and trade shows, including inertial navigation, PPS generation, UTC traceability, clock disciplining, and holdover strategies.

o Support alternative and complementary PNT techniques, including inertial-only navigation, terrain aiding, celestial navigation, and signals of opportunity.

o Contribute to assured PNT strategies for operation in GNSS degraded or contested environments.
