jobs.title: TEAM Coordinator for production at MotilityCount ApS
jobs.description:
MotilityCount ApS is an ambitious company with both scientific and commercial expertise in fertility. We are located in Valby, Copenhagen, have about 30 employees.

We are an international company and our ambition is to raise awareness of male fertility and enable more couples to realise their dream of having a child – "sooner rather than later". In a world of increasing fertility challenges, we know that "Every Day Counts".

The company primarily sells two products: the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test for home use and the SwimCount™ Harvester for clinical use. For each of the two product areas, we have a TEAM Coordinator in production.

As our current TEAM Coordinator for the production of SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test is retiring and in the future only wants to continue on reduced hours, we are looking for a new TEAM Coordinator who will take the lead in the daily operations and take responsibility for products and deliveries being completed on time. You therefore take responsibility for the daily coordination of our operations. The right candidate will be an active part of the production of the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test and as a playing coach creates motivation, well-being and development among the company's employees in production.

In addition to being at the forefront of production, you must be able to contribute by ultrasonic welding, applying labels, filling syringes and packing in both primary and secondary packaging on day and evening shifts, respectively.

The production manufactures goods both for stock and for specific customer orders. It is therefore important that you can show great flexibility and ensure that deadlines are met. This applies not least to specific orders to the USA, where we must comply with agreed delivery dates to our American importer and distributor, who delivers on to major American retailers and webshops, among others.

Your tasks

  • Be highly visible in production, support employees in doing their work and create direction in everyday life.

  • Handle production planning, staffing, division of work, training and follow-up on the employees' work.

  • Plan and coordinate production tasks and staffing so that deadlines are met.

  • Coordinate with production management and QA with a focus on quality, efficiency and deadlines.

  • As a playing coach, you can actively participate in the TEAM's daily production work together with 10-12 production/packaging employees.

  • Be responsible for the daily distribution of the tasks and follow-up on the TEAM's tasks and results.

  • Focus on safety, quality and proper craftsmanship.

  • Follow up on and order production materials from suppliers.

  • Contribute to a strong team spirit and good cooperation in production.

Your qualification

We imagine that you have a technical background and solid experience with tasks in a Medical Device production similar to the production at MotilityCount ApS.

You thrive in the role of playing coach, take the lead, are visible in production and motivate employees through presence and professional sparring. At the same time, you are practically oriented and ready to show how the tasks should be carried out.

You will not have personnel management, as the employee management and financial responsibility are handled by Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach.

You can read and understand technical SOPs, have knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and generally have a good understanding of technical solutions.

You are accommodating, good at listening and able to create trust. At the same time, you work in a structured way and follow the tasks all the way through – even when it is busy. You believe that the best results are created through a strong team spirit and good cooperation. IT is a natural part of your daily work.

We offer

  • A TEAM Leader-Coordinator role with daily management and coordination of 10-12 employees, where you combine professionalism with responsibility for people and processes.

  • A production in good development, where you get the opportunity to put your stamp on the direction.

  • A working day close to colleagues – you are not alone, but become part of a committed workplace where your ideas and commitment make a difference.

  • A job where we focus on making time for both work and leisure.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at:

21 44 59 19.

 Please send your application as soon as possible to Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at: jm@motilitycount.com.

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Intelligent Industrial Energy Systems, Physics-informed AI, digital twins and advanced control
jobs.description:
Help build the systems that will electrify industry
Industrial energy systems are about to change fundamentally. For more than a century, industrial processes have been designed as isolated, deterministic systems. You model them, you optimize them, you operate them. That paradigm is breaking down. As electricity replaces fossil fuels, industrial systems must operate under fundamentally new conditions: fluctuating renewable energy, dynamic electricity prices, and increasing system complexity.

In the future, industrial energy systems will not simply run.

  • They will understand themselves.
  • They will learn from data.
  • They will anticipate and adapt.
  • They will optimize continuously.

At Aalborg University, we are starting to build the scientific foundations for those systems. We are looking for a PhD researcher who wants to be part of that.

The stipend is open for appointment from 15 September 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

What this PhD is really about
This PhD focuses on modelling and controlling electrified industrial thermal systems under real-world conditions. The work is embedded in a collaborative research project with industrial partners, providing access to realistic system configurations, experimental setups and operational data. The scientific ambition is to develop methods that combine physical models and data-driven approaches for adaptive, real-time operation of complex energy systems. Applications such as drying processes serve as test cases, but the goal is to establish methodologies that extend across industrial thermal systems more broadly.

How do we create industrial energy systems that combine physics and data to become adaptive, autonomous and trustworthy?
To get there, you will work at the intersection of thermal energy systems, machine learning and scientific AI, system modelling and identification, as well as optimization and control.

Your work will focus on developing new methods that integrate first-principles models with data-driven learning, supported by reduced-order representations and designed for real-time optimization and control. In essence, this is about physics-informed AI-approaches where physical insight and data reinforce each other rather than compete.

The ambition is to move beyond abstract or idealized solutions. Think digital twins that are not just conceptual, but genuinely useful in practice. Think control systems that can operate robustly under uncertainty, rather than relying on simplified assumptions.

The systems you will be working with are real world, industrial scale energy systems rather than simplified lab set-ups. They include high-temperature, high-power applications, including heat pumps, thermal storage, and complex process units, where both physical understanding and intelligent control are essential.

What you will do
Your day-to-day research will move between theory, modelling and real systems.

  • You will build mathematical and physics-based models of complex thermal systems.
  • You will develop reduced order representations enabling real-time implementation suited for online optimization of operating conditions and control.
  • You will combine the models with data driven learning to adapt to varying operating conditions.
  • You will design control strategies that can operate under real-world constraints.

Some of your work will be purely theoretical. Some of it will be validated against experimental setups and industrial data. You will publish your work, present it internationally, and build a research profile that is relevant far beyond this specific application.

The environment you will step into
You will not be placed inside a narrow, predefined research group. Instead, you will work across a small, complementary team that brings together different pieces of the puzzle:

thermal systems and physical modelling advanced control and system-level thinking industrial electrification and future energy technologies

This is an emerging collaboration, not a finished structure.  This means that you are not just executing a predefined roadmap. You are helping shape the direction.

Your supervisors
You will be supported by a team with different strengths, scientifically and personally.

Henrik Sørensen is Head of Section and your main supervisor. His focus is not only on research, but on building researchers. He will push you, give you space, and expect you to grow into an independent scientist.

Henrik C. Pedersen is Vice Head of Research and one of the key profiles within modelling and control at AAU. He will challenge your thinking, sharpen your methods and connect your work to a broader scientific context.

Anna Lyhne Jensen represents the next generation of energy researchers.
Her work focuses on electrification of industrial processes and future thermal systems, and she is deeply engaged in the green transition. She will be your closest collaborator in many parts of the project.

Together, the team is not uniform, and that is exactly the point. No single discipline can solve this problem.

Who you are
You likely have a background in energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control, applied mathematics, physics or a related field.

But more importantly, we are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong curiosity about how complex systems actually work.
  • Is comfortable with mathematical modelling and analytical thinking.
  • Is motivated to combine physical insight with data-drive methods.
  • Enjoys building models and methods – not just analyzing existing ones.
  • Has the ambition and persistence to tackle difficult problems and carry them through.

This is a demanding PhD. It requires both independence and engagement, and a willingness to work at the intersection of disciplines. You don’t need to know everything from the start - but you should have a clear drive to develop expertise and contribute at a high scientific level.

What you get out of it
This PhD is not just about writing three papers and moving on. It is about building a profile that sits at the intersection of energy systems, AI & modelling and optimization & control. That combination is rare, and extremely valuable, both in academia and industry.

  • You will work with real systems, real data and real problems.
  • You will collaborate with industry.
  • You will be part of the broader European research landscape in energy and sustainability.

And you will have a high degree of freedom to shape your own direction.

Why this matters
Industrial heat is one of the hardest parts of the green transition. Electrification alone is not enough. If we cannot control and optimize these systems intelligently, we will not unlock their full potential. This PhD is about contributing to these missing pieces.

Expected starting date is 15 September 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Interested?
If you want to work on something that is technically challenging, scientifically interesting, and actually matters — we would like to hear from you. Applications should include a CV, transcripts and a short motivation.

For further information, feel free to contact:

Henrik Sørensen, hs@energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at: the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus.
AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

jobs.title: Guide
jobs.description:
Activity Guide

We are now looking for an **Activity Guide** to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our international activity operations – safely guiding our guests through unique nature experiences and contributing to the development of our activity services.

What we offer

- Meaningful work with one of the pioneers of tourism in Lapland, where sustainability and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

- An inspiring working environment: in your free time, you can enjoy the peace and beauty of Laplands nature – skiing, hiking, fishing or watching the Northern Lights.

- The support of an encouraging work community: you will work in an international environment with the warm and relaxed atmosphere of a family-owned company.

- A wide range of staff benefits and opportunities for personal and professional development.

- Staff accommodation can be arranged if needed.


Your responsibilities

- Safely and professionally guiding guests on a variety of activities, such as snowshoeing, snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights excursions and ice fishing.

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences through warm, clear communication and professional service.

- Preparing equipment and maintaining activity areas.

- Working in the equipment storage and service area.

- Following safety guidelines and company procedures.

- Supporting the development of activity products and daily operations.

- Reporting to the Activity Manager.


Who are we looking for?

You are responsible, proactive and passionate about the outdoors and customer service. You enjoy seasonal work where no two days are exactly the same and thrive in an international environment.

You have:

- Solid experience in guiding or outdoor activities; previous experience in Lapland is considered an advantage.

- Good physical fitness and a safety-first mindset.

- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Fluency in English; other language skills, such as Finnish, German or French, are considered an advantage.

- A valid Category B driving licence.

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills.


Ready for an adventure?

If you have a passion for nature, adventure and creating unforgettable guest experiences, you might be the person we are looking for.

**Start date:** Late November.

If this sounds like you and you are interested in joining our team, send us your application and CV. We would love to hear from you!

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris is a family-owned pioneer of tourism in Lapland, located in Muonio in Fell Lapland, close to the Swedish border. Founded in 1973 as a camping and caravan site on the banks of the Tornio–Muonio River, Europes longest free-flowing river, Harriniva has grown into three full-service resorts surrounded by the pristine nature of Lapland.

Today, Harriniva Hotels & Safaris consists of **Harriniva Adventure Resort**, **Jeris Lakeside Resort** and **Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort**.

Every day, our team works to deliver on our promise: **Best in Wilderness**. At Harriniva, we do our utmost to ensure that every guest experiences the unique nature of Lapland in an unforgettable way – taking home lasting memories and the feeling of being at their best in the wilderness.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Secretary General (maternity cover)
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker, structured and with exceptional execution and communication skills? And do you have experience with executive and strategic support to senior management and knowledge of humanitarian and global affairs? We are looking for an experienced, proactive, extrovert and solutions oriented Executive Assistant to the Secretary General of the Danish Refugee Council (DRC). You will support the Secretary General in her daily work, work closely with the DRC Executive Management Team and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

About the job

The office of the Secretary General is a small dynamic team, supporting the Secretary General, the Executive Management Team, the Board of Directors, and the Council of DRC. The office also supports DRC’s overall organisational processes and its overall strategy, provides management and administrative support to the Secretary General, and organises global staff meetings. The office works and coordinates closely with departments in headquarters as well as DRC offices across the world.

 

Your key responsibilities will include:

·         Day-to-day comprehensive executive support and advice to the Secretary General, including on external engagements, positioning and communication, in close coordination with relevant teams. Liaising and communicating clearly and professionally on behalf of the Secretary General internally in DRC and with external stakeholders.

·         Support to the Executive Management Team (EMT), including preparation of agendas and presentations, decision-making documents and minutes, follow-up to decisions, and preparation of regular bilateral meetings between the SG and EMT members, including agenda setting. 

·         Coordinating and advising on processes for preparing the Secretary General’s external engagements, including drafting and proof reading of products (briefs, talking points, presentations etc.) for the Secretary General, and ensure timely and efficient follow-ups and minutes, and feedback to relevant teams.

·         Making sure that the Secretary General receives information requiring her attention and action and managing the Secretary General’s calendar.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen ways of working through digital tools, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

·         Ensuring expense management in Microsoft Dynamics, related to SG travels, events and meetings (primary task of student assistant).

·         Ensuring legalisation of documents required across the organisation, including notarisation, apostilles, and coordination with embassies and translation services (primary task of student assistant).

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

·         A relevant master’s degree in international relations, political science or similar.

·         Excellent collaboration, analytical, organisational and communication skills, a flexible and solution-oriented attitude, and a structured and independent way of working with the ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong attention to detail and high-quality deliverables.

·         Ability to maintain overview of a broad operational and political portfolio, advise on priorities and ensure timely execution and follow-up.

·         Solid knowledge of humanitarian affairs and operations, as well as international relations and developments impacting the work of DRC.

·         Experience in interacting with many different stakeholders, including high level, ideally from diplomacy and/or external relations from a global organisation.

·         Ability to deliver high-quality analytical inputs, and to draft complex briefing materials, talking points, and political or legal reports in fast-paced, high-pressure environment is required.

·         Full professional proficiency in Danish and English. Basic knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable.

 

All employees should master DRC's core competencies:

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

An interesting workplace with excellent colleagues and plenty of scope for contribution with your own ideas. The possibility of working closely with and supporting the Secretary General and the Executive Management Team, as well as colleagues across our global organisation.

Contract length: 9 months with the possibility of extension (maternity cover)

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Start date: mid-November 2026 or the soonest hereafter

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and AC. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply. Salary will be determined based on qualifications.

Please note that you need to have the right to work in Denmark (through nationality or existing work visa) in order to be considered for this role. 

 

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English (no longer than four pages) as well as degree certificate. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 2 September 2026. We expect to conduct interviews in September.

Further information 

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Vibeke Bach Madsen, Corporate Strategic Advisor in the Secretary General’s Office: vibeke.bach.madsen@drc.ngo. We will do our best to respond to as many inquiries as possible.

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

 

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

 

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

 

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

 

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Junior Planner
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how bestselling fashion products stay available in stores and online around the world? Do you enjoy working with data and finding solutions? If you're looking for a place where you can learn, grow and make an impact from day one, this could be your next step.

Join SELECTED's Essentials department as our new Junior Planner and become part of the team behind one of our most important business areas. Together, we ensure that our bestselling products are available when and where our customers need them, across international markets.

YOUR TEAM
Essentials is home to SELECTED's Never Out Of Stock programme, also known as NOOS. Here, we work to keep our bestselling products available throughout the year by balancing customer demand, inventory and product availability. To make that happen, we work closely with colleagues across Sales, Buying and Product, as well as with our international suppliers. 
You'll join a skilled and supportive team where knowledge is shared openly, responsibility comes early and you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make an impact.

YOUR ROLE
As a Junior Planner, you'll help ensure that SELECTED's bestselling products are available throughout the year. By combining data, analysis and close collaboration with colleagues across the business, you'll see how every planning decision helps keep our bestselling products moving.
From day one, you'll contribute to the team's work while developing your analytical skills and commercial understanding. As you grow in the role, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and build your expertise within different planning disciplines. Depending on your development and business needs, you'll have the opportunity to specialise within areas such as demand planning or replenishment planning.

Your tasks will include:

  • Monitoring sales, stock levels and product availability across international markets

  • Analysing data and identifying trends that support planning and business decisions

  • Supporting forecasting, replenishment and purchasing activities

  • Preparing reports and maintaining planning data in our systems

  • Collaborating with colleagues across Sales, Buying and Product to ensure an efficient product flow

  • Contributing ideas that help improve planning processes and commercial performance.

YOUR PROFILE
We believe you'll thrive if you're curious about how a business works, enjoy analysing data and are motivated by turning data into meaningful business decisions. You're eager to learn, enjoy collaborating across teams and are ready to take responsibility while making a real contribution to the business. In addition, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Economics, Engineering or a similar analytical field

  • Have experience working with Microsoft Excel and are eager to strengthen your analytical toolbox

  • Work in a structured and detail-oriented way

  • Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Nidal Himidi on +45 52 15 12 83. Otherwise, please send your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 7 September 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to remove the job advertisement, when we find the right candidate.  

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritise based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

jobs.title: Technician
jobs.description:
Technician

The Security Centre Limited is seeking a technically capable and customer-focused Technician to join our Systems Department. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance, servicing, and troubleshooting of electronic security systems, including intruder alarms, card access systems, CCTV, and commercial fire systems.

The Technician will make a significant contribution to the success of the Systems Department by delivering high-quality technical work, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring projects and service requirements are completed safely, efficiently, and to the satisfaction of our clients.


Location: Cayman Islands

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Reports to: Systems Department Management


About the Role

This is a hands-on technical role supporting the delivery of electronic security projects and ongoing maintenance services across residential and commercial environments.

The successful candidate will work across the full project lifecycle, from cable installation and device deployment through to control panel termination, system commissioning, troubleshooting, and client handover.


The role will also support related electrical, communications, audio-visual, security lighting, telephone, cabling, and home automation projects, while working closely with the Sales and Systems teams, manufacturers, customers, and other stakeholders.

A key part of the role is ensuring that all work is completed in accordance with company standards, client requirements, project specifications, contractual commitments, and applicable safety requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning


â¢ Install electronic security systems and associated equipment in residential and commercial environments.

â¢ Run and terminate cables in accordance with system and project requirements.

â¢ Execute control panel terminations and associated wiring.

â¢ Install security devices, sensors, readers, cameras, panels, and other system components.

â¢ Establish Central Station connections and complete system commissioning.

â¢ Test systems to ensure correct operation and compliance with project specifications.

â¢ Support client handovers and provide appropriate system guidance where required.


Service, Maintenance & Troubleshooting

â¢ Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance on security systems.

â¢ Diagnose and troubleshoot system faults and technical issues.

â¢ Carry out repairs and corrective works as required.

â¢ Maintain accurate records of service activities, faults, repairs, and system performance.

â¢ Respond professionally and efficiently to client service requirements.

â¢ Ensure systems remain operational, reliable, and fit for purpose.


Electronic Security Projects

â¢ Assist the Sales and Systems teams with the design, sourcing, ordering, installation, and commissioning of electronic security projects.

â¢ Support both reactive and proactive security projects.

â¢ Assist with project planning, equipment requirements, installation activities, and commissioning.

â¢ Work to agreed labour, equipment, and project timelines.

â¢ Contribute to the successful completion and delivery of projects to customer expectations.

â¢ Identify opportunities for system improvements and additional client requirements.


Related Technical Services

â¢ Perform electrical and civil works associated with security installations.

â¢ Support projects involving security lighting, telephones, audio-visual systems, home automation, and structured cabling.

â¢ Assist with the integration of security systems and related technologies where required.

â¢ Apply sound technical judgement when working with existing infrastructure and client premises.

Customer & Supplier Relationships

â¢ Develop and maintain strong working relationships with product and equipment manufacturers.

â¢ Build positive and professional relationships with commercial and residential customers.

â¢ Communicate clearly with clients regarding technical requirements, project progress, service issues, and completion.

â¢ Represent The Security Centre Limited professionally at all times.

â¢ Maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction and service quality.


Administration, Compliance & Safety

â¢ Complete administrative tasks, service documentation, project records, and reports requested by the Head of Department.

â¢ Comply with all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of The Security Centre Limited.

â¢ Comply with applicable requirements and rules established by clients while working on their premises.

â¢ Follow all company health and safety requirements and maintain safe working practices.

â¢ Complete required safety training and ensure all work is carried out in accordance with established procedures.

â¢ Support compliance with the policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook.

â¢ Perform other duties as assigned by the Management Team from time to time.


What We're Looking For

Essential experience includes:


â¢ Experience in electronic security systems, electrical work, telecommunications, structured cabling, or a related technical field.

â¢ Strong practical skills in cable installation, termination, and equipment installation.

â¢ Ability to read and understand technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and system specifications.

â¢ Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

â¢ Ability to work safely with electrical and electronic equipment.

â¢ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

â¢ Good communication and customer service skills.

â¢ Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.

â¢ Ability to manage multiple assignments and work within established project timelines.

â¢ Valid driver's licence and ability to travel to client sites as required.


Experience with intruder alarms, access control, CCTV, commercial fire systems, Central Station connections, security lighting, home automation, audio-visual systems, or structured cabling would be a strong advantage.


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

â¢ Technically capable, practical, and hands-on

â¢ Customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service

â¢ Strong at troubleshooting and finding practical solutions

â¢ Detail-oriented and committed to quality workmanship

â¢ Reliable, organised, and accountable

â¢ Comfortable working on construction sites, commercial premises, and residential properties

â¢ Able to work effectively under project and service deadlines

â¢ Professional and confident when dealing with customers, suppliers, and colleagues

â¢ Committed to following safety, company, and client procedures

â¢ Willing to continuously develop their technical knowledge and skills


This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded individual to develop their career within one of the Cayman Islands' leading security companies while working with a broad range of electronic security technologies and projects.


Kindly send your resume/CV to HR at hr@security.ky

jobs.title: Senior Professional Data-Engineer (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
who we are At adorsys, we are not just developers and analysts; we are pioneers shaping the digital future for banking and insurance sectors. For over a decade, we have crafted innovative software solutions that grant our clients a decisive edge in their business. We foster an international and agile work environment that thrives on diversity, creativity, and collaboration.
What awaits youWe are looking for experienced Data Engineers to join an international platform team responsible for the infrastructure and data management of intelligent automation services in the finance domain. The services leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning models to generate automated booking proposals from various financial data sources.

The team is currently modernizing its platform to ensure long-term scalability, stability, and performance. By 2026, all core components and data pipelines will be migrated to a modern infrastructure stack based on Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, and other state-of-the-art technologies.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and streaming solutions, ensuring high data quality, governance, and security standards.

Your profile Main Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache NiFi.
• Implement and manage data lakehouse structures based on Apache Iceberg, including schema evolution, partitioning, and time travel features.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries and data access layers with Trino, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Integrate diverse data sources (Kafka, S3, RDBMS, REST APIs, etc.) into unified pipelines.
• Ensure data quality, security, and governance across the data infrastructure.
• Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and distributed systems.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data scientists, platform engineers, business stakeholders) to deliver data-driven solutions.
• Document technical designs, concepts, and processes.

Required Skills & Experience
• Proven experience with Apache Iceberg, Apache NiFi, and Trino.
• Understanding and ability to work with Apache Spark code.
• Experience with ETL/ELT processes and integrating APIs.
• Hands-on expertise in real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.
• Strong background in large-scale data processing and distributed systems.
• Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially S3, IAM, Glue.
• Programming languages: Python, Java, or Scala.
• Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• CI/CD & DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
• Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and performance optimization techniques.

Nice to Have
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Familiarity with CI/CD automation and Infrastructure as Code.
• Practical knowledge of security configurations in data processing.

Soft Skills
• Structured and solution-oriented working style.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills within interdisciplinary teams.
• Ability to document and explain complex technical processes in a clear manner.

Project Context

The platform team develops and maintains the data infrastructure for automation services in the accounting and finance sector. These services use artificial intelligence to continuously improve booking suggestions based on historical cloud data, ensuring seamless integration into familiar workflows.
To ensure scalability and long-term stability, the platform is being migrated to a new infrastructure (Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, etc.) by 2026. This transformation secures performance, scalability, and future-proof operations.

Why us?We're not just offering a job; we're inviting you to be part of a movement. With us, you'll navigate the exciting terrain of finance and banking and contribute to sustainable financial living. Benefit from a German firm's structure and security, coupled with competitive remuneration and a culture that nurtures growth.

Your contact personLucian Mihaila

About usWe have been developing individual software for banks and insurance companies for more than 10 years. We do this to give our customers a real competitive advantage. Our teams accompany the clients from the first idea to the finished product.
Regardless of whether an existing service needs to be modernized or the solution for a new business model is missing: we develop software for a digital future.

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.

 
 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.

 - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Professional fluency in English and Japanese, both written and verbal.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.

jobs.title: Engineer Estimator
jobs.description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading provider of premium glass products, dedicated to transforming spaces with elegance and sophistication. With a commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, we specialize in designing and manufacturing high-quality glass solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Founded in 2017 in New York, the company has expanded its presence with offices in Los Angeles, Florida, and Texas. As a nationwide company, we serve clients across America, offering our signature glass products and services to diverse markets.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

Employment Type:

  • Remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural drawings and submitted quotes to determine suitable installation options for our systems, including glass, aluminum, and steel partitions
  • Perform precise take-offs for all door and partition openings based on architectural and shop drawings
  • Read and interpret door schedules and hardware sets to ensure accurate product selection and full compatibility
  • Communicate effectively with the sales team to clarify project scope, technical requirements, and deadlines
  • Request necessary documentation, including compliance and regulatory certifications, as needed
  • Prepare detailed quotes that clearly define included materials, scope of work, exclusions, and any relevant assumptions or conditions
  • Identify and correct technical errors made by sales managers and propose appropriate alternatives or solutions

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
  • Confident in reading and interpreting:
  • Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Basic formulas
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently
  • Comfortable working with scaled PDFs (e.g., in Adobe Acrobat)
  • Languages: Russian (fluent), English (Upper-intermediate B2)
  • Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

  • Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
  • Supportive and innovative work environment
  • Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

Take your passion to the next level and work alongside other masters of their craft to build a fulfilling and rewarding career at Marina Bay Sands.

Summary Of Job Responsibilities

As a Valet driver, you will be responsible for handling all arrivals, and departing vehicles at the Hotel Valet, Casino Valet, Carpark Valet, MICE, and Hall Parking. You are expected to deliver the required service standard based on Forbes service standards consistently.

You must perform and support the Valet operations, and under the supervision of Valet Captains, and Managers to ensure that all the tasks are being completed on time and based on the standards set by the department. You should also work in close collaboration with other Valet drivers, traffic marshals and the bellman who are on duty at the driveway to ensure seamless arrival and departure for all guests.

  • Handle valet vehicles within the property of Marina Bay Sands in line with the departmental standards
  • Operate the Valet Management System according to departmental guidelines.
  • Assist in managing the traffic around the property of Marina Bay Sands as well as ensuring and maintaining safety of guests and vehicles.
  • Provide level of service and experience according to the departmental audit standards and work as a team to achieve the departmental KPIs.

  • Monitor and report any anomalies to Valet Captains for immediate action.
  • Learn and support the team with any other operational and/or departmental duties when required.
  • Assist with any other assignments tasked by Valet Captains

Job Requirements

Education & Certification

  • No formal education required

Experience

  • Possess a valid Singapore Class 3 Driving License with a minimum of 2 years driving experience.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is an advantage.

Other Prerequisites

  • Good interpersonal and English communication skills, proactive and positive attitude
  • Able to work within a culturally diverse team.
  • Able to deploy in environment as required to perform job responsibility
  • Able to perform manual handling duties, including lifting and moving guests' luggage.

  • Able to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working outdoors and standing for extended periods as required by operational needs

  • Possess basic knowledge of Singapore attractions and places of interest.

Marina Bay Sands is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, providing equal opportunities as we grow our talent base to match our growth ambitions in Singapore. jobs.title: Autolakerer til Herning
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har igen bedt os om at finde den rette person til en central rolle i virksomheden. De søger en Produktionsteknisk Leder, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling, produktion og mennesker.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har deres domicil i Middelfart og fungerer som nordisk udviklingscenter for den japanske koncern Mayekawa. Virksomheden udvikler industrielle køleanlæg og varmepumper og er særligt kendt for mCHILLER-serien, der bruger det naturlige kølemiddel ammoniak og på den måde opnår høj energieffektivitet og bæredygtighed.

Der skal bygges en helt ny Industrialization-afdeling op i Middelfart, og det er dig, der kommer til at gøre det. I samarbejde med udviklingsdirektøren, finder du ud af hvad afdelingen skal kunne, og du bygger systemerne til det. Du tager de lange møder og forhandlingerne med udvikling og produktion om, hvordan tingene kan gøres bedre, og du sætter retning for, hvordan udviklingens arbejde modnes og overleveres til produktionen, og du bidrager i udførelsen af arbejdet. Det er en rolle med ansvar og ledelse, hvor du selv er med i det faglige udførende arbejde.

Afdelingen kommer til at bygge bro mellem udvikling og produktion. Og med en produktionsenhed i Serbien, som du får en del at gøre med, skal du regne med op til 50 rejsedage om året.

I bliver to i afdelingen: dig som lead og en Produktionsteknisk Supporter, og sammen udgør I fundamentet i Mayekawas Industrialization-afdeling.

Ansvarsområder
I samarbejde med Mayekawa Nordics ledelse, bygger du afdelingen op fra bunden og finder, udvikler og sætter rammerne for, hvordan den skal arbejde.

Ansvaret kommer til at ligge hos dig fra dag ét, og med reference til den danske udviklingsdirektør, omfatter dine opgaver:

  • Opbygning af afdelingens arbejdsgange og processer.

  • At afdelingen sikrer en grundig modning af produkterne, så de kan gå sikkert fra udvikling til produktion.

  • Kontakten til de tre interessenter: udvikling i Danmark, moderfirma i Japan og produktion i Serbien.

  • Sourcingaftaler i samarbejde med strategisk indkøb.

Arbejdsopgaver
Du får det daglige ansvar for at opgaver bliver udført, og du er selv med i det faglige arbejde, hvor en del af af det ligger også på det strategiske plan:

  • CAD-automatisering på tværs af produktfamilier og varianter.

  • Produktvariant-ingeniørarbejde og vurdering af, hvad ændringer påvirker.

  • Design-for-assembly forbedringer.

  • Integration af kvalitetssikring i udviklingsprocesserne.

  • Udvikling af systemer til generering af kundedokumentationspakker.

  • Integration af nye produktfeatures i eksisterende produktlinjer.

Faglige kompetencer
Du har en baggrund som produktionsingeniør, maskinmester, produktionsteknolog eller noget, der ligner. Vigtigst er, at du har stået i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling og produktion før og ved, hvor der kan opstå gnidninger i praksis. Har du ledelseserfaring, er det fint. Har du den ikke, men lyst til at træde ind i en lederrolle, er det lige så fint.

Afdelingen skal samlet set dække en række tekniske områder. Da du bliver den første person i afdelingen, forventer vi, at du allerede har et solidt fagligt fundament og kan dække flere af områderne fra begyndelsen.  Det gælder Vault og Inventor, herunder automatisering og workflows, mekanisk design og montageprocesser, kendskab til produktionsteknologi og erfaring med ERP- og PDM-systemer. Viden om svejsning, pladebearbejdning, rør og fittings er en fordel.

Personlige kompetencer
Du er en person, der tager ansvar, og som er opsøgende på både relationer og viden, og du venter ikke på, at nogen beder dig om noget. Du tager teten, når det kræves, og forstår at give plads til andre, når det er dem, der skal fylde.

Du har drive til at bygge systemer, forbedre dem og holde dem kørende. Du gør opgaver færdige frem for at kaste dig over de næste. Og du kan finde vej i en organisation, der endnu ikke er struktureret. For det er præcis det, du kommer til: at skabe strukturen, der ikke er der endnu.

Det vil være en fordel for dig, hvis du har interesse i eller erfaring med, at arbejde i et internationalt miljø, med relationer og kontakter uden for landets grænser. Derfor er det også væsentligt, at du taler engelsk på et højere niveau.

  • Et spændende og selvstændigt job med stor frihed i udførelsen af opgaverne og gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

jobs.title: Morgenfrisk og ansvarsbevidst? Bliv en del af Oscar Biludlejning
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til to medarbejdere, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i en afdeling og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.
